tandem-stance-balance.name: Tandem Stance Balance
tandem-stance-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or extended for balance. Look straight ahead with a neutral spine.
tandem-stance-balance.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, maintaining upright posture. Hold this position while keeping your gaze fixed on a focal point.

single-leg-stance.name: Single Leg Stance
single-leg-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides or ready to use nearby support. Engage your core and maintain upright posture.
single-leg-stance.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees. Keep your standing leg straight and arms out for balance if needed.

marching-high-knees.name: Marching in Place with High Knees
marching-high-knees.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees ready to swing. Maintain an engaged core and neutral spine.
marching-high-knees.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee toward chest height in a marching motion while swinging opposite arm forward. Alternate legs in a controlled, rhythmic pattern.

heel-toe-walking.name: Heel-Toe Walking
heel-toe-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms at sides or extended for balance. Look forward with good posture.
heel-toe-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward by landing on heels first and rolling through to toes with each step. Maintain slow, deliberate movements with controlled weight transfer.

seated-trunk-rotations.name: Seated Trunk Rotations
seated-trunk-rotations.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
seated-trunk-rotations.endPoseDescription: Rotate your trunk to one side, keeping hips stable and facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side with controlled movement.

standing-hip-marches-wall.name: Standing Hip Marches with Wall Support
standing-hip-marches-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with hands lightly on it for balance, feet hip-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
standing-hip-marches-wall.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward hip height while maintaining upright posture. Lower the leg back down and repeat alternating sides in a controlled rhythm.

gait-training-walking.name: Gait Training with Walking Pattern Focus
gait-training-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture, feet together, ready to walk forward. Focus on maintaining balance and awareness of body position.
gait-training-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly with deliberate steps, focusing on heel-strike, midstance, and toe-off phases. Maintain upright posture and consistent step length throughout.

sit-to-stand-practice.name: Sit to Stand Practice
sit-to-stand-practice.startPoseDescription: Sit on a sturdy chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back against the backrest with hands on armrests if available.
sit-to-stand-practice.endPoseDescription: Lean forward slightly and push through your heels to stand up fully, extending hips and knees. Stand with good posture, then slowly lower back down to seated position.

resistance-band-wrist-extension.name: Resistance Band Wrist Extension
resistance-band-wrist-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected forearm resting on a table, palm facing downward. Hold a looped resistance band around your hand with light to moderate tension.
resistance-band-wrist-extension.endPoseDescription: Extend your wrist upward, lifting the back of your hand against the band resistance. Slowly lower back to the starting position with control.

resistance-band-finger-flexion.name: Resistance Band Finger Flexion
resistance-band-finger-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected hand relaxed in front of you, fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your fingers with light tension.
resistance-band-finger-flexion.endPoseDescription: Curl your fingers inward, making a fist against the band resistance. Slowly release back to the extended position with controlled movement.

resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Abduction
resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. Your affected arm hangs at your side with the band in your hand.
resistance-band-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your affected arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbow throughout. Lower back down with control.

resistance-band-elbow-flexion.name: Resistance Band Elbow Flexion
resistance-band-elbow-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your affected arm at your side, holding one end of a resistance band that is anchored under your feet. Your elbow should be slightly bent with palm facing forward.
resistance-band-elbow-flexion.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbow, bringing your hand up toward your shoulder against the band resistance. Slowly lower back to the starting position with controlled movement.

shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.name: Shoulder Flexor Stretch with Band
shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and hold a resistance band with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height. Keep your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
shoulder-flexor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body while keeping your arms extended, feeling a stretch across your chest and front shoulders. Hold this comfortable stretch position.

tandem-standing.name: Tandem Standing
tandem-standing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together near a wall or sturdy support that you can hold if needed. Keep your posture upright and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
tandem-standing.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, holding the stance for as long as safely possible. Maintain a tall posture and engaged core muscles.
conditions_seen_in: osteoporosis safe exercise program for 70 year old

bicep-curls.name: Bicep Curls
bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged.
bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells up toward shoulders by bending at the elbows. Lower back to starting position with control.

goblet-squats.name: Goblet Squats
goblet-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
goblet-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower into a squat by bending at hips and knees, keeping weight in heels. Return to standing position by driving through heels.

seated-rows.name: Seated Rows
seated-rows.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at sides with arms extended forward. Maintain neutral spine alignment.
seated-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull dumbbells toward ribcage by bending elbows and retracting shoulder blades. Extend arms back to starting position with control.

tricep-extensions.name: Tricep Extensions
tricep-extensions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
tricep-extensions.endPoseDescription: Extend arms upward by straightening elbows until the dumbbell reaches overhead. Lower back to starting position with control.

standing-hip-abductions.name: Standing Hip Abductions
standing-hip-abductions.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, holding onto a stable surface for balance. Hold dumbbells at sides with arms straight.
standing-hip-abductions.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg out to the side while keeping it straight, raising it to hip height. Lower back to starting position and repeat on the other side.

quadriceps-stretches.name: Quadriceps Stretches
quadriceps-stretches.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and use a wall or chair for balance with one hand. Stand on one leg with good posture.
quadriceps-stretches.endPoseDescription: Bend the opposite knee and pull your foot toward your buttock using your hand, feeling a stretch on the front of the thigh. Keep knees aligned and avoid arching the back.
conditions_seen_in: tibial stress fracture return to running

hip-abduction.name: Hip Abduction Exercises
hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent for support and the top leg straight and aligned with your body. Rest your head on your arm comfortably.
hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift the top leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight and externally rotated at the hip. Raise the leg to about 45 degrees and hold briefly before lowering.
conditions_seen_in: tibial stress fracture return to running

patellar-tendon-strap.name: Patellar Tendon Strap Exercises
patellar-tendon-strap.startPoseDescription: Sit on a chair with one leg extended and a resistance band wrapped around the upper calf just below the knee. Keep good posture and core engaged.
patellar-tendon-strap.endPoseDescription: Extend the knee fully against the band resistance, tensioning the patellar tendon in a controlled manner. Hold the extended position and return slowly without fully relaxing the muscle.

supine-spinal-twist-stretch.name: Supine Spinal Twist Stretch
supine-spinal-twist-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms spread out to the sides in a T-position. Your spine should be neutral and relaxed against the floor.
supine-spinal-twist-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bend your right knee and bring it across your body toward the left side, allowing your torso and spine to twist gently. Keep your shoulders flat on the ground and look toward the right.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

standing-lateral-band-walk.name: Standing Lateral Band Walk
standing-lateral-band-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Slightly bend your knees and lean forward with a neutral spine, maintaining tension in the band.
standing-lateral-band-walk.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side while maintaining tension in the band and keeping your torso upright. Take controlled steps sideways while the band remains taut, working your hip stabilizers.

prone-superman-hold.name: Prone Superman Hold
prone-superman-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on your stomach with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Your forehead rests on the floor in a neutral neck position.
prone-superman-hold.endPoseDescription: Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground simultaneously, creating a slight arch in your back. Hold this position while squeezing your back muscles and glutes.

seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.name: Seated Spinal Rotation with Resistance Band
seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band looped around a fixed point at chest height. Cross your arms over your chest while holding the band with tension.
seated-spinal-rotation-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso away from the anchor point, feeling a controlled stretch in your spine and obliques. Keep your hips stable and move only through your thoracic spine.

prone-y-t-w-raises-band.name: Prone Y-T-W Raises with Band
prone-y-t-w-raises-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band underneath you and both ends held in your hands at shoulder level. Your forehead rests on the floor and core is engaged.
prone-y-t-w-raises-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms up and back against the band resistance, creating Y, T, and W shapes sequentially. Each position targets different back stabilizer muscles while maintaining a stable prone position.

standing-balance-hold.name: Standing Balance Hold
standing-balance-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with light fingertip contact on a chair or counter for light balance support if needed. Keep your eyes focused on a fixed point ahead of you.
standing-balance-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain your upright posture while gradually reducing hand support as balance improves. Try to stand independently with weight evenly distributed through both feet.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

shin-stretch.name: Shin Stretch
shin-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on a padded mat and sit your glutes back slightly toward your heels with the tops of your feet flat on the ground behind you. Keep your torso upright and place your hands behind you on the mat.
shin-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean back on your hands while keeping your feet flat, creating a stretch across the front of your shins and tops of your feet. Only go as far back as comfort allows without pain.

dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand facing away from a bench or elevated surface with one foot elevated behind you on the bench, holding dumbbells at your sides. Your front leg is straight with feet positioned to allow for a deep lunge.
dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending your front knee until it reaches approximately 90 degrees, keeping your torso upright. Your back knee hovers just above the ground while dumbbells remain at your sides.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with a slight bend in your knees. Your shoulders are back and your core is braced.
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your glutes backward while maintaining a neutral spine and slight knee bend. The dumbbells travel down the front of your legs until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.name: Single Leg Balance with Dumbbell Hold
single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Your non-standing knee is lifted to hip height, creating an athletic stance.
single-leg-balance-dumbbell-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain the single-leg stance while keeping your standing knee slightly flexed and your core engaged. The dumbbell remains at your side as you balance without shifting weight or dropping the lifted knee.

dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.name: Dumbbell Step-Up with Knee Drive
dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a bench or step, holding dumbbells at your sides with your feet hip-width apart. Your posture is upright and you're positioned to step up onto the elevated surface.
dumbbell-step-up-knee-drive.endPoseDescription: Step up with one leg and drive the opposite knee up to hip height while standing tall on the bench. Your dumbbells remain at your sides as you complete the dynamic movement with control.

dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise to Single Leg Stand
dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Your non-standing leg is lightly touching the ground for light balance support if needed.
dumbbell-lateral-raise-single-leg.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height while maintaining single-leg balance. Your core remains engaged and your standing knee stays slightly flexed throughout the movement.

external-rotation-resistance-band.name: External Rotation with Resistance Band
external-rotation-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right elbow bent to 90 degrees against your side and a resistance band around your wrist. Your forearm points forward across your body.
external-rotation-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance, stopping when your forearm is perpendicular to your body. Slowly return to the starting position with controlled movement.

scapular-push-ups.name: Scapular Push-ups
scapular-push-ups.startPoseDescription: Position yourself in a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Keep your elbows locked and core engaged.
scapular-push-ups.endPoseDescription: Slightly depress your shoulder blades by dropping your chest a few inches without bending your elbows. Return to the starting position by retracting your scapulae upward.

quadruped-shoulder-rocks.name: Quadruped Shoulder Rocks
quadruped-shoulder-rocks.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-shoulder-rocks.endPoseDescription: Rock your hips backward toward your heels while keeping your arms extended, feeling the stretch through your shoulders and chest. Return to center and repeat the gentle rocking motion.

planks-with-shoulder-taps.name: Planks with Shoulder Taps
planks-with-shoulder-taps.startPoseDescription: Hold a plank position with hands directly under your shoulders, body in a straight line, and core fully engaged. Keep your hips stable and avoid rotating.
planks-with-shoulder-taps.endPoseDescription: Tap your right hand to your left shoulder while maintaining plank position, then return and tap your left hand to your right shoulder. Alternate sides in a controlled manner.

glute-bridge-band-loop.name: Glute Bridge with Band Loop
glute-bridge-band-loop.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Your arms are at your sides with palms down for stability.
glute-bridge-band-loop.endPoseDescription: Drive your hips upward toward the ceiling, engaging your glutes and maintaining outward pressure against the band with your knees. Your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders at the peak.

calf-stretch-band-assist.name: Calf Stretch with Band Assist
calf-stretch-band-assist.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, placing a resistance band around the ball of one foot while holding the band's ends. Your back is upright and your other leg is relaxed.
calf-stretch-band-assist.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your body, bringing your toes and ball of the foot back toward your shin in a dorsiflexed position. You should feel a stretch along the calf and Achilles tendon of the working leg.

quadruped-hip-circles-band.name: Quadruped Hip Circles with Band
quadruped-hip-circles-band.startPoseDescription: Begin on your hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one knee, positioned on your forearms for added support. Your hips are directly over your knees and your core is braced.
quadruped-hip-circles-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded knee and make slow, controlled circles with it while maintaining tension in the band and stability in your core. Your supporting arm and leg remain stationary throughout the circular motion.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

banded-monster-walk.name: Banded Monster Walk
banded-monster-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees, feet shoulder-width apart, and hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Maintain a quarter-squat position with a slight forward lean.
banded-monster-walk.endPoseDescription: Take a large diagonal step forward and to one side, then bring the opposite leg to follow, creating a forward diagonal walking pattern. Maintain outward pressure on the band and the quarter-squat position throughout the movement.

prone-shoulder-flexion-band.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Band
prone-shoulder-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a table with your arms hanging off the edge, holding a resistance band in both hands with your arms at your sides. Your forehead rests on a small towel and your core is engaged.
prone-shoulder-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms up and forward against band resistance until they reach shoulder height or slightly above, maintaining a neutral spine. Your shoulders are engaged and your core remains braced throughout the movement.

diaphragmatic-breathing.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
diaphragmatic-breathing.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place one hand on your chest and one hand on your belly.
diaphragmatic-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose, allowing your belly to rise while keeping your chest still. Exhale slowly through your mouth, feeling your pelvic floor relax completely.

happy-baby-pose.name: Happy Baby Pose
happy-baby-pose.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent toward your chest and feet off the ground. Grasp the outer edges of your feet with your hands.
happy-baby-pose.endPoseDescription: Gently press your knees toward your armpits while keeping your lower back on the ground. Rock side to side gently to release tension in the pelvic floor.

supine-pelvic-floor-relaxation.name: Supine Pelvic Floor Relaxation
supine-pelvic-floor-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Let your arms rest at your sides with palms facing up.
supine-pelvic-floor-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Focus on consciously relaxing all tension from your pelvic floor muscles while maintaining slow, deep breathing. Imagine the muscles softening and releasing with each exhale.

recumbent-figure-four.name: Recumbent Figure Four
recumbent-figure-four.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure-four shape.
recumbent-figure-four.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the thigh of the bottom leg toward your chest while keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the ground. Hold to feel a deep stretch in the hip and pelvic floor region.

kegel-exercise.name: Kegel Exercise (Pelvic Floor Contraction)
kegel-exercise.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably on a chair or mat with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Relax your pelvic floor muscles completely.
kegel-exercise.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urine, holding the contraction for 3-5 seconds. Release and relax for 5 seconds before repeating.

dumbbell-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
dumbbell-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your chest up, shoulders back, and core engaged.
dumbbell-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while keeping your back straight and lowering the dumbbells along your legs until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive through your heels to return to standing position.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

supine-pelvic-floor-dumbbell-squeeze.name: Supine Pelvic Floor With Dumbbell Squeeze
supine-pelvic-floor-dumbbell-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a light dumbbell placed on your lower abdomen. Relax your entire pelvic floor.
supine-pelvic-floor-dumbbell-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Contract your pelvic floor muscles while gently pressing down on the dumbbell with your lower abdomen for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest before repeating.

standing-pelvic-tilts.name: Standing Pelvic Tilts
standing-pelvic-tilts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands on your hips. Maintain a neutral spine with shoulders relaxed.
standing-pelvic-tilts.endPoseDescription: Tilt your pelvis forward and backward in a controlled manner, engaging your core with each movement. Focus on the pelvic floor engagement during the posterior tilt.

heel-slides.name: Heel Slides
heel-slides.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Engage your transverse abdominis by gently drawing in your lower abdomen.
heel-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide one heel away from your body, extending the leg while keeping your lower back neutral against the floor. Return to start and repeat on the other side.

wall-push-up.name: Wall Push-Up
wall-push-up.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with feet hip-width apart and hands on the wall at shoulder height. Your body should form a diagonal line from head to heels.
wall-push-up.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows to lower your upper body toward the wall while engaging your core. Push through your hands to return to the starting position.

supine-marching.name: Supine Marching
supine-marching.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees, feet hovering above the floor. Engage your core by drawing your lower abdomen inward.
supine-marching.endPoseDescription: Maintain the tabletop position while alternately lowering one foot toward the floor in a marching pattern. Keep your lower back neutral and core engaged throughout.

pelvic-floor-contractions.name: Pelvic Floor Muscle Contractions (Kegels)
pelvic-floor-contractions.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the floor, maintaining neutral spine posture. Relax all abdominal and leg muscles.
pelvic-floor-contractions.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urine, holding the contraction for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest for 5 seconds between repetitions.

resistance-band-glute-activation.name: Resistance Band Glute Activation
resistance-band-glute-activation.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean from the hips.
resistance-band-glute-activation.endPoseDescription: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes pointing forward and chest upright. Return to center and repeat, feeling the outer glute engage.

deep-core-activation-band.name: Deep Core Activation with Band
deep-core-activation-band.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band wrapped around your torso at the level of your ribs. Hands are under shoulders and knees under hips.
deep-core-activation-band.endPoseDescription: Exhale and draw your navel toward your spine, engaging the deep core muscles while maintaining neutral spine. Hold for 5 seconds while gently resisting the band, then release.

transverse-abdominis-engagement.name: Transverse Abdominis Engagement
transverse-abdominis-engagement.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Place your hands on your lower abdomen below the navel.
transverse-abdominis-engagement.endPoseDescription: Inhale to prepare, then exhale while drawing the lower abdominal wall inward and upward toward the spine. Hold this contraction for 5 seconds while breathing normally, then relax.

resistance-band-clamshells.name: Resistance Band Clamshells
resistance-band-clamshells.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Stack your hips and keep your feet together with knees bent at 45 degrees.
resistance-band-clamshells.endPoseDescription: Keeping feet together, open the top knee against the band resistance while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Squeeze the outer glute and hip at the top, then slowly close.

seated-cat-cow-stretch.name: Seated Cat-Cow Stretch
seated-cat-cow-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands placed behind the head or crossed over chest. Engage your core lightly.
seated-cat-cow-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently arch the back and lift the chest forward while looking slightly upward, then reverse by rounding the spine and tucking the chin. Move slowly between positions.

bridge-hold.name: Bridge Hold
bridge-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.
bridge-hold.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees through shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining core engagement.

modified-dumbbell-chest-press.name: Modified Dumbbell Chest Press
modified-dumbbell-chest-press.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and dumbbells held at chest level with elbows at 90 degrees. Keep your lower back neutral against the mat.
modified-dumbbell-chest-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until arms are nearly straight, maintaining a slight bend in the elbows. Lower controlled with tension in the chest and core.

quadruped-rocking.name: Quadruped Rocking
quadruped-rocking.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders, knees under hips, and a neutral spine. Engage your core lightly to stabilize your position.
quadruped-rocking.endPoseDescription: Gently rock your hips backward toward your heels while keeping hands in place, feeling a stretch through your back and hips. Hold the stretch and return to center.
conditions_seen_in: chef lower back and plantar fascia pain
lumbar disc herniation return to golf

glute-squeeze-with-dumbbell.name: Glute Squeeze with Dumbbell
glute-squeeze-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
glute-squeeze-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Perform a small squat by bending knees slightly, then powerfully squeeze your glutes as you return to standing, pressing through your heels. Contract your glutes maximally at the top.

supported-wall-push-up.name: Supported Wall Push-Up
supported-wall-push-up.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall about 18 inches away with feet hip-width apart and hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
supported-wall-push-up.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the wall in a controlled manner, then push through your palms to return to start. Maintain core engagement throughout the movement.

pelvic-floor-relaxation-breathing.name: Pelvic Floor Relaxation Breathing
pelvic-floor-relaxation-breathing.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place one hand on your chest and one on your lower abdomen.
pelvic-floor-relaxation-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale through your nose for 4 counts, allowing your abdomen to expand and pelvic floor to relax downward. Exhale slowly for 6 counts, maintaining relaxation without clenching.

deep-abdominal-engagement.name: Deep Abdominal Engagement
deep-abdominal-engagement.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands resting on your lower abdomen. Breathe normally and relax your abdominal muscles.
deep-abdominal-engagement.endPoseDescription: Exhale and gently draw your lower abdomen inward as if pulling your navel toward your spine, without holding your breath. Maintain this gentle engagement for 5-10 seconds while breathing freely.

supine-pelvic-floor-engagement.name: Supine Pelvic Floor Engagement
supine-pelvic-floor-engagement.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back on a firm surface with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep arms at your sides with palms down.
supine-pelvic-floor-engagement.endPoseDescription: While maintaining pelvic floor contractions, gently press your lower back toward the floor and hold for 3-5 seconds. Release both the pelvic floor and back press, then rest before repeating.

seated-marching-pelvic-floor.name: Seated Marching with Pelvic Floor Activation
seated-marching-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your thighs. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
seated-marching-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest while simultaneously contracting your pelvic floor muscles. Lower the leg while releasing, then alternate sides in a controlled marching motion.

glute-bridge-pelvic-floor.name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Squeeze
glute-bridge-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet about 12 inches from your buttocks.
glute-bridge-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while squeezing your glutes and pelvic floor muscles simultaneously. Hold at the top for 2-3 seconds, maintaining even weight distribution across both feet.

deep-abdominal-breathing.name: Deep Abdominal Breathing
deep-abdominal-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with feet flat on the floor and one hand on your chest and one on your abdomen. Maintain relaxed shoulders and neutral spine.
deep-abdominal-breathing.endPoseDescription: Slowly inhale through your nose, feeling your abdomen expand while keeping your chest still. Exhale slowly through your mouth while gently engaging your deep abdominal muscles and pelvic floor.

standing-calf-raises-pelvic-floor.name: Standing Calf Raises with Pelvic Floor Engagement
standing-calf-raises-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a sturdy chair or wall for light support and balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
standing-calf-raises-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet while simultaneously contracting your pelvic floor muscles for 2-3 seconds. Lower your heels back down with control while releasing the pelvic floor contraction.

quadriceps-sets-pelvic-floor.name: Quadriceps Sets with Pelvic Floor Activation
quadriceps-sets-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg extended flat and the other knee slightly bent with foot flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the extended leg's knee if needed.
quadriceps-sets-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Tighten the thigh muscle of the extended leg by straightening the knee fully while simultaneously engaging pelvic floor muscles. Hold the contraction for 3-5 seconds, then release both the quad and pelvic floor.

seated-hip-flexor-engagement.name: Seated Hip Flexor Engagement
seated-hip-flexor-engagement.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture maintained with shoulders back. Keep both hands resting on your thighs.
seated-hip-flexor-engagement.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee slightly off the chair while contracting your pelvic floor and maintaining upright posture. Hold briefly, then lower back down with control before switching sides.

pelvic-floor-kegel.name: Pelvic Floor Activation - Kegel Exercise
pelvic-floor-kegel.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable position with feet flat on the floor. Relax all muscles and take a deep breath to center yourself.
pelvic-floor-kegel.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles by squeezing as if stopping the flow of urine, hold for 3-5 seconds, then fully relax. Feel the muscles engage and release with each repetition.

happy-baby-stretch.name: Happy Baby Stretch
happy-baby-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bring one or both knees toward your chest, grasping the shins or behind the thighs.
happy-baby-stretch.endPoseDescription: Hold both knees toward your chest while keeping your lower back flat on the ground, allowing the hips and pelvic floor to relax deeply. Breathe slowly and allow gravity to deepen the stretch.

glute-bridge-pelvic.name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Engagement
glute-bridge-pelvic.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Engage your core and prepare to activate your pelvic floor.
glute-bridge-pelvic.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while engaging the pelvic floor muscles. Hold the bridge position with glutes and pelvic floor engaged for 2-3 seconds before lowering.

supported-deep-squat.name: Supported Deep Squat
supported-deep-squat.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on the wall for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
supported-deep-squat.endPoseDescription: Lower into a deep squat position with weight in your heels, allowing your pelvic floor and hip muscles to open and relax. Hold this stretch while maintaining balance with your hands on the support.

supine-butterfly-stretch.name: Supine Butterfly Stretch
supine-butterfly-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides. Rest your arms at your sides with palms up.
supine-butterfly-stretch.endPoseDescription: Allow gravity to gently open your hips and inner thighs while your lower back remains relaxed on the ground. Breathe deeply and hold this restorative stretch to release pelvic floor tension.

prone-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Prone Hip Flexor Stretch
prone-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders. One leg should be bent with knee toward your glute, while the other extends behind you.
prone-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Press your hips gently into the ground to deepen the stretch in the extended leg's hip flexor and quadriceps. Hold this stretch while breathing steadily to release tension in the pelvic region.
conditions_seen_in: chef lower back and plantar fascia pain

gaze-stabilization-horizontal.name: Gaze Stabilization - Horizontal
gaze-stabilization-horizontal.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your head still and relaxed.
gaze-stabilization-horizontal.endPoseDescription: Slowly move your head side to side while keeping your eyes fixed on the same point. Your head moves but your gaze remains locked on the target.

gaze-stabilization-vertical.name: Gaze Stabilization - Vertical
gaze-stabilization-vertical.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level. Maintain a neutral head position.
gaze-stabilization-vertical.endPoseDescription: Slowly move your head up and down while keeping your eyes locked on the same fixed point. Your head follows a vertical path but your gaze stays steady.

heel-toe-taps.name: Heel-Toe Taps
heel-toe-taps.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides or on a countertop for light support. Look straight ahead.
heel-toe-taps.endPoseDescription: Rapidly tap your heels on the ground while keeping your toes elevated, then alternate by tapping your toes while heels stay down. Maintain a steady rhythm for the duration of the exercise.

vestibular-walk.name: Vestibular Walk
vestibular-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with proper posture and arms at your sides. Choose a clear walking path in front of you.
vestibular-walk.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly while keeping your eyes focused on a fixed point at eye level ahead. Maintain steady, controlled steps and upright posture throughout the walk.

quadruped-head-turns.name: Quadruped Head Turns
quadruped-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with shoulders stacked over wrists and hips over knees. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to look over your shoulder toward one hip. Hold briefly before returning to center and repeating on the opposite side.

balance-ball-sitting.name: Balance Ball Sitting
balance-ball-sitting.startPoseDescription: Sit on a balance/stability ball with feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart. Maintain an upright posture with neutral spine alignment.
balance-ball-sitting.endPoseDescription: Hold the seated position on the ball while engaging your core to maintain stability. Keep your shoulders relaxed and look straight ahead.

seated-marching-head-turns.name: Seated Marching with Head Turns
seated-marching-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Keep your head facing forward with arms relaxed at your sides.
seated-marching-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest while simultaneously turning your head to look over the opposite shoulder. Alternate legs with each head turn.

standing-balance-resistance-band.name: Standing Balance with Resistance Band
standing-balance-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Hands can be on hips or extended forward.
standing-balance-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Slightly bend your knees while maintaining tension on the band and shift your weight onto one leg. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

neck-flexion-extension-band.name: Neck Flexion and Extension with Band
neck-flexion-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around the back of your head and held in both hands at chest level. Keep your shoulders relaxed.
neck-flexion-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band forward to flex your neck, bringing your chin toward your chest. Release and return to neutral position, moving slowly and controlled.

quadruped-alternating-limb-raises.name: Quadruped Alternating Limb Raises
quadruped-alternating-limb-raises.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-alternating-limb-raises.endPoseDescription: Extend your right arm forward and left leg backward to form a straight line with your body. Hold for 2 seconds, return to start, and repeat on the opposite side.

supine-head-turns-stabilization.name: Supine Head Turns with Stabilization
supine-head-turns-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest your arms at your sides with eyes focused on the ceiling.
supine-head-turns-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side, keeping your eyes open and focused. Pause briefly, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

seated-shoulder-rolls-band.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls with Band Resistance
seated-shoulder-rolls-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a resistance band held taut across your shoulders at mid-chest height, hands gripping the band at shoulder width. Keep your core engaged.
seated-shoulder-rolls-band.endPoseDescription: Roll your shoulders backward against the band resistance while maintaining tension. Complete the circular motion and return to start, focusing on smooth controlled movement.

standing-single-leg-stance-band.name: Standing Single-Leg Stance with Band Support
standing-single-leg-stance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or sturdy surface with a resistance band looped around a post at waist height for light support. Feet are together.
standing-single-leg-stance-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg slightly off the ground and balance on the standing leg while maintaining light contact with the band. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

prone-neck-isometric-hold.name: Prone Neck Isometric Hold
prone-neck-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and forehead resting on a towel. Engage your core to stabilize your spine.
prone-neck-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Gently lift your head and neck slightly off the ground, creating a neutral alignment with your spine. Hold this position for 5-10 seconds without strain, then relax and repeat.

head-turns-fixed-gaze.name: Head Turns with Fixed Gaze
head-turns-fixed-gaze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your head in a neutral position and your eyes focused on a fixed point at eye level. Keep your shoulders relaxed and facing forward.
head-turns-fixed-gaze.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head left and right while maintaining your gaze on the fixed point. Your eyes should stay locked on the target as your head rotates.

standing-weight-shifts.name: Standing Weight Shifts
standing-weight-shifts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides or lightly touching a counter for light support if needed. Look straight ahead and maintain an upright posture.
standing-weight-shifts.endPoseDescription: Shift your body weight slowly to one side, feeling the pressure increase through that foot. Return to center and shift to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

seated-head-nods.name: Seated Head Nods
seated-head-nods.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your head in neutral position and eyes looking forward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your back supported by the chair.
seated-head-nods.endPoseDescription: Slowly nod your head up and down in a gentle, controlled motion. Move only your head while keeping your shoulders still and your gaze forward.

standing-figure-eight-walking.name: Standing Figure 8 Walking
standing-figure-eight-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture and eyes focused on a point ahead. Identify a space where you can walk a figure-8 pattern slowly, staying near a wall or furniture for safety.
standing-figure-eight-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk a slow figure-8 pattern, turning your head and body naturally with the movement. Keep your movements controlled and deliberate, maintaining focus on your path.

seated-eye-circles.name: Seated Eye Circles
seated-eye-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your head still and neutral, eyes open and facing forward. Keep your neck relaxed and shoulders in a neutral position.
seated-eye-circles.endPoseDescription: Move your eyes in slow, smooth circles clockwise and counterclockwise. Keep your head completely still while tracing an imaginary circle with your eyes only.

scapular-stabilization-dumbbells.name: Scapular Stabilization with Dumbbells
scapular-stabilization-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
scapular-stabilization-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, squeezing the trapezius muscles, then slowly lower back down. Maintain neutral spine throughout the movement.

prone-shoulder-ytw.name: Prone Shoulder Y-T-W
prone-shoulder-ytw.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or elevated surface with arms hanging down on either side. Rest your forehead on a towel to maintain neutral cervical spine.
prone-shoulder-ytw.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms in Y, T, and W positions sequentially, engaging upper back muscles. Return to starting position between each variation with controlled movement.

gaze-stabilization-exercise.name: Gaze Stabilization Exercise
gaze-stabilization-exercise.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a target (finger or object) at eye level 12 inches away. Keep your head still initially.
gaze-stabilization-exercise.endPoseDescription: Keep your eyes fixed on the target while slowly moving your head side to side in a controlled manner. Maintain focus on the target throughout the movement.

upper-back-dumbbell-rows.name: Upper Back Dumbbell Rows
upper-back-dumbbell-rows.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
upper-back-dumbbell-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower with control while maintaining neutral cervical spine.

proprioceptive-head-tracking.name: Proprioceptive Head Tracking
proprioceptive-head-tracking.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with arms at your sides. Focus on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.
proprioceptive-head-tracking.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to look at objects in different directions while standing on one leg. Return to center and switch legs to challenge proprioception.

seated-dumbbell-press.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
seated-dumbbell-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells held at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain neutral spinal alignment and engage your core.
seated-dumbbell-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner without arching your lower back. Lower back to shoulder height with control.

gaze-stabilization-x1.name: Gaze Stabilization - X1 (Visual Fixation)
gaze-stabilization-x1.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing forward with a fixed target (letter or object) at eye level on a wall about 3 feet away. Keep your head still and focus on the target.
gaze-stabilization-x1.endPoseDescription: Maintain steady visual fixation on the target while your head remains completely stationary. Your eyes should not move from the target point.

gaze-stabilization-head-turns.name: Gaze Stabilization - Head Turns (VOR Exercise)
gaze-stabilization-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, facing a fixed target at eye level on the wall. Hold your gaze on the target with your head in neutral position.
gaze-stabilization-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head side to side (approximately 30 degrees each direction) while maintaining visual focus on the target. Keep your eyes fixed on the target as your head moves.

balance-walk-tandem-stance.name: Balance Walk - Tandem Stance
balance-walk-tandem-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, with arms out to the sides for balance. Keep your gaze forward on a fixed point.
balance-walk-tandem-stance.endPoseDescription: Maintain the tandem stance (one foot in front of the other) for 20-30 seconds without losing balance. Focus on a fixed visual target to help stabilize your position.

single-leg-stance-dynamic.name: Single Leg Stance - Dynamic
single-leg-stance-dynamic.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with the other knee lifted to hip height, with hands on your hips or extended to the sides for balance. Keep your focus on a fixed point ahead.
single-leg-stance-dynamic.endPoseDescription: Hold the single-leg stance for 20-30 seconds while maintaining upright posture and a fixed gaze. Your standing leg should be slightly bent at the knee for stability.

treadmill-walking-progressive.name: Treadmill Walking - Progressive Speed
treadmill-walking-progressive.startPoseDescription: Stand on a treadmill at a slow comfortable walking speed (2-3 mph) with hands lightly on the rails. Focus your gaze straight ahead at eye level.
treadmill-walking-progressive.endPoseDescription: Gradually increase the treadmill speed to a brisk walking pace (3.5-4.5 mph) while maintaining forward gaze. Maintain upright posture and stable head position throughout.

quadruped-rocking-head-turns.name: Quadruped Rocking - Head Turns
quadruped-rocking-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Get on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Look down at the floor between your hands.
quadruped-rocking-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Rock your body backward toward your heels while slowly turning your head to look over your shoulder, then return to center. Alternate head turns with each rocking motion.

standing-head-tilts-visual.name: Standing Head Tilts - Visual Focus
standing-head-tilts-visual.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart facing a fixed target at eye level on the wall. Keep your body still and focus intently on the target.
standing-head-tilts-visual.endPoseDescription: Slowly tilt your head to one side (ear toward shoulder) while keeping your eyes focused on the fixed target, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

sit-to-stand-head-turns.name: Sit-to-Stand - Head Turns
sit-to-stand-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor hip-width apart and hands crossed over your chest. Look straight ahead.
sit-to-stand-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Stand up from the chair while simultaneously turning your head to one side, then sit back down and repeat on the opposite side. Maintain controlled movement throughout.

tandem-walk-heel-toe.name: Tandem Walk - Heel to Toe
tandem-walk-heel-toe.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, ready to walk in a straight line with one foot placed directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe pattern. Keep arms out to the sides for balance.
tandem-walk-heel-toe.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly in a tandem stance, placing the heel of one foot directly in front of the toes of the other foot. Maintain focus on a fixed point ahead while walking.

horizontal-head-turns-with-focus.name: Horizontal Head Turns with Focus
horizontal-head-turns-with-focus.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Fix your gaze on a target object at eye level directly in front of you.
horizontal-head-turns-with-focus.endPoseDescription: Turn your head slowly to one side while keeping your eyes focused on the target as long as possible before following with your eyes. Return to center and repeat to the opposite side.

vertical-head-nods-with-fixation.name: Vertical Head Nods with Fixation
vertical-head-nods-with-fixation.startPoseDescription: Stand with good posture, feet hip-width apart, looking straight ahead at a focal point. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.
vertical-head-nods-with-fixation.endPoseDescription: Slowly nod your head up and down while maintaining focus on a fixed point on the wall. Move through a comfortable range of motion.

diagonal-gaze-shifts.name: Diagonal Gaze Shifts
diagonal-gaze-shifts.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your head in neutral position. Focus on a target straight ahead at eye level.
diagonal-gaze-shifts.endPoseDescription: Shift your gaze diagonally to upper-right, then lower-left in a smooth, controlled manner. Alternate directions and repeat for the prescribed repetitions.

band-resisted-head-stabilization.name: Band-Resisted Head Stabilization
band-resisted-head-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place a resistance band around your head at forehead level, holding both ends behind your head. Maintain neutral head position with eyes focused forward.
band-resisted-head-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Apply gentle resistance with your hands while keeping your head perfectly still and your gaze fixed on a target. Hold for 5 seconds then release.

standing-gaze-stability-with-head-moveme.name: Standing Gaze Stability with Head Movement
standing-gaze-stability-with-head-moveme.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, eyes focused on a target at eye level. Keep your arms at your sides or slightly out for balance.
standing-gaze-stability-with-head-moveme.endPoseDescription: Move your head in slow circles while maintaining continuous focus on a fixed target. Keep your gaze locked on the target as your head rotates around it.

band-assisted-neck-isometric-with-gaze-h.name: Band-Assisted Neck Isometric with Gaze Hold
band-assisted-neck-isometric-with-gaze-h.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around your head, anchoring it to your hands positioned at shoulder height. Fix your eyes on a point directly ahead.
band-assisted-neck-isometric-with-gaze-h.endPoseDescription: Gently push your head against the band resistance while keeping your gaze perfectly stable on the target. Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

x-pattern-gaze-tracking.name: X-Pattern Gaze Tracking
x-pattern-gaze-tracking.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with an X-pattern drawn or imagined on it. Position yourself at a comfortable viewing distance with your gaze at the center.
x-pattern-gaze-tracking.endPoseDescription: Smoothly move your eyes along each line of the X pattern from center outward and back. Keep your head still while only your eyes move.

tandem-stance-gaze-stabilization.name: Tandem Stance Gaze Stabilization
tandem-stance-gaze-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Stand in a tandem stance (one foot directly in front of the other) with arms out for balance. Focus your gaze on a fixed target at eye level.
tandem-stance-gaze-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Maintain the challenging balance position while keeping your eyes locked on the target and slowly turning your head side to side. Keep gaze stable throughout.

seated-head-turns.name: Seated Head Turns
seated-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes focused straight ahead.
seated-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side, bringing your chin toward your shoulder without forcing it. Hold briefly and return to center.

standing-single-leg-stance.name: Standing Single-Leg Stance
standing-single-leg-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart near a wall or sturdy chair for safety support. Keep your arms ready to grasp support if needed.
standing-single-leg-stance.endPoseDescription: Shift your weight onto one leg and lift the opposite foot slightly off the ground, maintaining an upright posture. Keep your eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
conditions_seen_in: mild traumatic brain injury return to activity

seated-deep-breathing.name: Seated Deep Breathing
seated-deep-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed down and back. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
seated-deep-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply through your nose, feeling your belly expand, then exhale slowly through your mouth. Focus on controlled, intentional breathing.
conditions_seen_in: mild traumatic brain injury return to activity

seated-eye-tracking.name: Seated Eye Tracking
seated-eye-tracking.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and head still, focusing straight ahead. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.
seated-eye-tracking.endPoseDescription: Slowly move your eyes to follow an imaginary point in different directions (up, down, left, right, diagonals) without moving your head. Track smoothly and controlled.
conditions_seen_in: mild traumatic brain injury return to activity

seated-quad-sets.name: Seated Quad Sets
seated-quad-sets.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your back against the chair for support.
seated-quad-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on one leg by straightening it, lifting the heel slightly off the ground. Hold briefly, then relax and repeat on the opposite leg.

standing-marching-head-stability.name: Standing Marching with Head Stability
standing-marching-head-stability.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Keep your gaze fixed on a point at eye level directly ahead of you.
standing-marching-head-stability.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up to hip height while maintaining a steady gaze and upright posture. Keep your head still and level throughout the movement.

seated-head-turns-fixation.name: Seated Head Turns with Fixation
seated-head-turns-fixation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Look straight ahead at a fixed point.
seated-head-turns-fixation.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side while keeping your eyes focused on a stationary object at eye level. Hold the position for 2-3 seconds before returning to center.

dumbbell-squats-visual-focus.name: Dumbbell Squats with Visual Focus
dumbbell-squats-visual-focus.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Fix your gaze on a stable point ahead at eye level.
dumbbell-squats-visual-focus.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees while maintaining your forward gaze and keeping your chest upright. Push through your heels to return to standing position.

bird-dog-stability-hold.name: Bird Dog with Stability Hold
bird-dog-stability-hold.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your head in a neutral position looking down at the floor.
bird-dog-stability-hold.endPoseDescription: Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg backward until both are parallel to the floor. Maintain a level spine and neutral head position, holding for 2-3 seconds.

dumbbell-farmers-carry-head-level.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry with Head Level
dumbbell-farmers-carry-head-level.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a firm grip. Keep your head level and your gaze focused straight ahead.
dumbbell-farmers-carry-head-level.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and steady gaze. Keep your shoulders level and your core engaged throughout the walk.

seated-neck-flexion-extension.name: Seated Neck Flexion and Extension
seated-neck-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back straight and your gaze directed ahead. Keep your shoulders relaxed and stationary.
seated-neck-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, then gently tilt your head back to look toward the ceiling. Move within a comfortable range without forcing the motion.

standing-dumbbell-rows-stability.name: Standing Dumbbell Rows with Stability
standing-dumbbell-rows-stability.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended down in front of you. Maintain an upright posture with your gaze fixed ahead.
standing-dumbbell-rows-stability.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your core engaged and your head level throughout the movement.

gentle-jaw-opening-tongue-palate.name: Gentle Jaw Opening with Tongue on Palate
gentle-jaw-opening-tongue-palate.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your back against a chair and shoulders relaxed. Place your tongue on the roof of your mouth behind your upper front teeth.
gentle-jaw-opening-tongue-palate.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth about 1-2 inches while keeping your tongue pressed against the palate. Hold this position for 2-3 seconds without straining.

resisted-jaw-opening-band.name: Resisted Jaw Opening with Resistance Band
resisted-jaw-opening-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and loop a light resistance band around your chin. Hold the ends of the band with both hands at chest level with slight tension.
resisted-jaw-opening-band.endPoseDescription: Gently open your mouth against the band resistance for 2-3 seconds. Return slowly to the starting position without closing your teeth completely.

lateral-jaw-glide.name: Lateral Jaw Glide Exercise
lateral-jaw-glide.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth lightly touching in neutral position. Place your index finger on your chin for guidance.
lateral-jaw-glide.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your lower jaw to one side 1-2 centimeters without opening your mouth. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

neck-stretch-gentle-rotation.name: Neck Stretching with Gentle Rotation
neck-stretch-gentle-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your jaw relaxed with teeth slightly apart.
neck-stretch-gentle-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder, dropping your chin slightly. Hold the gentle stretch for 15-20 seconds and feel the tension in your neck muscles.

submental-isometric.name: Submental Isometric Exercise
submental-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place your index and middle fingers under your chin. Keep your mouth closed with teeth lightly touching.
submental-isometric.endPoseDescription: Press your chin downward against your fingers while resisting with your hand, creating an isometric contraction. Hold for 5 seconds without moving your jaw.

shoulder-shrugs-relaxation.name: Shoulder Shrugs and Relaxation
shoulder-shrugs-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms at your sides and shoulders relaxed. Keep your neck neutral and jaw unclenched.
shoulder-shrugs-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Raise both shoulders toward your ears, hold for 2 seconds, then drop them down quickly while exhaling. Repeat 10 times to release tension.

tongue-strengthening.name: Tongue Strengthening Exercise
tongue-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed and teeth together lightly. Position your tongue tip against the roof of your mouth.
tongue-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Press your tongue firmly against the hard palate while holding your mouth closed. Maintain firm pressure for 5-10 seconds then relax.

jaw-relaxation-opening.name: Jaw Relaxation and Gentle Opening
jaw-relaxation-opening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Allow your mouth to close gently with teeth slightly apart.
jaw-relaxation-opening.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth 1-2 inches without forcing, keeping tension-free. Hold briefly before returning to starting position.

neck-isometric-band.name: Neck Isometric with Band Support
neck-isometric-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head at ear level. Hold both ends of the band with your hands near your temples.
neck-isometric-band.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head forward against the band resistance without moving, maintaining tension for 5-10 seconds while keeping jaw relaxed.

shoulder-shrugs-band.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Band
shoulder-shrugs-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band under both feet. Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
shoulder-shrugs-band.endPoseDescription: Lift both shoulders toward your ears against the band resistance, hold briefly, then lower back down with control.

lateral-neck-stretch.name: Lateral Neck Stretch
lateral-neck-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your gaze forward with both feet flat on the floor.
lateral-neck-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a mild stretch along the left side of your neck. Hold without bouncing.

resisted-jaw-closure.name: Resisted Jaw Closure
resisted-jaw-closure.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open. Place your index finger gently under your chin.
resisted-jaw-closure.endPoseDescription: Apply light downward resistance with your finger while slowly closing your mouth, engaging the jaw muscles without clenching.

upper-back-extension-band.name: Upper Back Extension with Band
upper-back-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and wrap a resistance band around a fixed point at chest height. Hold both ends with arms extended forward.
upper-back-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, maintaining upright posture and relaxed jaw throughout.

forehead-wrinkle.name: Forehead Wrinkle Exercise
forehead-wrinkle.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your face relaxed and looking straight ahead. Keep your eyebrows in their natural resting position.
forehead-wrinkle.endPoseDescription: Raise your eyebrows as high as possible, creating horizontal wrinkles across your forehead. Hold this position while maintaining the contraction in the forehead muscles.

eye-closure-blinking.name: Eye Closure and Blinking
eye-closure-blinking.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with eyes open, looking straight ahead in a relaxed manner. Keep your face still and avoid any compensatory movements.
eye-closure-blinking.endPoseDescription: Slowly close both eyes as tightly as possible, squinting hard to engage the orbicularis oculi muscles. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds before slowly releasing.

smile-mouth-closed.name: Smile with Mouth Closed
smile-mouth-closed.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed and lips together in a neutral position. Your face should be completely relaxed.
smile-mouth-closed.endPoseDescription: Draw the corners of your mouth upward into a gentle smile while keeping your lips closed. Try to engage both sides of your face equally, noting any asymmetry.

mouth-opening.name: Mouth Opening Exercise
mouth-opening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and face relaxed. Keep your jaw in a neutral position without tension.
mouth-opening.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth as wide as comfortable, dropping your jaw downward and feeling the stretch across your lower face. Hold briefly and return to the starting position.

cheek-puff.name: Cheek Puff Exercise
cheek-puff.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed and cheeks in their natural relaxed state. Keep your lips sealed but not pressed tightly together.
cheek-puff.endPoseDescription: Inhale through your nose and puff out both cheeks with air, stretching the buccinator muscles. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release the air through pursed lips.

lip-rounding.name: Lip Rounding Exercise
lip-rounding.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth relaxed and lips in a neutral position. Your face should be calm with no tension in the perioral muscles.
lip-rounding.endPoseDescription: Round your lips as if saying the letter 'O', bringing them forward and together in a tight pucker. Focus on engaging the orbicularis oris muscle symmetrically on both sides.

neck-rom-turns.name: Neck ROM - Gentle Turns
neck-rom-turns.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and head facing forward. Keep your shoulders still throughout the movement.
neck-rom-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side as far as comfortable, looking over your shoulder. Hold briefly, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

dumbbell-reverse-flyes.name: Dumbbell Reverse Flyes
dumbbell-reverse-flyes.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine.
dumbbell-reverse-flyes.endPoseDescription: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until your arms are parallel to the ground. Squeeze your rear shoulder muscles at the top of the movement.

neck-lateral-flexion-stretch.name: Neck Lateral Flexion Stretch
neck-lateral-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Your head is in neutral position facing forward.
neck-lateral-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch along the left side of your neck. Your opposite shoulder remains relaxed and down.

tmj-mobilization.name: Temporomandibular Joint Mobilization
tmj-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed and jaw relaxed. Place your index and middle fingers on your chin.
tmj-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth while gently pressing downward on your chin with your fingers, creating gentle resistance. Move through a comfortable range of motion without pain.

prone-cobra-hold.name: Prone Cobra Hold
prone-cobra-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a mat with your palms flat under your shoulders and legs extended behind you. Your forehead is gently resting on the mat.
prone-cobra-hold.endPoseDescription: Push through your hands to lift your chest off the ground while keeping your pelvis on the mat and neck in neutral alignment. Your gaze remains downward to maintain cervical spine safety.

seated-resistance-band-rows.name: Seated Resistance Band Rows
seated-resistance-band-rows.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with legs extended in front of you and a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with both hands at chest level, maintaining good posture with shoulders back.
seated-resistance-band-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your torso by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows close to your body. Hold briefly at the chest, feeling the contraction in your back muscles.

standing-lateral-band-walks.name: Standing Lateral Band Walks
standing-lateral-band-walks.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Keep feet hip-width apart with a slight bend in your knees and hands on your hips.
standing-lateral-band-walks.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side, maintaining tension on the band and keeping knees slightly bent. Your torso remains upright as you take controlled steps sideways.

supine-glute-bridge-with-band.name: Supine Glute Bridge with Band
supine-glute-bridge-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
supine-glute-bridge-with-band.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders while maintaining band tension. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.

seated-shoulder-press-with-band.name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
seated-shoulder-press-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band anchored under both feet. Hold the band ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward.
seated-shoulder-press-with-band.endPoseDescription: Press the band upward and slightly forward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining core stability. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

seated-upper-back-stretch-with-band.name: Seated Upper Back Stretch with Band
seated-upper-back-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and hold a resistance band at arm's length in front of you with hands shoulder-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
seated-upper-back-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band apart while rounding your upper back slightly, feeling a stretch across your shoulders and upper back. Hold this position while maintaining steady breathing.

standing-hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch with Band
standing-hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the opposite end. Keep your core engaged and maintain upright posture.
standing-hip-flexor-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your foot toward your glute using the band, feeling a stretch along the front of your hip and thigh. Keep your knee pointing downward and avoid arching your lower back.

seated-torso-rotation-with-band.name: Seated Torso Rotation with Band
seated-torso-rotation-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a slight forward lean and hold both ends of a resistance band at chest height. Keep your feet flat on the floor and maintain a neutral spine.
seated-torso-rotation-with-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band in front of you while keeping your hips stable. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side for controlled rotational movement.

standing-bicep-curls-with-band.name: Standing Bicep Curls with Band
standing-bicep-curls-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band under both feet. Hold the band ends with palms facing forward and arms extended at your sides.
standing-bicep-curls-with-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and curl the band upward toward your shoulders, keeping upper arms stationary and maintaining good posture. Lower back to starting position with control.

seated-quadriceps-strengthener-with-band.name: Seated Quadriceps Strengthener with Band
seated-quadriceps-strengthener-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep the other foot flat on the floor and maintain upright posture.
seated-quadriceps-strengthener-with-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten the leg with the band by extending your knee fully, tightening your quadriceps muscle. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

seated-torso-rotation.name: Seated Torso Rotation
seated-torso-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart. Cross your arms over your chest with hands touching opposite shoulders.
seated-torso-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, turning your shoulders and upper back while keeping hips facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

neck-flexion-extension.name: Neck Flexion and Extension
neck-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and spine neutral.
neck-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, then gently lift your gaze upward while extending the neck. Move in a controlled manner through the full range.
conditions_seen_in: musician violinist neck and shoulder pain
dentist upper back and neck strain

big-arm-circles.name: Big Arm Circles
big-arm-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
big-arm-circles.endPoseDescription: Make large circular motions with both arms moving forward in exaggerated, expansive circles. Complete full rotations with maximum range of motion, then reverse direction.

big-steps-forward.name: Big Steps Forward
big-steps-forward.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or holding light dumbbells. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged.
