big-steps-forward.endPoseDescription: Take an exaggerated large step forward, bending the front knee deeply while keeping the back knee nearly touching the ground. Step forward with purposeful, high-amplitude movements.

big-backward-steps.name: Big Backward Steps
big-backward-steps.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing forward with feet together and arms at your sides. Keep your core tight and posture tall.
big-backward-steps.endPoseDescription: Take deliberate, large steps backward with exaggerated knee bending and hip extension. Emphasize the backward reach and amplitude of each step.

big-arm-raises-dumbbells.name: Big Arm Raises with Dumbbells
big-arm-raises-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Maintain upright posture with engaged core.
big-arm-raises-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead with a powerful, exaggerated movement, fully extending the arms above the head. Lower with control back to shoulder height.

big-trunk-rotations.name: Big Trunk Rotations
big-trunk-rotations.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms crossed over chest or extended out to sides. Maintain upright posture with slight knee bend.
big-trunk-rotations.endPoseDescription: Rotate the torso maximally to one side with a big, exaggerated turning motion, then return to center. Alternate sides with full range of motion rotations.

big-sit-to-stand-dumbbells.name: Big Sit-to-Stand with Dumbbells
big-sit-to-stand-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a sturdy chair holding dumbbells at shoulder height, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Lean slightly forward from the hips.
big-sit-to-stand-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Stand up with an exaggerated, powerful movement using leg and hip extension, fully extending the knees and hips. Lower back down with control.

big-lateral-reaches-dumbbells.name: Big Lateral Reaches with Dumbbells
big-lateral-reaches-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout.
big-lateral-reaches-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Reach the dumbbell laterally and overhead in a large, sweeping arc, fully extending the arm across and upward. Return to starting position and repeat on the other side.

sit-to-stand-transfer.name: Sit-to-Stand Transfer
sit-to-stand-transfer.startPoseDescription: Patient sits upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Hands are placed on the seat beside the hips for support.
sit-to-stand-transfer.endPoseDescription: Patient stands fully upright with knees extended and hips neutral, maintaining balance without hand support if possible. Weight is evenly distributed through both legs.
conditions_seen_in: post-stroke lower extremity gait training (6 months)

supine-hip-flexion-march.name: Supine Hip Flexion March
supine-hip-flexion-march.startPoseDescription: Patient lies on their back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Arms are at the sides with palms down for stability.
supine-hip-flexion-march.endPoseDescription: Patient alternately lifts one knee toward the chest in a marching motion while keeping the opposite foot on the floor. Movement is controlled and rhythmic with the core engaged throughout.
conditions_seen_in: post-stroke lower extremity gait training (6 months)

prone-knee-extension.name: Prone Knee Extension
prone-knee-extension.startPoseDescription: Patient lies face-down on a mat with hips flat and arms folded under the forehead for comfort. The affected leg is bent with the knee at 90 degrees.
prone-knee-extension.endPoseDescription: Patient straightens the affected leg by extending the knee fully while keeping the hip on the mat. The leg is held briefly at full extension before slowly returning to the bent position.
conditions_seen_in: post-stroke lower extremity gait training (6 months)

seated-dorsiflexion.name: Seated Dorsiflexion
seated-dorsiflexion.startPoseDescription: Patient sits upright in a firm chair with both feet flat on the floor. The affected leg remains relaxed with the foot resting naturally on the floor.
seated-dorsiflexion.endPoseDescription: Patient pulls the toes toward the shin, flexing the ankle joint while keeping the heel on the floor. The movement is slow and controlled, activating the anterior tibialis muscle.
conditions_seen_in: post-stroke lower extremity gait training (6 months)

treadmill-gait-training.name: Treadmill Gait Training
treadmill-gait-training.startPoseDescription: Patient stands on a treadmill with feet hip-width apart, holding the handrails lightly for balance and safety. The machine is set at a slow speed appropriate for the patient's function level.
treadmill-gait-training.endPoseDescription: Patient walks at a controlled pace with normalized gait pattern, focusing on symmetrical weight distribution and smooth step-over mechanics. Posture is upright and stride length is consistent throughout the duration.
conditions_seen_in: post-stroke lower extremity gait training (6 months)

seated-hip-flexor-band.name: Seated Hip Flexor Strengthening with Band
seated-hip-flexor-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot while holding the other end in both hands.
seated-hip-flexor-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded leg upward, bringing the knee toward the chest against the band resistance. Hold briefly at the top of the movement with controlled tension.

quadriceps-sets-band.name: Quadriceps Sets with Band Isometric Hold
quadriceps-sets-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with a small rolled towel under one knee. Loop a resistance band around the thigh just above the knee for added resistance.
quadriceps-sets-band.endPoseDescription: Tighten the thigh muscle and press the back of the knee into the towel, straightening the leg. Hold the contraction for 5 seconds against the band tension.

supine-hip-bridge.name: Supine Hip Bridge Hold
supine-hip-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Place a resistance band above the knees for added engagement.
supine-hip-bridge.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, engaging the glutes and core. Hold the bridge position while keeping the band tensioned between the knees.

seated-hamstring-curl-band.name: Seated Hamstring Curl with Band
seated-hamstring-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands.
seated-hamstring-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Curl the banded leg backward, bringing the heel toward the glute against the band resistance. Maintain an upright seated position throughout the movement.

standing-single-leg-balance-band.name: Standing Single Leg Balance with Band
standing-single-leg-balance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or support surface with hands lightly on the support. Anchor a resistance band at waist height for added stability if needed.
standing-single-leg-balance-band.endPoseDescription: Shift weight to one leg and lift the opposite foot slightly off the ground, maintaining balance. Hold briefly, then lower and switch sides.

standing-wall-holds.name: Standing Wall Holds
standing-wall-holds.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart, approximately 6 inches away from the wall. Place your hands on the wall at chest height for light support.
standing-wall-holds.endPoseDescription: Maintain an upright posture with your weight evenly distributed across both feet. Gradually reduce pressure on your hands to challenge your balance while keeping contact with the wall for safety.

standing-single-leg-stand.name: Standing Single Leg Stand
standing-single-leg-stand.startPoseDescription: Stand next to a wall or counter with your hand resting lightly on it for support. Position your feet hip-width apart with your weight evenly distributed.
standing-single-leg-stand.endPoseDescription: Shift your weight onto one leg while lifting the other foot slightly off the ground. Maintain an upright posture and hold this position for 10-30 seconds.

seated-torso-flexion.name: Seated Torso Flexion
seated-torso-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Keep your hands crossed in front of your chest and your shoulders relaxed.
seated-torso-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently round your back and lean forward, letting your head and shoulders drop toward your knees. Hold this stretch and breathe deeply, feeling the lengthening along your spine and hamstrings.

seated-shoulder-flexion-dumbbells.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Dumbbells
seated-shoulder-flexion-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Keep your core engaged and back neutral against the chair.
seated-shoulder-flexion-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion, extending your arms fully but without locking your elbows. Hold briefly at the top before returning to shoulder height.

quadriceps-sets-isometric.name: Quadriceps Sets with Isometric Hold
quadriceps-sets-isometric.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with one leg extended and the other knee bent with foot flat on the floor. Place a small towel roll under the extended knee for support.
quadriceps-sets-isometric.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle of the extended leg by pressing the back of the knee down into the towel, creating a visible muscle contraction. Hold the contraction for 5 seconds, then relax and repeat.

prone-hip-extension-dumbbell.name: Prone Hip Extension with Dumbbell
prone-hip-extension-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with your forehead resting on your hands for comfort, legs extended straight behind you. Place a light dumbbell in the crook of one knee or hold it against your thigh.
prone-hip-extension-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lift the leg holding the dumbbell upward, squeezing the glute muscle while keeping the knee slightly bent. Hold at the top for 2 seconds, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

seated-trunk-rotation-dumbbell.name: Seated Trunk Rotation with Dumbbell
seated-trunk-rotation-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor, holding one dumbbell at chest height with both hands, elbows bent. Keep your lower body stable and engage your core muscles.
seated-trunk-rotation-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping the dumbbell at chest level, then return to center and rotate to the opposite side. Move in a controlled manner, avoiding rapid twisting motions.

standing-balance-dumbbell-hold.name: Standing Balance with Dumbbell Hold
standing-balance-dumbbell-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side with your arm extended. Keep your gaze focused on a fixed point ahead.
standing-balance-dumbbell-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain steady balance while slowly shifting your weight from one foot to the other in a controlled manner. Progress by closing your eyes briefly or standing on one leg if balance allows.

seated-upper-extremity-reaches.name: Seated Upper Extremity Reaches
seated-upper-extremity-reaches.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms resting at your sides. Keep your back against the chair for support and stability.
seated-upper-extremity-reaches.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise one arm forward and upward, reaching at a comfortable level without full extension. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

seated-core-breathing.name: Seated Core Breathing
seated-core-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your abdomen or thighs. Keep your shoulders relaxed and maintain proper posture against the chair back.
seated-core-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4, gently engaging your abdominal muscles, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 4. Focus on controlled breathing without excessive exertion to conserve energy.

seated-ankle-pumps.name: Seated Ankle Pumps
seated-ankle-pumps.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and legs extended or relaxed at a comfortable angle. Keep your back against the chair for support and stability.
seated-ankle-pumps.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward, then flex your feet by pulling your toes toward your shins in a pumping motion. Perform slow, controlled repetitions to promote circulation without excessive exertion.

resistance-band-wrist-flexion.name: Resistance Band Wrist Flexion
resistance-band-wrist-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up, holding one end of a resistance band looped under your foot. Your wrist hangs slightly off the edge of the table with the band creating light tension.
resistance-band-wrist-flexion.endPoseDescription: Curl your wrist upward against the band resistance, bringing your palm toward your inner forearm. Hold briefly at the top of the movement before slowly lowering back down.

resistance-band-pronation-supination.name: Resistance Band Pronation/Supination
resistance-band-pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and hold a resistance band vertically with both hands, one end anchored under your foot. Your elbows stay bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your sides.
resistance-band-pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearms to turn your palms upward (supination), then rotate back to palms down (pronation), maintaining tension on the band throughout the movement.

resistance-band-bicep-curl.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
resistance-band-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet. Hold the other end of the band in each hand with arms extended downward and palms facing forward.
resistance-band-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl your hands upward toward your shoulders against the band resistance, keeping your elbows stationary. Squeeze briefly at the top before lowering back to the starting position.

forearm-flexor-stretch-band.name: Forearm Flexor Stretch with Band
forearm-flexor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing down. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
forearm-flexor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Use the band to gently pull your fingers back toward your wrist, extending the forearm flexor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the underside of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

forearm-extensor-stretch-band.name: Forearm Extensor Stretch with Band
forearm-extensor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with your right arm extended in front of you at shoulder height with your palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your fingers and hold the other end in your left hand.
forearm-extensor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Use the band to gently pull your fingers down toward your wrist, stretching the forearm extensor muscles. Feel a comfortable stretch along the top of your forearm and hold for 20-30 seconds.

shoulder-mobility-band-pull-apart.name: Shoulder Mobility Band Pull-Apart
shoulder-mobility-band-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height about shoulder-width apart. Your arms are slightly bent and the band has light tension.
shoulder-mobility-band-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, opening your chest while keeping your arms at chest level. Slowly return the band to the starting position with control.

lying-it-band-stretch.name: Lying IT Band Stretch
lying-it-band-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.
lying-it-band-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pull your right knee across your body toward your left shoulder using your hands, keeping your shoulders flat on the floor. Hold this position while feeling the stretch along the outer hip.

single-leg-deadlifts-dumbbell.name: Single-Leg Deadlifts with Dumbbell
single-leg-deadlifts-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, with a slight knee bend in the standing leg. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
single-leg-deadlifts-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hip while extending the non-standing leg behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Return to standing by driving through the heel of the support leg.

patellar-tendon-mobilization.name: Patellar Tendon Mobilization
patellar-tendon-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Sit with one leg extended and use your hands to gently grasp the area just below your kneecap. Keep the quad relaxed and the knee slightly bent.
patellar-tendon-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Gently massage and mobilize the patellar tendon with controlled thumb or finger pressure, moving in small circles. Apply light to moderate pressure based on comfort level.

single-leg-balance-dumbbell.name: Single-Leg Balance with Dumbbell
single-leg-balance-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg while holding a dumbbell at your side, with a slight knee bend in the standing leg. Keep your core tight and focus on a fixed point ahead.
single-leg-balance-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Maintain single-leg balance while performing small controlled arm movements with the dumbbell. Keep the supporting knee soft and engaged throughout the hold.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

dead-bugs.name: Dead Bugs
dead-bugs.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with arms extended straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees, shins parallel to the ground. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
dead-bugs.endPoseDescription: Slowly extend one arm overhead while straightening the opposite leg, hovering both just above the ground. Return to start and alternate sides in a controlled manner.

prone-external-rotation.name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation
prone-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your right arm hanging off the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulder abducted at 90 degrees with your forearm pointing downward.
prone-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your shoulder externally, raising your forearm upward toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow fixed at 90 degrees. Slowly lower back down with control and repeat for repetitions.

resistance-band-radial-deviation.name: Resistance Band Radial Deviation
resistance-band-radial-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your thumb side faces upward.
resistance-band-radial-deviation.endPoseDescription: Your wrist deviates toward the thumb side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

resistance-band-ulnar-deviation.name: Resistance Band Ulnar Deviation
resistance-band-ulnar-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table in neutral position, holding one end of a resistance band anchored under your opposite foot. Your pinky side faces upward.
resistance-band-ulnar-deviation.endPoseDescription: Your wrist deviates toward the pinky side against the band resistance. The movement is small and controlled.

resistance-band-pronation.name: Resistance Band Pronation
resistance-band-pronation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing upward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
resistance-band-pronation.endPoseDescription: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

resistance-band-supination.name: Resistance Band Supination
resistance-band-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your body, palm facing downward. Hold a resistance band with both hands at the ends.
resistance-band-supination.endPoseDescription: Your forearm rotates so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. The upper arm remains stationary against your body.

finger-isometric-hold.name: Finger Isometric Hold
finger-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your affected hand should be relaxed and supported by the table surface.
finger-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Gently curl your fingertips to hold a ball or soft object without moving, maintaining steady pressure for the duration. Keep your wrist neutral and avoid any bouncing or dynamic movement.
conditions_seen_in: rock climber finger A2 pulley strain

finger-spread-squeeze.name: Finger Spread and Squeeze
finger-spread-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your hand relaxed and fingers slightly together in front of you. Your palm should be facing downward in a neutral position.
finger-spread-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Slowly spread all fingers apart as wide as comfortable, creating space between each digit. Gently squeeze them back together without making a tight fist, focusing on controlled movement.
conditions_seen_in: rock climber finger A2 pulley strain

finger-flexor-stretch.name: Finger Flexor Stretch
finger-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up with fingers relaxed. Your opposite hand is ready to assist with gentle pressure.
finger-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently press the back of your extended fingers toward your body, creating a mild stretch in the palm and forearm. Hold the stretch position while maintaining relaxed breathing.
conditions_seen_in: rock climber finger A2 pulley strain

extensor-carpi-radialis-stretch.name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Stretch
extensor-carpi-radialis-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your arm extended in front of you, elbow straight, with your palm facing downward. Your opposite hand is positioned to apply gentle pressure.
extensor-carpi-radialis-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently press your extended hand downward toward the ground, creating a stretch along the top of your forearm. Keep your elbow straight and hold the stretch position.
conditions_seen_in: rock climber finger A2 pulley strain

hip-internal-rotation-band.name: Hip Internal Rotation with Band
hip-internal-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a resistance band around both feet just above the arches.
hip-internal-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Keeping your right foot planted, rotate your left knee inward toward the midline of your body against the band resistance. Return to center and repeat before switching sides.

copenhagen-adductor-squeeze.name: Copenhagen Adductor Squeeze
copenhagen-adductor-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Lie on your left side with hips and knees bent at 45 degrees. Place a cushion or foam pad between your knees, positioned just above knee level.
copenhagen-adductor-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the pad with your inner thighs and hips, bringing your knees slightly closer together. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds while maintaining stable hip and pelvic positioning.

glute-bridge-single-leg.name: Glute Bridge Single Leg
glute-bridge-single-leg.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Lift one foot slightly off the ground and extend that leg slightly forward.
glute-bridge-single-leg.endPoseDescription: Drive through the heel of your planted foot to lift your hips high off the ground, maintaining a straight line from knee to shoulder. Squeeze your glutes at the top before lowering back down.

pigeon-pose-hip-stretch.name: Pigeon Pose Hip Stretch
pigeon-pose-hip-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start on all fours, then bring your right knee forward between your hands with your right foot flexed. Keep your left leg extended straight behind you with your hip square to the ground.
pigeon-pose-hip-stretch.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso toward your front leg while maintaining a neutral spine. Breathe deeply into the stretch of your right hip external rotators and piriformis muscle.

monster-walks-band.name: Monster Walks with Band
monster-walks-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean with knees bent in a quarter-squat position.
monster-walks-band.endPoseDescription: Take a step forward and slightly outward with one leg, keeping tension on the band and maintaining hip stability. Alternate legs in a controlled stepping pattern while keeping your torso upright.

prone-iyt-raises-band.name: Prone I-Y-T Raises with Band
prone-iyt-raises-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a bench or table with your chest supported and feet on the ground, holding a resistance band in both hands with arms hanging down. Your forehead is neutral looking toward the floor.
prone-iyt-raises-band.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms in three positions: I (straight overhead), Y (45-degree angle), and T (90-degree angle), squeezing your rear shoulder muscles at the peak of each movement.

band-resisted-shoulder-internal-rotation.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder Internal Rotation
band-resisted-shoulder-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand with right side toward a fixed point where the band is anchored at elbow height. Bend your right elbow 90 degrees with upper arm against your ribs, forearm pointing outward, holding the band.
band-resisted-shoulder-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Pull the band across your body using internal rotation, bringing your forearm toward your midline while keeping your elbow stationary. Control the return to start position.

quadruped-shoulder-stabilization.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stabilization
quadruped-shoulder-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with hands shoulder-width apart and knees hip-width apart, maintaining a neutral spine. Shoulders are packed down with scapulae stable.
quadruped-shoulder-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining stability through the opposite shoulder and core. Return and alternate sides with controlled movements.

band-rows-high-to-low.name: Band Rows - High to Low
band-rows-high-to-low.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a fixed anchor point with the band attached at high level, feet hip-width apart. Hold the band with both hands at shoulder height with arms extended.
band-rows-high-to-low.endPoseDescription: Pull the band down and toward your body by retracting your shoulder blades, bringing your hands to your ribcage level. Squeeze your back muscles and control the return.

prone-shoulder-flexion-lifts.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion Lifts
prone-shoulder-flexion-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a bench with your chest supported, feet anchored to the floor, and arms hanging straight down holding a resistance band. Your forehead is neutral and core is engaged.
prone-shoulder-flexion-lifts.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms forward and upward to shoulder height against the band resistance, leading with your thumbs. Squeeze your shoulder muscles and control the descent back to start.

seated-hip-flexor-marching.name: Seated Hip Flexor Marching
seated-hip-flexor-marching.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core engaged and back against the chair.
seated-hip-flexor-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee toward your chest in a controlled marching motion, then lower it back down. Alternate legs in a slow, deliberate rhythm, focusing on smooth hip flexion without compensating with your back.

standing-hip-flexion-with-support.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Support
standing-hip-flexion-with-support.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy chair or counter with both hands lightly touching it for balance. Maintain upright posture with feet hip-width apart.
standing-hip-flexion-with-support.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee forward and upward to hip height in a controlled manner. Hold briefly at the top, then lower your leg back down without letting your foot touch the floor completely before the next repetition.

knee-to-chest-hold.name: Knee to Chest Hold
knee-to-chest-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
knee-to-chest-hold.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull one knee toward your chest with your hands and hold it there gently for the prescribed duration. Keep your other leg extended and your lower back in contact with the floor.

dumbbell-deadlifts.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts
dumbbell-deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Your chest is upright and core is engaged.
dumbbell-deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips and slightly bend your knees while lowering the dumbbells toward the ground, keeping your back straight and chest forward. Return to standing by driving through your heels.
conditions_seen_in: construction worker chronic low back pain
nurse thoracic and lumbar pain from patient lifting

supported-childs-pose.name: Supported Child's Pose
supported-childs-pose.startPoseDescription: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels, placing a foam roller or pillow under your chest for support. Let your arms rest alongside your body.
supported-childs-pose.endPoseDescription: Allow your torso to rest completely on the support with your forehead relaxed downward. Breathe deeply and let gravity gently stretch your thoracic and lumbar spine.
conditions_seen_in: nurse thoracic and lumbar pain from patient lifting

resistance-band-pull-apart.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
resistance-band-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you. The band should have slight tension.
resistance-band-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement. Your arms form a wide V-shape at the peak of the exercise.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

neck-isometric-hold-lateral.name: Neck Isometric Hold - Lateral
neck-isometric-hold-lateral.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and place your right hand against the right side of your head near your temple. Your head is in a neutral position.
neck-isometric-hold-lateral.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head into your hand while resisting with equal force, creating an isometric contraction without allowing any head movement. Maintain the contraction while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

band-assisted-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Band-Assisted Shoulder External Rotation
band-assisted-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your ribs. Your forearms point forward at the starting position.
band-assisted-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearms outward against the band resistance, opening your chest and engaging your rotator cuff. Your elbows remain stationary against your ribs throughout the movement.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

thoracic-spine-extension-stretch.name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
thoracic-spine-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with elbows pointing outward. Your shoulders are relaxed and your spine is in neutral.
thoracic-spine-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your upper back backward while allowing your hands to support your head, opening up your chest and front shoulders. Avoid excessive neck extension by keeping your gaze slightly downward.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

band-resisted-neck-flexion.name: Band-Resisted Neck Flexion
band-resisted-neck-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place a resistance band around the back of your head, holding both ends of the band in your hands at chest level. Your head is in a neutral position.
band-resisted-neck-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently flex your neck forward against the band resistance, bringing your chin toward your chest in a controlled manner. Maintain steady resistance throughout the movement without jerking.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

shoulder-rolls.name: Shoulder Rolls
shoulder-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arms at your sides and shoulders relaxed in their natural position. Keep your neck neutral and core engaged.
shoulder-rolls.endPoseDescription: Roll both shoulders backward in a controlled circular motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. Complete the rotation by returning shoulders to the starting position.
conditions_seen_in: musician violinist neck and shoulder pain
dentist upper back and neck strain

upper-trapezius-release.name: Upper Trapezius Release
upper-trapezius-release.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with both feet flat on the floor and maintain neutral posture. Place your right hand across your chest and grasp your left shoulder.
upper-trapezius-release.endPoseDescription: Gently drop your right ear toward your right shoulder while keeping your left shoulder pressed down with your right hand. Feel the stretch along the left upper trapezius and side of the neck.
conditions_seen_in: musician violinist neck and shoulder pain

shoulder-blade-protraction.name: Shoulder Blade Protraction
shoulder-blade-protraction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms extended forward at chest height with palms facing inward. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders relaxed.
shoulder-blade-protraction.endPoseDescription: Protract your shoulder blades by rounding your upper back and pushing your hands forward slightly, feeling your shoulder blades spread apart. Return to start position slowly and controlled.
conditions_seen_in: musician violinist neck and shoulder pain

lying-spinal-twist.name: Lying Spinal Twist
lying-spinal-twist.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms extended out to the sides in a T position. Keep your shoulders relaxed and pressed into the floor.
lying-spinal-twist.endPoseDescription: Lower both knees to one side, rotating your spine and pelvis while keeping your shoulders on the floor. Feel a gentle stretch through your back and hold, then repeat on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

scapular-push-up.name: Scapular Push-Up
scapular-push-up.startPoseDescription: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders, elbows locked, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. Your core should be engaged and your shoulder blades slightly retracted.
scapular-push-up.endPoseDescription: Depress and protract your scapulae by allowing your shoulder blades to spread apart, dropping your chest slightly toward the ground without bending your elbows. Return to the starting position by retracting your shoulder blades.

reverse-fly-dumbbells.name: Reverse Fly with Dumbbells
reverse-fly-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides, palms facing inward. Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground with a neutral spine.
reverse-fly-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Lift until your arms are parallel to the ground, squeezing your rear shoulder muscles and upper back at the peak of the movement.

resistance-band-forearm-pronation.name: Resistance Band Forearm Pronation
resistance-band-forearm-pronation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing up. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
resistance-band-forearm-pronation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces downward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-up starting position.

resistance-band-forearm-supination.name: Resistance Band Forearm Supination
resistance-band-forearm-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, held close to your side with your palm facing down. Loop the resistance band around your hand and hold the other end under your foot.
resistance-band-forearm-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward against the band resistance. Control the movement and return slowly to the palm-down starting position.

grip-strengthening-with-band.name: Grip Strengthening with Band
grip-strengthening-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arm resting in your lap, holding a resistance band looped in your hand. Your fingers are relaxed and extended slightly.
grip-strengthening-with-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the band firmly with all your fingers, creating a tight grip. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release to the starting position.

towel-wrist-rolls.name: Towel Wrist Rolls
towel-wrist-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arm extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a small towel with a loose grip. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
towel-wrist-rolls.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll your wrist in circles, first clockwise for 10 rotations, then counter-clockwise. Perform the movement smoothly with a gentle, pain-free range of motion.

supine-knee-to-chest.name: Supine Knee to Chest
supine-knee-to-chest.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Keep your head neutral and arms at your sides.
supine-knee-to-chest.endPoseDescription: Bend one knee and gently pull it toward your chest using both hands, feeling a stretch in your lower back and glutes.
conditions_seen_in: chef lower back and plantar fascia pain

neck-isometric-affected-side.name: Neck Isometric Hold - Affected Side
neck-isometric-affected-side.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand against the side of your head on the affected side (the side the chin is rotated toward).
neck-isometric-affected-side.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head into your hand without allowing any neck movement, creating an isometric contraction. Hold this tension for 5-10 seconds while maintaining relaxed breathing.

sternocleidomastoid-stretch-affected.name: Sternocleidomastoid Stretch - Affected Side
sternocleidomastoid-stretch-affected.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your eyes forward and neck in neutral position.
sternocleidomastoid-stretch-affected.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head away from the affected side (rotate chin toward the unaffected shoulder) while keeping shoulders down. Feel a stretch along the front and side of the affected neck. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbell
shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Maintain neutral spine and relaxed neck position.
shoulder-shrugs-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears in a shrugging motion, hold briefly at the top, then lower back down in a controlled manner. This strengthens the upper trapezius and stabilizer muscles.

neck-rotation-active-rom.name: Neck Rotation - Active Range of Motion
neck-rotation-active-rom.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture, shoulders relaxed, and eyes looking straight ahead. Keep your head level and neutral.
neck-rotation-active-rom.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder, moving through your full comfortable range of motion without forcing. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side. Perform controlled, gentle rotations.

prone-cobras.name: Prone Cobras
prone-cobras.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows positioned under your shoulders, and legs extended behind you. Keep your neck neutral and eyes looking down.
prone-cobras.endPoseDescription: Press through your forearms to lift your chest off the ground while keeping your pelvis in contact with the floor. Maintain a neutral neck position aligned with your spine. Hold for 5-10 seconds to strengthen postural muscles.

dumbbell-rows-bilateral.name: Dumbbell Rows - Bilateral
dumbbell-rows-bilateral.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, slight bend in knees, and a dumbbell in each hand hanging at your sides with palms facing inward. Maintain neutral spine with shoulders back and down.
dumbbell-rows-bilateral.endPoseDescription: Pull both dumbbells up toward your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your neck neutral and shoulders engaged. Lower dumbbells back down in a controlled manner.

seated-foot-intrinsic-strengthening.name: Seated Foot Intrinsic Strengthening
seated-foot-intrinsic-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your heel planted on the ground with toes relaxed.
seated-foot-intrinsic-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes downward to create an arch under the ball of your foot, maintaining heel contact with the floor. Hold the contraction for 2 seconds.

single-leg-balance-firm-surface.name: Single Leg Balance on Firm Surface
single-leg-balance-firm-surface.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, arms at your sides or extended for light balance. Look straight ahead at a fixed point.
single-leg-balance-firm-surface.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to 90 degrees while maintaining an upright torso. Keep the standing leg straight and engaged.

calf-raises-both-feet.name: Calf Raises on Both Feet
calf-raises-both-feet.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands lightly touching a wall or bar for balance. Keep your weight distributed evenly across both feet.
calf-raises-both-feet.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as possible. Hold the top position for 1 second before lowering.

plantar-fascia-stretching-towel.name: Plantar Fascia Stretching with Towel
plantar-fascia-stretching-towel.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended in front of you or draped over your knee. Keep your back straight against the chair.
plantar-fascia-stretching-towel.endPoseDescription: Loop a towel or resistance band around the ball of your foot and gently pull your toes toward your shin. Feel a stretch along the bottom of your foot.

arch-doming-exercise.name: Arch Doming Exercise
arch-doming-exercise.startPoseDescription: Stand barefoot with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly distributed, and hands resting on a wall or table for balance. Keep your toes flat on the ground.
arch-doming-exercise.endPoseDescription: Without curling your toes, draw the ball of your foot toward your heel to create a dome-shaped arch. Maintain this arch position for 3-5 seconds.

supine-bridge-foot-focus.name: Supine Bridge with Foot Focus
supine-bridge-foot-focus.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Position feet parallel with weight on the outer edges.
supine-bridge-foot-focus.endPoseDescription: Press through the outer edges of your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top.

seated-ankle-alphabet.name: Seated Ankle Alphabet
seated-ankle-alphabet.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one leg extended or crossed over the opposite knee. Keep your foot relaxed and ready to move.
seated-ankle-alphabet.endPoseDescription: Using your foot as a pointer, write capital letters A through Z in the air using ankle and foot movements. Move slowly and deliberately to strengthen intrinsic foot muscles.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports
Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

plantar-fascia-massage.name: Plantar Fascia Self-Massage
plantar-fascia-massage.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with one foot flat on the floor. Place a small ball or roller under the arch of your foot.
plantar-fascia-massage.endPoseDescription: Roll the ball slowly from your heel to your toes along the bottom of your foot, applying gentle to moderate pressure. Spend extra time on tender areas.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

heel-raises-supported.name: Heel Raises - Supported
heel-raises-supported.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or counter with your hands lightly resting on it for balance. Your feet are hip-width apart.
heel-raises-supported.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortable, then lower back down with control. Perform this movement slowly and deliberately.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

toe-taps.name: Toe Taps
toe-taps.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Your legs are relaxed and your feet are hip-width apart.
toe-taps.endPoseDescription: While keeping your heels on the ground, tap the balls of your feet up and down in a controlled manner. This strengthens the muscles on the front of the foot.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

adductor-stretching.name: Adductor Stretching
adductor-stretching.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended. Bend one knee and gently pull it toward your chest and across your body.
adductor-stretching.endPoseDescription: Hold the bent knee across your body, feeling a gentle stretch in the inner thigh and hip region. Keep your opposite leg relaxed on the floor.

standing-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
standing-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and take a small step forward with one leg, bending that knee into a shallow lunge position. Keep your hands on your hips or a stable surface.
standing-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently push your hips forward, feeling a stretch in the front of the hip and upper thigh of the back leg. Maintain an upright torso throughout.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

seated-groin-stretch.name: Seated Groin Stretch
seated-groin-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall open to the sides. Hold your feet gently with both hands.
seated-groin-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean forward slightly from the hips, pressing your elbows gently against your inner thighs to deepen the stretch. Maintain good posture through your spine.

clam-shells.name: Clam Shells
clam-shells.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent to approximately 45 degrees, feet together. Support your head with your lower arm.
clam-shells.endPoseDescription: Keeping your feet together and lower body stable, rotate your top knee upward like opening a clamshell. Return to the starting position with control.

hamstring-curls-dumbbell.name: Hamstring Curls with Dumbbell
hamstring-curls-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell between your feet at ankle height. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
hamstring-curls-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Bend the knee and curl the dumbbell up toward your glute, keeping the thigh stationary. Return to starting position with control.

step-ups-dumbbell.name: Step-Ups with Dumbbell
step-ups-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step or platform, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
step-ups-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the platform with one leg, driving through your heel and standing fully upright at the top. Step back down with control.

quadriceps-sets-vmo.name: Quadriceps Sets with VMO Focus
quadriceps-sets-vmo.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with legs extended flat on the floor. Place a small rolled towel under the knee of the working leg.
quadriceps-sets-vmo.endPoseDescription: Tighten the thigh muscle above the knee, pushing the back of the knee down into the towel and hold. Keep the knee in slight external rotation to activate the VMO (vastus medialis obliquus).

shoulder-blade-squeezes-prone.name: Shoulder Blade Squeezes (Prone)
shoulder-blade-squeezes-prone.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with arms at your sides, palms facing down, and forehead on a towel. Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
shoulder-blade-squeezes-prone.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms slightly off the floor, keeping elbows straight. Hold the contraction while maintaining a neutral neck.

planks-scapular-control.name: Planks with Scapular Control
planks-scapular-control.startPoseDescription: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows under shoulders and forearms parallel. Keep your core tight and body in one straight line from head to heels.
planks-scapular-control.endPoseDescription: Hold the plank while consciously depressing and retracting your shoulder blades, avoiding any shoulder hiking or excessive winging. Maintain steady breathing throughout.

wall-sits-knee-alignment.name: Wall Sits with Knee Alignment
wall-sits-knee-alignment.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart and about 12 inches away from the wall. Engage your core and ensure proper knee alignment.
wall-sits-knee-alignment.endPoseDescription: Slide down the wall until your knees reach 60-90 degrees of bend, keeping knees tracking over ankles. Hold the position while maintaining an engaged core and neutral spine.

tall-kneeling-shoulder-stability.name: Tall Kneeling Shoulder Stability
tall-kneeling-shoulder-stability.startPoseDescription: Begin in a tall kneeling position with knees hip-width apart, core engaged, and hands on a stability ball or light medicine ball at chest height. Keep your torso upright.
tall-kneeling-shoulder-stability.endPoseDescription: Slowly push the ball forward, extending your arms without losing spinal stability or excessive forward lean. Return to start and repeat, maintaining core engagement throughout.

scapular-stabilization-band.name: Scapular Stabilization with Band
scapular-stabilization-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight ahead. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed away from ears.
scapular-stabilization-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping elbows slightly bent. Hold the peak contraction briefly while maintaining neutral spine.

glute-bridge-band.name: Glute Bridge with Band
glute-bridge-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Arms rest at your sides with palms down.
glute-bridge-band.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling while pressing gently outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining a neutral spine and controlled breathing.

prone-shoulder-stabilization.name: Prone Shoulder Stabilization
prone-shoulder-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with arms extended overhead in a Y position, forehead resting neutrally on a towel. Engage your core to maintain neutral spine.
prone-shoulder-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Lift your arms slightly off the floor while squeezing your shoulder blades down and back, keeping elbows straight. Hold the lift for 2-3 seconds then lower with control.

kneeling-core-stability-band.name: Kneeling Core Stability with Band
kneeling-core-stability-band.startPoseDescription: Kneel upright with hips over knees, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands in front of your chest. Maintain neutral spine and engaged abdominals.
kneeling-core-stability-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band diagonally across your body while keeping your hips stationary. Return to center with control and repeat on the opposite side.

hamstring-curl-band.name: Hamstring Curl with Band
hamstring-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end in both hands for tension. Maintain neutral posture with slight knee bend.
hamstring-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Curl your foot toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your hip stable and thigh vertical. Lower with control to the starting position.

seated-spinal-stability-breathing.name: Seated Spinal Stability Breathing
seated-spinal-stability-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hips and knees at 90 degrees, and hands resting on your thighs. Maintain neutral spine alignment with shoulders over hips.
seated-spinal-stability-breathing.endPoseDescription: Take slow, deep breaths while maintaining upright posture, feeling your core muscles engage during exhalation. Focus on stability throughout the movement with no compensatory slouching.

supine-hip-knee-flexion.name: Supine Hip and Knee Flexion
supine-hip-knee-flexion.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with legs extended and arms at your sides. Keep your head in a neutral position.
supine-hip-knee-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring one knee up toward your chest, gently hugging the thigh with both hands. Hold for a few seconds, then lower and repeat on the opposite side.

seated-trunk-rotation.name: Seated Trunk Rotation
seated-trunk-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed over your chest. Keep your hips and pelvis stable.
seated-trunk-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your trunk toward one side, twisting gently at the waist while keeping your hips still. Hold briefly, then return to center and rotate to the opposite side.

standing-quad-strengthening.name: Standing Quadriceps Strengthening
standing-quad-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart while holding onto a sturdy chair back for balance. Engage your core and maintain good posture.
standing-quad-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Slowly straighten one leg by tightening the thigh muscle, lifting the foot slightly off the floor. Hold briefly, then lower and repeat on the opposite leg.

standing-spinal-rotation.name: Standing Spinal Rotation
standing-spinal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands crossed over chest or behind head. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
standing-spinal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, holding the rotation for a moment to feel the stretch in your mid-back and obliques. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

hip-bridges.name: Hip Bridges
hip-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and close to your buttocks. Arms are at your sides.
hip-bridges.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze glutes at the top and lower with control.

glute-bridges-hold.name: Glute Bridges with Hold
glute-bridges-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Place arms at sides with palms down for stability.
glute-bridges-hold.endPoseDescription: Lift hips toward ceiling, squeezing glutes maximally, and hold for 2-3 seconds before lowering. Focus on controlled movement to protect joints.

shoulder-blade-squeeze.name: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
shoulder-blade-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms at your sides and elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching.
shoulder-blade-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together toward your spine, holding the contraction for 2-3 seconds. Release slowly and repeat for controlled joint protection.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

finger-flexor-extensor.name: Finger Flexor and Extensor Exercises
finger-flexor-extensor.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearms resting on a table, palms facing down. Keep wrists in neutral position without bending.
finger-flexor-extensor.endPoseDescription: Make a gentle fist by curling fingers inward, then straighten fingers fully. Perform slowly and deliberately without forcing through pain.

seated-shoulder-press-band.name: Seated Shoulder Press with Band
seated-shoulder-press-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees at 90 degrees. Hold the resistance band anchored under your feet with handles at shoulder height, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
seated-shoulder-press-band.endPoseDescription: Press the band handles overhead until arms are nearly fully extended, maintaining an upright posture. Lower back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

lying-hamstring-curl-band.name: Lying Hamstring Curl with Band
lying-hamstring-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band around one foot and hold the ends in both hands for stability.
lying-hamstring-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Curl the banded foot toward your glutes by bending the knee, maintaining tension on the band. Straighten the leg with control back to the starting position.

seated-chest-press-band.name: Seated Chest Press with Band
seated-chest-press-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with the resistance band wrapped around your mid-back and thorax. Hold the band ends at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
seated-chest-press-band.endPoseDescription: Press the band forward until arms are nearly fully extended at chest height. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

standing-lateral-leg-raise-band.name: Standing Lateral Leg Raise with Band
standing-lateral-leg-raise-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hands can rest on your hips or a chair for balance.
standing-lateral-leg-raise-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping toes forward and torso upright. Lower the leg back to center with control.

seated-torso-stretch.name: Seated Torso Stretch
seated-torso-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture. Cross one arm across your body toward the opposite knee.
seated-torso-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your crossed arm toward your body, rotating your torso slightly and feeling a stretch along your outer back and shoulder. Hold this gentle stretch position.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

seated-row-band.name: Seated Row with Band
seated-row-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with legs extended or slightly bent, with the resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends with arms extended forward at chest height.
seated-row-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your body by bending your elbows, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.

seated-bicep-curl-band.name: Seated Bicep Curl with Band
seated-bicep-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band anchored under your feet. Hold the band handles with arms extended down at your sides, palms facing forward.
seated-bicep-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Curl the band handles up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

hand-opening-closing.name: Gentle Hand Opening and Closing
hand-opening-closing.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected arm resting on a table or in your lap. Make a gentle fist with your hand, keeping tension minimal.
hand-opening-closing.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your hand wide, spreading all fingers apart gently. Hold for 2 seconds before returning to the starting fist position.
