wrist-flexion-extension.name: Wrist Flexion and Extension
wrist-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your hand relaxed in a neutral position.
wrist-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently bend your wrist upward, then slowly lower it downward past neutral. Move only within a pain-free range.
conditions_seen_in: CRPS (complex regional pain syndrome) upper limb desensitization

finger-desensitization-tapping.name: Finger Desensitization Tapping
finger-desensitization-tapping.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected arm supported on a table. Rest your fingers flat on the table surface.
finger-desensitization-tapping.endPoseDescription: Gently tap each finger individually on the table in sequence, then tap all fingers together. Use light pressure to gradually desensitize the skin.
conditions_seen_in: CRPS (complex regional pain syndrome) upper limb desensitization

arm-circles-range-motion.name: Active Range of Motion Arm Circles
arm-circles-range-motion.startPoseDescription: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height. Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
arm-circles-range-motion.endPoseDescription: Make small circles forward with both arms, gradually increasing the size. Reverse direction and make circles backward at a comfortable pace.
conditions_seen_in: CRPS (complex regional pain syndrome) upper limb desensitization

gentle-palm-pressing.name: Gentle Palm Pressing
gentle-palm-pressing.startPoseDescription: Sit with both hands placed flat on a table in front of you, fingers spread naturally. Keep your wrists in a neutral position.
gentle-palm-pressing.endPoseDescription: Gently press your palms and fingers into the table with light pressure, engaging the muscles without causing pain. Hold for 2 seconds and release.
conditions_seen_in: CRPS (complex regional pain syndrome) upper limb desensitization

seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Your core is engaged and your back maintains a neutral position against the chair.
seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner until your arms are nearly fully extended. Your shoulders remain stable and engaged throughout the movement.

seated-dumbbell-bicep-curl.name: Seated Dumbbell Bicep Curl
seated-dumbbell-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat, arms hanging at your sides holding dumbbells with palms facing forward. Your elbows stay close to your torso throughout the movement.
seated-dumbbell-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells upward by bending your elbows, bringing the weights toward your shoulders in a controlled manner. Your upper arms remain stationary while only your forearms move.

prone-dumbbell-rows.name: Prone Dumbbell Rows
prone-dumbbell-rows.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or sturdy surface with dumbbells on the ground beneath your shoulders, arms extended. Your core is engaged and your neck remains neutral, looking slightly downward.
prone-dumbbell-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbells upward toward your ribcage, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your back muscles are fully engaged at the top of the movement.

seated-dumbbell-lateral-raise.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
seated-dumbbell-lateral-raise.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Your core is engaged and your posture is upright.
seated-dumbbell-lateral-raise.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled motion until your arms are approximately parallel to the ground at shoulder height. Your elbows maintain a slight bend throughout the movement.

seated-torso-rotation-stretch.name: Seated Torso Rotation Stretch
seated-torso-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed over your chest. Your spine is tall and your shoulders are relaxed.
seated-torso-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your shoulders to follow the movement while keeping your hips facing forward. Hold the stretch feeling the muscles along your back and torso lengthen.

standing-dumbbell-goblet-squats.name: Standing Dumbbell Goblet Squats
standing-dumbbell-goblet-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands cupping the top end. Your chest is up, core engaged, and weight distributed evenly across your feet.
standing-dumbbell-goblet-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending your knees and hips as if sitting into a chair, keeping the dumbbell at chest height. Your knees track over your toes and your chest remains upright throughout the movement.

supine-shoulder-flexion-towel.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion with Towel
supine-shoulder-flexion-towel.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Hold a towel roll or small foam roller horizontally across your chest at shoulder height with both hands.
supine-shoulder-flexion-towel.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise the towel up and back over your head in an arc, keeping elbows slightly bent and moving only as far as comfortable. Return to starting position in a controlled manner.

seated-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.name: Seated Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
seated-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture. Bring your affected arm across your body at shoulder height.
seated-cross-body-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your affected arm closer to your chest, feeling a stretch across the back of the shoulder. Hold the stretch position steady and breathe deeply.

seated-shoulder-external-rotation-band.name: Seated Shoulder External Rotation with Band
seated-shoulder-external-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with back supported and feet flat. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent 90 degrees at your sides and palms facing inward.
seated-shoulder-external-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearms outward against band resistance, keeping elbows stationary at your sides. Return slowly to starting position and repeat with controlled movement.

supine-bridge-shoulder-engagement.name: Supine Bridge with Shoulder Engagement
supine-bridge-shoulder-engagement.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down and elbows slightly bent.
supine-bridge-shoulder-engagement.endPoseDescription: Press through your feet to lift hips toward the ceiling while pressing your arms into the mat to engage shoulder stabilizers. Hold at the top position while maintaining neutral spine alignment.

kneeling-quadruped-shoulder-reaches.name: Kneeling Quadruped Shoulder Reaches
kneeling-quadruped-shoulder-reaches.startPoseDescription: Start in a quadruped position on hands and knees with shoulders directly over wrists and hips over knees. Maintain a neutral spine throughout.
kneeling-quadruped-shoulder-reaches.endPoseDescription: Slowly reach your affected arm forward and slightly across your body, extending through the shoulder while keeping your torso stable. Return to starting position and repeat.

shoulder-flexion-band.name: Shoulder Flexion with Resistance Band
shoulder-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band under both feet with handles in each hand at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
shoulder-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping the band taut and resisting its tension. Lower arms back to the starting position with controlled movement.

shoulder-abduction-band.name: Shoulder Abduction with Resistance Band
shoulder-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet while holding the handles at your sides. Keep your arms relaxed and your core engaged.
shoulder-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, maintaining tension in the band throughout the movement. Slowly lower your arms back down in a controlled manner.

elbow-flexion-band-curl.name: Elbow Flexion Curls with Resistance Band
elbow-flexion-band-curl.startPoseDescription: Stand on a resistance band with both feet, holding one handle in each hand with arms extended straight down at your sides. Keep your elbows close to your body and maintain an upright posture.
elbow-flexion-band-curl.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and curl both hands up toward your shoulders, keeping the band tension consistent and elbows stationary. Slowly lower your arms back to full extension.

finger-flexion-extension-band.name: Finger Flexion and Extension with Band
finger-flexion-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably and place a resistance band looped around all four fingers of one hand with the band anchored under your foot or held in the opposite hand. Your fingers should be in a relaxed, extended position.
finger-flexion-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Curl your fingers inward, flexing against the band resistance while keeping your palm flat. Slowly extend your fingers back to the starting position.

horizontal-adduction-band.name: Horizontal Adduction with Resistance Band
horizontal-adduction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart while holding a resistance band anchored at shoulder height in front of you. Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.
horizontal-adduction-band.endPoseDescription: Pull both arms together in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles against the band tension. Slowly return to the starting position with arms extended out to the sides.

lymphatic-drainage-arm-raises.name: Lymphatic Drainage Arm Raises
lymphatic-drainage-arm-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, keeping your shoulders relaxed and your core engaged. This is a gentle, controlled movement focused on promoting lymphatic flow.
lymphatic-drainage-arm-raises.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms overhead in a smooth, flowing motion, then lower them back down gently to your sides. Perform this movement slowly and deliberately to encourage lymphatic drainage upward toward the trunk.

neck-lateral-flexion.name: Neck Lateral Flexion
neck-lateral-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Keep both feet flat on the floor.
neck-lateral-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch on the left side of the neck. Return to center and repeat on the left side.

supine-shoulder-internal-rotation.name: Supine Shoulder Internal Rotation
supine-shoulder-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Position the affected shoulder at 90 degrees with elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing upward.
supine-shoulder-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently lower the forearm across your body toward the floor, feeling a stretch across the front and back of the shoulder. Hold gently without forcing the movement.

seated-scapular-squeezes.name: Seated Scapular Squeezes
seated-scapular-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms relaxed at your sides and shoulders in neutral position. Keep your chest open and shoulders pulled back slightly.
seated-scapular-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and slightly downward, creating tension in the upper back. Hold briefly and release, maintaining a controlled movement.

seated-neck-rotation.name: Seated Neck Rotation
seated-neck-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your eyes looking straight ahead.
seated-neck-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to the right, trying to bring your chin toward your shoulder while maintaining an upright posture. Hold briefly and return to center, then repeat on the left.

walking-lunges-dumbbells.name: Walking Lunges with Dumbbells
walking-lunges-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet together. Take a controlled step forward with your right leg.
walking-lunges-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee nearly touches the ground and your front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push off your front foot to step forward with your opposite leg.

quadruped-bird-dogs.name: Quadruped Bird Dogs
quadruped-bird-dogs.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral and core gently engaged.
quadruped-bird-dogs.endPoseDescription: Simultaneously extend your right arm forward and left leg backward, creating a straight line from fingertips to heel. Return to starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

chest-stretch.name: Chest Stretch
chest-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture, feet hip-width apart. Clasp your hands behind your back with arms extended.
chest-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your hands slightly away from your body, feeling a stretch across your chest. Hold this stretch position, breathing deeply.

single-leg-stance-support.name: Single Leg Stance with Upper Body Support
single-leg-stance-support.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy gym railing or wall with fingertips lightly touching for support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight evenly distributed.
single-leg-stance-support.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot slightly off the ground while maintaining light contact with the support. Keep your core engaged and gaze fixed on a stable point ahead.

tandem-stance-wall.name: Tandem Stance with Wall Support
tandem-stance-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways next to a wall with your hand lightly resting on it for balance. Position feet parallel and hip-width apart.
tandem-stance-wall.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe line while maintaining light hand contact on the wall. Keep your body upright and core engaged.

calf-raises-handrail.name: Calf Raises with Handrail Support
calf-raises-handrail.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a gym railing with both hands holding it for support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight distributed evenly through all toes.
calf-raises-handrail.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining steady contact with the railing. Lower heels back down with control.

proprioceptive-foot-taps.name: Proprioceptive Foot Taps on Ground
proprioceptive-foot-taps.startPoseDescription: Stand with one hand lightly touching a stable surface for balance. Weight is on one leg while the other leg is ready to perform taps.
proprioceptive-foot-taps.endPoseDescription: Gently tap your toes and heel sequentially on the ground while standing on one leg, creating a rhythmic pattern. Maintain focus on foot placement and sensory feedback.

wall-sits-sensory.name: Wall Sits with Sensory Focus
wall-sits-sensory.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hands are at your sides or on your thighs.
wall-sits-sensory.endPoseDescription: Slide down the wall into a squat position with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees, keeping your back flat against the wall. Focus on feeling muscle engagement in your thighs and glutes.

hip-abduction-rail.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Rail Support
hip-abduction-rail.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways next to a gym railing with the near hand holding it lightly for balance. Feet are hip-width apart with weight on the standing leg.
hip-abduction-rail.endPoseDescription: Lift the outer leg out to the side in a controlled manner, maintaining a slight forward lean from the hips. Lower the leg back down with control without rotating your torso.

seated-shin-taps.name: Seated Shin Taps with Foot Flexion
seated-shin-taps.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart. Back is straight and hands rest on thighs for stability.
seated-shin-taps.endPoseDescription: Tap your toes repeatedly on the ground by flexing your feet at the ankles, lifting your heel while keeping the ball of the foot in contact with the floor. Perform the movement slowly with deliberate control.

seated-band-pull-apart.name: Seated Upper Body Band Pull-Apart
seated-band-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended straight out in front of you.
seated-band-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward in an arc, bringing the band to chest level with elbows slightly bent. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end position.

seated-shoulder-flexion-band.name: Seated Shoulder Flexion with Band
seated-shoulder-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Stand on a resistance band with both feet and hold the ends in each hand at your sides.
seated-shoulder-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping elbows slightly bent. Return to starting position with controlled movement.

supine-chest-stretch-band.name: Supine Chest Stretch with Band
supine-chest-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a mat with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band across your chest with both hands.
supine-chest-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently press the band outward and across your body, allowing your chest to open and stretch. Hold this position, feeling a gentle stretch across the front of your chest.

seated-shoulder-internal-rotation-band.name: Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation with Band
seated-shoulder-internal-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band with elbows bent at 90 degrees, upper arms at your sides.
seated-shoulder-internal-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearms inward toward your body against the band resistance. Return to the starting position with control.

seated-hip-flexion-band.name: Seated Hip Flexion with Band
seated-hip-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the other end with your hands.
seated-hip-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded leg by raising the knee up toward your chest against the band resistance. Lower back down with control and repeat on both sides.

supine-lower-back-stretch-band.name: Supine Lower Back Stretch with Band
supine-lower-back-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one knee.
supine-lower-back-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the banded knee toward your chest and across your body, creating a stretch through your lower back and hip. Hold the stretch position, breathing deeply.

ankle-pumps.name: Ankle Pumps
ankle-pumps.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your thighs parallel to the ground.
ankle-pumps.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward as far as comfortable, then pull your toes toward your shins. Move through the full range of motion smoothly.

supine-glute-squeeze.name: Supine Glute Squeeze
supine-glute-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the bed, positioned hip-width apart. Rest your arms at your sides with palms down.
supine-glute-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the buttock muscles tightly while keeping your back pressed to the bed. Hold the contraction for 3-5 seconds before relaxing.

supine-arm-lifts.name: Seated Arm Lifts (Supine)
supine-arm-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides, palms facing down, and elbows slightly bent. Keep your chest open and shoulders relaxed.
supine-arm-lifts.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide both arms up along your sides toward your head, lifting only to shoulder height without crossing the sternal midline. Return arms to starting position.

supine-breathing-exercises.name: Supine Breathing Exercises
supine-breathing-exercises.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and a pillow under your head for comfort. Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
supine-breathing-exercises.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4, allowing your belly to rise while keeping your chest relaxed. Exhale through your mouth for a count of 4.

dumbbell-chest-press-seated.name: Dumbbell Chest Press - Seated
dumbbell-chest-press-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Feet are flat on the floor with knees at 90 degrees.
dumbbell-chest-press-seated.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells forward and slightly upward until arms are nearly extended without locking the elbows. Return to start position in a controlled manner.

dumbbell-bicep-curls-standing.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls - Standing
dumbbell-bicep-curls-standing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides holding light dumbbells with palms facing forward. Maintain an upright posture with core engaged and knees slightly bent.
dumbbell-bicep-curls-standing.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders by bending the elbows while keeping upper arms stationary. Lower back to starting position with control.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

dumbbell-lateral-raises-seated.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises - Seated
dumbbell-lateral-raises-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended and palms facing inward. Feet are flat on the floor.
dumbbell-lateral-raises-seated.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows. Slowly lower them back to the starting position.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

dumbbell-rows-seated.name: Dumbbell Rows - Seated
dumbbell-rows-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with back support, holding a light dumbbell in one hand with arm extended downward. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
dumbbell-rows-seated.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip by bending the elbow and squeezing the back muscle. Return to starting position with control and repeat on both sides.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

treadmill-walking-intervals.name: Treadmill Walking with Interval Training
treadmill-walking-intervals.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on the treadmill with feet hip-width apart and hands lightly gripping the handrails. Begin at a slow, comfortable walking pace to warm up.
treadmill-walking-intervals.endPoseDescription: Increase the treadmill speed to a moderate intensity where conversation is difficult but possible, maintaining an upright posture. Continue at this increased pace for the interval duration.

stationary-bike-resistance.name: Stationary Bike with Resistance
stationary-bike-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit on the bike seat with feet flat on the pedals, hands on the handlebars, and back upright. Adjust the seat height so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
stationary-bike-resistance.endPoseDescription: Pedal at a moderate to brisk pace against moderate resistance, maintaining steady breathing and an upright posture. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed throughout the movement.

seated-marching-arm-circles.name: Seated Marching with Arm Circles
seated-marching-arm-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides. Maintain an upright posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
seated-marching-arm-circles.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up while performing large circular motions with both arms overhead. Alternate knees in a marching rhythm while continuing smooth arm circles for controlled cardiovascular engagement.

standing-hip-abduction-wall.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Wall Support
standing-hip-abduction-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways next to a wall or sturdy rail with your hand lightly touching it for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged, with your other leg relaxed at your side.
standing-hip-abduction-wall.endPoseDescription: Lift your outer leg out to the side, keeping your toes pointing forward and your torso upright. Hold at the top briefly, then lower your leg back down with control.

standing-quad-stretch-wall.name: Standing Quad Stretch with Wall
standing-quad-stretch-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with one hand lightly touching it for balance. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged with good posture.
standing-quad-stretch-wall.endPoseDescription: Bend your opposite knee and bring your heel toward your buttock, holding your ankle gently with your hand. Keep your knees aligned and maintain an upright torso while holding the stretch.

pursed-lip-breathing-exercise.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing during Light Exercise
pursed-lip-breathing-exercise.startPoseDescription: Stand upright in a relaxed position with shoulders back and feet hip-width apart. Focus on your normal breathing pattern.
pursed-lip-breathing-exercise.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 2, then exhale slowly through pursed lips for a count of 4, as if blowing through a straw. Maintain this controlled breathing pattern during light walking or movement.

supported-squats-to-chair.name: Supported Squats to Chair
supported-squats-to-chair.startPoseDescription: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet hip-width apart and hands resting lightly on the chair back for support. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
supported-squats-to-chair.endPoseDescription: Lower your hips back and down as if sitting into the chair, keeping your weight in your heels and knees tracking over your toes. Tap the chair seat lightly and return to standing by pushing through your heels.

resistance-band-shoulder-press.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Press
resistance-band-shoulder-press.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Loop the resistance band under your feet and hold the ends at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
resistance-band-shoulder-press.endPoseDescription: Press the band upward and outward, extending your arms overhead while maintaining control. Return to the starting position with a slow, controlled movement.

standing-quad-sets-with-band.name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
standing-quad-sets-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy support with one hand lightly resting on it for balance. Loop the resistance band around your thigh just above the knee.
standing-quad-sets-with-band.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps muscle and straighten your leg by tightening the thigh muscles against the band resistance. Hold the contraction briefly, then relax while keeping your leg straight.

seated-spinal-twist-stretch.name: Seated Spinal Twist Stretch
seated-spinal-twist-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and your back against the chair. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your core gently engaged.
seated-spinal-twist-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently twist your torso to one side, placing your right hand on your left knee while your left hand rests behind you. Hold the stretch gently, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

seated-shoulder-blade-squeezes.name: Seated Shoulder Blade Squeezes
seated-shoulder-blade-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides with palms facing backward. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your chest open.
seated-shoulder-blade-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together toward your spine, pulling your elbows slightly backward. Hold the contraction briefly, feeling the muscles between your shoulder blades engage, then release.

seated-box-breathing.name: Seated Box Breathing
seated-box-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting on your lap.
seated-box-breathing.endPoseDescription: Complete a breathing cycle: inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4 counts, exhale for 4 counts, hold for 4 counts. Repeat the pattern with controlled, deliberate breathing.

chest-wall-mobility-stretch.name: Chest Wall Mobility Stretch
chest-wall-mobility-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and clasp your hands behind your back at waist level. Keep your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
chest-wall-mobility-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your hands downward and straighten your arms while lifting your chest upward and opening your shoulders. Hold this position while taking slow, deep breaths.

prone-cobra-breathing.name: Prone Cobra Breathing
prone-cobra-breathing.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forehead resting on the back of your hands, elbows tucked close to your body. Keep your legs extended and relaxed.
prone-cobra-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply and gently lift your head and upper chest slightly off the floor using minimal arm support. Exhale fully as you return to the starting position.

pursed-lip-breathing-walk.name: Pursed-Lip Breathing Walk
pursed-lip-breathing-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with good posture and feet shoulder-width apart. Begin walking at a comfortable, slow pace.
pursed-lip-breathing-walk.endPoseDescription: While walking, inhale through your nose for 2-4 steps, then exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4-6 steps. Maintain steady, controlled breathing throughout the walk.

belly-breathing-with-leg-lifts.name: Belly Breathing with Leg Lifts
belly-breathing-with-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands on your belly. Focus on breathing into your diaphragm.
belly-breathing-with-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply through your nose, then exhale while slowly straightening one leg and extending it along the floor. Inhale to return, then repeat on the opposite side.

standing-rib-expansion.name: Standing Rib Expansion
standing-rib-expansion.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands gently on the sides of your rib cage. Keep your posture upright and relaxed.
standing-rib-expansion.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply through your nose, expanding your ribs outward and to the sides while resisting gently with your hands. Exhale slowly and feel your ribs return to neutral position.

intrinsic-hand-strengthening.name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening
intrinsic-hand-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open with fingers spread apart and relaxed. Keep your palm and wrist in a neutral position.
intrinsic-hand-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Make a claw shape by bending only the middle and end knuckles while keeping the base knuckles straight. Squeeze gently to engage the small intrinsic muscles of the hand.

palmar-fascia-stretching.name: Palmar Fascia Stretching
palmar-fascia-stretching.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and use your opposite hand to gently grasp the affected hand at the base of the fingers. Your hand should be relaxed and supported.
palmar-fascia-stretching.endPoseDescription: Gently extend the fingers backward toward the top of your hand, creating a stretch through the palm. Hold the stretch without forcing, maintaining gentle tension through the fascia.

grip-strengthening-progressive.name: Grip Strengthening Progressive
grip-strengthening-progressive.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a soft stress ball or therapy putty in your affected hand with fingers extended. Your hand should be relaxed and ready to engage.
grip-strengthening-progressive.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the ball or putty with all your fingers gradually increasing pressure. Hold the squeeze for 3-5 seconds at a comfortable intensity, then release slowly.

finger-tapping-exercise.name: Finger Tapping Exercise
finger-tapping-exercise.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand relaxed and flat on a table, fingers extended naturally. Your hand should be completely supported and at rest.
finger-tapping-exercise.endPoseDescription: Tap each finger individually against the table in sequence from index to pinky, then back again. Perform this movement continuously with controlled, moderate speed to improve individual finger mobility.

dip-finger-flexion-extension.name: DIP (Finger) Flexion and Extension
dip-finger-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. The affected finger hangs off the edge of the table while other fingers remain flat on the surface.
dip-finger-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly bend the DIP joint (tip of finger) downward, then straighten it back to neutral. Move only at the DIP joint while keeping the PIP joint stable.

pip-joint-passive-rom.name: PIP Joint Passive Range of Motion
pip-joint-passive-rom.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected hand resting on a table, palm up. Use your other hand to gently support the finger at the base.
pip-joint-passive-rom.endPoseDescription: Gently bend the PIP joint (middle knuckle) to approximately 45 degrees, holding for 2 seconds without forcing. Return slowly to neutral position.

intrinsic-hand-muscle-activation.name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation
intrinsic-hand-muscle-activation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand relaxed on a table, fingers extended and slightly spread. Keep your metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while preparing to curl the other joints.
intrinsic-hand-muscle-activation.endPoseDescription: Flex only the PIP and DIP joints to make a claw-like position while keeping MCP joints extended. Hold for 5 seconds, maintaining the splint position on the affected finger.

grip-strengthening-therapy-putty.name: Grip Strengthening with Therapy Putty
grip-strengthening-therapy-putty.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow flexed to 90 degrees and hold a ball of therapy putty in your palm. Keep your fingers extended over the putty.
grip-strengthening-therapy-putty.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl all fingers into a fist, pressing the putty firmly while protecting the splinted DIP joint. Hold for 3 seconds then release, repeating for 10 repetitions.

pronation-supination-rotation.name: Pronation and Supination Rotation
pronation-supination-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and forearm supported on a table, starting with your palm facing down. Keep your elbow stationary against the table throughout the movement.
pronation-supination-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then reverse to palm down (pronation). Move through the full range of motion slowly and controlled.

forearm-isometric-strengthening.name: Forearm Isometric Strengthening
forearm-isometric-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with your palm facing down. Keep your hand in neutral position with fingers extended and splint in place.
forearm-isometric-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Press your forearm down firmly into the table without moving, generating tension in the forearm muscles. Hold this contraction for 10 seconds, rest, and repeat 8-10 times.

shoulder-circles-mobility.name: Shoulder Circles for Upper Body Mobility
shoulder-circles-mobility.startPoseDescription: Stand with your arms at your sides, feet shoulder-width apart, maintaining good posture. Relax your shoulders and let your arms hang naturally.
shoulder-circles-mobility.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll both shoulders backward in a circular motion, then reverse to roll forward. Complete 10 circles in each direction with controlled, fluid movements.

thumb-opposition-isometric.name: Thumb Opposition Isometric Hold
thumb-opposition-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is relaxed and in a neutral position away from your fingers.
thumb-opposition-isometric.endPoseDescription: Gently press your thumb pad against your index finger pad while applying light resistance with your other hand. Hold this position without movement.

grip-strength-band-squeeze.name: Grip Strengthening with Band Squeeze
grip-strength-band-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on your lap, holding a resistance band in your hand with all fingers and thumb relaxed around it. Your elbow is bent at 90 degrees.
grip-strength-band-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the band firmly with your entire hand, including your thumb, for a maximum contraction. Hold the squeeze while maintaining thumb stability without allowing it to bend excessively.

thumb-ip-flexion-hold.name: Thumb IP Joint Flexion Hold
thumb-ip-flexion-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table, with your thumb extended and straight. Your other hand is ready to provide gentle resistance at the thumb tip.
thumb-ip-flexion-hold.endPoseDescription: Bend only the tip joint of your thumb while your other hand provides light resistance. Hold this position, focusing on isolated movement at the interphalangeal joint.

wrist-flexion-stretch-band.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch with Band Assist
wrist-flexion-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up, using a resistance band looped around your hand for gentle assistance. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
wrist-flexion-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your hand toward your forearm using the band, creating a stretch along the back of your wrist and forearm. Hold this comfortable stretch position, ensuring your thumb remains relaxed.

thumb-mcp-stability.name: Isolated Thumb MCP Joint Stabilization
thumb-mcp-stability.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, with a light resistance band wrapped loosely around your thumb and index finger. Your thumb is in a relaxed neutral position.
thumb-mcp-stability.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb against the light band resistance while keeping your MCP (middle) joint stable and slightly flexed. The UCL ligament is protected by maintaining this supported position throughout.

finger-extension-towel.name: Finger Extension with Resistance Band Alternative (Towel Roll)
finger-extension-towel.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place a small towel roll under your fingers just below the knuckles.
finger-extension-towel.endPoseDescription: Slowly straighten your fingers by lifting them upward against the resistance of the towel. Hold briefly at full extension without locking your joints.

pip-joint-flexion.name: PIP Joint Isolation Flexion
pip-joint-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with palm facing down. Keep the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints straight while allowing only the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints to flex.
pip-joint-flexion.endPoseDescription: Bend only the middle joint of your finger downward in a controlled motion. Hold this position for 2 seconds before slowly returning to straight.

dip-joint-active-motion.name: DIP Joint Active Motion
dip-joint-active-motion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down. Keep the MCP and PIP joints stationary while focusing on the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint.
dip-joint-active-motion.endPoseDescription: Gently curl only the fingertip downward by bending the DIP joint. Perform small, controlled movements without forcing or straining the joint.

gentle-finger-stretch.name: Gentle Finger Stretching
gentle-finger-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected hand resting palm-down on a table. Use your other hand to gently grasp the affected finger.
gentle-finger-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly and gently pull the finger into slight extension without pain. Hold the mild stretch for 15-20 seconds, then release gradually.

lumbrical-activation.name: Intrinsic Hand Muscle Activation (Lumbrical Exercise)
lumbrical-activation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand open and relaxed with fingers extended. Position your hand in a neutral posture with the palm facing sideways.
lumbrical-activation.endPoseDescription: Curl only the lower knuckles (MCP joints) downward while keeping the middle and top joints straight. This creates a claw-like position that activates the intrinsic muscles.

forearm-rotation.name: Forearm Pronation and Supination
forearm-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, forearm at neutral with palm facing downward. Keep your upper arm stationary throughout.
forearm-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then rotate back and turn palm downward (pronation). Move slowly through the full available range.

soft-grip-squeeze.name: Grip Strength Maintenance (Soft Object)
soft-grip-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably holding a soft sponge or cloth in your hand with fingers relaxed and slightly curled. Maintain a neutral wrist position.
soft-grip-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze the soft object using all your fingers for a 3-5 second hold at mild intensity. Release slowly and rest before repeating.

active-rom-finger-straight.name: Active Range of Motion Finger Straightening
active-rom-finger-straight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm down, allowing your fingers to naturally curl slightly. Begin from a relaxed, partially flexed position.
active-rom-finger-straight.endPoseDescription: Actively straighten all your fingers fully by engaging your finger extensor muscles. Hold the fully extended position briefly, then return to the starting relaxed position.

intrinsic-finger-flexion.name: Intrinsic Hand Strengthening - Finger Flexion
intrinsic-finger-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up with fingers extended. Your wrist is in neutral position with the repaired hand relaxed.
intrinsic-finger-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl only your fingers (not wrist) into a fist, bringing fingertips toward your palm. Hold the contracted position briefly before returning to full extension.
conditions_seen_in: flexor tendon repair zone 2 (8 weeks post-op)

thumb-opposition-resistance-band.name: Thumb Opposition with Resistance Band
thumb-opposition-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand in neutral position with fingers extended. Loop a resistance band around your thumb and index finger.
thumb-opposition-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Bring your thumb across your palm to touch the base of your little finger against light band resistance. Return slowly to the starting position.

thumb-abduction-towel-roll.name: Thumb Abduction with Towel Roll
thumb-abduction-towel-roll.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting palm-down on a table, fingers relaxed. Place a rolled towel under your hand for support.
thumb-abduction-towel-roll.endPoseDescription: Lift your thumb away from your palm, moving it toward the ceiling in a controlled manner. Hold briefly at the top before lowering back down.

wrist-flexion-light-weight.name: Wrist Flexion with Light Weight
wrist-flexion-light-weight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand extended beyond the edge with palm facing up. Hold a 1-2 pound weight in your hand.
wrist-flexion-light-weight.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your wrist upward, bringing your palm toward your forearm. Lower the weight back down with control.

wrist-extension-light-weight.name: Wrist Extension with Light Weight
wrist-extension-light-weight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand extended beyond the edge with palm facing down. Hold a 1-2 pound weight in your hand.
wrist-extension-light-weight.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your hand upward by extending your wrist. Lower the weight back down with control.

thumb-wrist-stretch.name: Thumb and Wrist Stretch
thumb-wrist-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing forward. Use your opposite hand to gently hold your affected thumb.
thumb-wrist-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your thumb backward and downward into extension, feeling a mild stretch at the base of the thumb. Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.

thumb-finger-pinch-release.name: Thumb-Finger Pinch and Release
thumb-finger-pinch-release.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand relaxed in your lap, fingers and thumb in neutral position. Keep your wrist straight and stable.
thumb-finger-pinch-release.endPoseDescription: Gently pinch each finger tip with your thumb in sequence, using light pressure without strain. Release and move to the next finger.

seated-great-toe-flexion.name: Seated Great Toe Flexion/Extension
seated-great-toe-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor or extended in front of you. Place your forearm across your thigh just above the knee to stabilize the foot.
seated-great-toe-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your great toe downward into flexion, then extend it upward as far as comfortable. Hold each direction for 2-3 seconds and repeat.

resistance-band-toe-flexion.name: Resistance Band Toe Flexion
resistance-band-toe-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around the forefoot just behind the metatarsal heads. Keep your heel on the floor and foot relaxed.
resistance-band-toe-flexion.endPoseDescription: Press your great toe downward against the band resistance, flexing the hallux joint while keeping your heel planted. Hold briefly and return to start.

resistance-band-toe-extension.name: Resistance Band Toe Extension
resistance-band-toe-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around your great toe, holding the band ends in your hands. Keep tension on the band with your foot in a neutral position.
resistance-band-toe-extension.endPoseDescription: Pull your great toe upward toward your shin against the band resistance, extending the hallux joint maximally. Maintain control and return slowly to neutral.

plantar-fascia-rolling.name: Plantar Fascia Rolling
plantar-fascia-rolling.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and place one foot flat on the floor with the opposite leg crossed over it. Grip your forefoot with both hands positioned on either side of the arch.
plantar-fascia-rolling.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your toes upward toward your shin, stretching the plantar fascia and arch. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds, feeling tension along the underside of your foot.

standing-calf-raises-toe-focus.name: Standing Calf Raises with Toe Focus
standing-calf-raises-toe-focus.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a wall or support for balance. Distribute weight evenly across all foot areas.
standing-calf-raises-toe-focus.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, emphasizing push-off through the great toe and first metatarsal. Lower back down slowly to complete one repetition.

resistance-band-adduction-great-toe.name: Resistance Band Adduction with Great Toe
resistance-band-adduction-great-toe.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and loop a resistance band around both great toes, holding the band ends in your hands with slight tension. Keep your feet relaxed with adequate space between them.
resistance-band-adduction-great-toe.endPoseDescription: Pull your great toes together against the band resistance, moving them toward midline adduction. Return slowly and repeat for controlled strengthening of the foot intrinsics.

toe-spreads.name: Toe Spreads
toe-spreads.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your heel planted and focus on the big toe.
toe-spreads.endPoseDescription: Spread the big toe away from the second toe as far as comfortably possible. Hold for 2 seconds while maintaining contact with the floor.

marble-pickups.name: Marble Pickups
marble-pickups.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with bare feet on the floor. Place 5-10 marbles or small objects on the floor in front of you.
marble-pickups.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes to grasp one marble and lift it slightly off the floor. Place it in a cup or container beside you, then repeat with each foot.

seated-foot-flexion-extension.name: Seated Foot Flexion and Extension
seated-foot-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keep one leg stationary while lifting the other foot slightly off the ground.
seated-foot-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward as far as comfortable, then flex your foot by pulling your toes toward your shin. Alternate between these positions.

big-toe-flexion-strengthening.name: Big Toe Flexion Strengthening
big-toe-flexion-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Place a small towel on the floor under your foot.
big-toe-flexion-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Curl just your big toe downward to grip the towel, then relax. Avoid curling the other toes. Repeat 10-15 times per foot.

arch-strengthening-towel-scrunches.name: Arch Strengthening with Towel Scrunches
arch-strengthening-towel-scrunches.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with a small towel spread flat on the floor in front of you. Place your bare foot on the towel with toes relaxed.
arch-strengthening-towel-scrunches.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes to scrunch the towel toward you, engaging your arch muscles. Release and smooth out the towel, then repeat 10-15 times.

wall-ankle-stretches.name: Wall Ankle Stretches
wall-ankle-stretches.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your back against a wall or in a comfortable position. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
wall-ankle-stretches.endPoseDescription: Gently press the top of your foot downward and rotate your ankle in slow circles. Reverse direction, then repeat on the other side.

towel-scrunch-foot.name: Intrinsic Foot Strengthening (Towel Scrunch)
towel-scrunch-foot.startPoseDescription: Sit with feet flat on the floor with a small towel spread out in front of you. Your toes are relaxed and extended on the towel.
towel-scrunch-foot.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes downward to scrunch and bunch up the towel toward you using only your foot intrinsic muscles. Hold the scrunched position briefly before releasing.

core-plank.name: Core Plank (Foot Neutral Position)
core-plank.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with forearms on the ground, elbows directly under shoulders, and feet together or slightly apart with toes on the ground. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
core-plank.endPoseDescription: Engage your core and glutes to lift your body off the ground, maintaining a neutral spine and even weight distribution through both feet. Avoid letting your hips drop or rise.

hamstring-stretch-band.name: Hamstring Stretch with Band
hamstring-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg bent and foot flat on the floor. Loop a resistance band around the foot of the extended leg.
hamstring-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Use the band to gently pull the extended leg toward your chest, keeping your knee relatively straight. Feel a stretch along the back of the thigh and hold for 30 seconds.

hallux-flexion-band.name: Hallux Flexion with Band Resistance
hallux-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended in front of you on a chair or bench. Place a resistance band around the ball of your foot just below the toes.
hallux-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Curl your toes downward against the band resistance, creating tension in the sole of the foot. Hold for 2 seconds at maximum contraction.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

hallux-extension-band.name: Hallux Extension with Band
hallux-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended and a resistance band looped around your toes. Keep your foot relaxed in plantarflexion.
hallux-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes upward against the band resistance, extending the great toe toward your shin. Maintain tension for 2 seconds.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

toe-walks-heels.name: Toe Walks on Heels
toe-walks-heels.startPoseDescription: Stand upright and rise onto your heels, lifting your toes off the ground. Keep your posture tall and shoulders back.
toe-walks-heels.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly on your heels for 30-60 seconds, keeping your toes elevated. Maintain balance and controlled movement.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

great-toe-abduction-band.name: Seated Great Toe Abduction with Band
great-toe-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around both great toes. Start with toes together.
great-toe-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Separate your great toes against the band resistance, creating an abduction movement. Hold the separation for 2 seconds.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

hip-abduction-band-standing.name: Band-Resisted Hip Abduction Standing
hip-abduction-band-standing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hands on hips or lightly touching support.
hip-abduction-band-standing.endPoseDescription: Step one leg out to the side against the band resistance, keeping your torso upright. Return to start and alternate sides.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

single-leg-bridges.name: Supine Single Leg Bridges
single-leg-bridges.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, the other leg extended toward the ceiling. Arms at your sides for support.
single-leg-bridges.endPoseDescription: Drive through the bent leg to lift your hips off the ground into a bridge position. Hold for 2 seconds at the top.
conditions_seen_in: turf toe grade 1 return to sport

supine-glute-bridge-dumbbell.name: Supine Glute Bridge with Dumbbell
supine-glute-bridge-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a dumbbell across your hips, holding it with both hands for stability.
supine-glute-bridge-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top while maintaining stable foot positioning.

prone-dorsiflexion-dumbbell.name: Prone Dorsiflexion Hold with Dumbbell Resistance
prone-dorsiflexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a bench with your feet hanging off the edge. Place a dumbbell on top of your feet near the toes, holding it in place.
prone-dorsiflexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shins, lifting the dumbbell through the dorsiflexion movement. Maintain the upward position briefly before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

seated-calf-raises-dumbbell.name: Seated Calf Raises with Dumbbell
seated-calf-raises-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor. Place a dumbbell on top of each thigh near the knees, holding them in place with your hands.
seated-calf-raises-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground against the dumbbell resistance. Hold briefly at the top before lowering your heels back down.

quadruped-foot-stability-taps.name: Quadruped Foot Stability Taps
quadruped-foot-stability-taps.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout the exercise.
quadruped-foot-stability-taps.endPoseDescription: Lightly tap one foot to the side while maintaining stability through your supporting leg and upper body. Return and alternate sides with controlled, precise movements.

hamstring-curls-prone.name: Hamstring Curls (Prone)
hamstring-curls-prone.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with your legs extended straight behind you. Keep your hips and core engaged against the floor.
hamstring-curls-prone.endPoseDescription: Bend your operative knee, bringing your heel toward your buttocks in a controlled motion. Squeeze your hamstring at the top before lowering your leg back to the start position.
conditions_seen_in: ACL post-op return to running (16 weeks)

treadmill-walking.name: Treadmill Walking Progression
treadmill-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand on the treadmill with one hand lightly resting on the handrail for balance and safety. Start at a slow, comfortable walking speed with good upright posture.
treadmill-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk at a steady controlled pace, allowing your operative leg to move through its full range of motion naturally. Maintain an even gait and gradually increase duration as tolerated.
conditions_seen_in: ACL post-op return to running (16 weeks)

supine-hamstring-stretch-band.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Band
supine-hamstring-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Loop a resistance band around one foot while keeping the other leg straight on the ground.
supine-hamstring-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band to gently draw the banded leg toward your chest, creating a stretch along the back of the thigh. Keep your head and lower back relaxed against the floor.

standing-hamstring-curl-band.name: Standing Hamstring Curl with Band
standing-hamstring-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band ends for stability or place hands on a wall for balance.
standing-hamstring-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Bend one knee and curl your heel up toward your glutes while maintaining an upright posture. Return to starting position and repeat before switching legs.

standing-quad-set-band.name: Standing Quad Set with Band Assist
standing-quad-set-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your thigh just above the knee. Keep your standing leg straight and engaged with slight knee bend.
standing-quad-set-band.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps to straighten the knee fully while pulling upward slightly with the band. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds while maintaining balance.

single-leg-rdl-band.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift with Band
single-leg-rdl-band.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg while holding a resistance band anchored under the standing foot. Maintain an upright posture with a slight knee bend in the standing leg.
single-leg-rdl-band.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip and extend the non-standing leg behind you for balance while leaning your torso forward. Feel the stretch and engagement in the hamstring of the standing leg as you return to upright.

seated-hip-ir-band.name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation with Band
seated-hip-ir-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent, foot flat. Loop a resistance band around the bent leg's foot or lower shin.
seated-hip-ir-band.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate the bent leg inward across your body using the band for light assistance. Stop at a comfortable stretch in the outer hip and hold briefly before returning.

resisted-high-knee-march.name: Resisted High Knee March
resisted-high-knee-march.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with arms ready to swing naturally.
resisted-high-knee-march.endPoseDescription: Drive one knee upward toward chest while maintaining tension on the band, then alternate legs in a marching rhythm. Progress speed gradually as tolerated for cardiovascular benefit.

prone-shoulder-isometric-hold.name: Prone Shoulder Isometric Hold
prone-shoulder-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a firm surface with arms at your sides, palms down, and forehead resting on a small towel. Your legs should be extended straight behind you.
prone-shoulder-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Gently lift your chest and arms slightly off the surface while maintaining neutral spine alignment. Hold this position for 5-10 seconds without moving, engaging the posterior shoulder and upper back muscles.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff repair return to overhead sport (6 months)

standing-scapular-squeezes.name: Standing Scapular Squeezes
standing-scapular-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides with palms facing forward, and shoulders relaxed in a neutral position. Maintain an upright posture with your gaze forward.
standing-scapular-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down toward your back pockets, creating a contraction across your upper back. Hold for 3-5 seconds, then relax and return to neutral position.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff repair return to overhead sport (6 months)

standing-hip-marches.name: Standing Hip Marches
standing-hip-marches.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, maintaining good posture with shoulders back and core engaged. Lightly touch a wall or chair for balance support if needed.
standing-hip-marches.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward hip height in a controlled marching motion, then lower and repeat on the opposite side. Continue alternating in a slow, rhythmic pattern while maintaining upright posture.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff repair return to overhead sport (6 months)

single-leg-balance-perturbations.name: Single Leg Balance with Perturbations
single-leg-balance-perturbations.startPoseDescription: Stand on the affected leg with knee slightly bent and arms out to the sides for balance. The opposite leg is lifted with hip and knee bent to about 90 degrees.
single-leg-balance-perturbations.endPoseDescription: Maintain single leg stance while gently swaying side to side and forward/backward with controlled movements. Weight is centered over the affected ankle with engaged core.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

dumbbell-single-leg-deadlifts.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlifts
dumbbell-single-leg-deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand on the affected leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with arm at your side. The other leg is positioned for balance with a slight bend in the standing knee.
dumbbell-single-leg-deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while extending the non-standing leg behind you for counterbalance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. The torso leans forward while maintaining a neutral spine and stable ankle.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

calf-raises-on-step.name: Calf Raises on Step
calf-raises-on-step.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg on a step or stair with the affected ankle positioned so the heel hangs slightly off the edge. The other leg is lifted for balance with a slight bend in the standing knee.
calf-raises-on-step.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the ball of the foot, lifting the heel as high as possible using the calf muscles. Hold the peak position briefly with full control through the ankle.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

reverse-lunge-with-rotation.name: Reverse Lunge with Rotation
reverse-lunge-with-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell at chest height with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart. Core is engaged with neutral spine.
reverse-lunge-with-rotation.endPoseDescription: Step backward with the affected leg into a lunge position while rotating the torso toward the front leg. The back knee lowers toward the ground with weight distributed through the front ankle.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

lateral-lunges.name: Lateral Lunges
lateral-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, holding dumbbells at your sides. Engage your core with neutral spine alignment.
lateral-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step laterally with the affected leg, bending that knee while keeping the opposite leg straight. The torso remains upright as weight shifts over the stepping ankle.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

dumbbell-step-ups-deceleration.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups with Deceleration
dumbbell-step-ups-deceleration.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a step or bench holding dumbbells at your sides, feet together. The affected leg is positioned to step up first onto the elevated surface.
dumbbell-step-ups-deceleration.endPoseDescription: Step up with the affected leg, driving through the ankle and pushing to stand fully on the step. Slowly lower back down with controlled deceleration through the ankle.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

standing-calf-stretch.name: Standing Gastrocnemius and Soleus Stretch
standing-calf-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or support at arm's length away with hands placed on the wall for balance. The affected leg is extended straight behind you with heel firmly on the ground.
standing-calf-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean forward slightly, allowing the affected ankle and calf to stretch while keeping the heel planted. Feel the stretch in the calf muscle and hold for a sustained duration.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports
general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

rowing-machine.name: Rowing Machine
rowing-machine.startPoseDescription: Sit on the rowing machine with feet secured, knees slightly bent, and arms extended forward. Grab the handle with an overhand grip at shoulder height.
rowing-machine.endPoseDescription: Drive through your legs while pulling the handle toward your torso, bringing elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Extend arms and return to start in a controlled motion.
conditions_seen_in: lumbar disc herniation return to golf

rotation-stretches.name: Rotation Stretches
rotation-stretches.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms spread out at shoulder height. Keep your shoulders flat against the floor.
rotation-stretches.endPoseDescription: Gently drop both knees to one side in a controlled manner, allowing your spine to rotate while maintaining contact with the floor. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: lumbar disc herniation return to golf

prone-shoulder-iyt-raises.name: Prone Shoulder I-Y-T Raises
prone-shoulder-iyt-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a table or bench with your arms hanging toward the floor and thumbs pointing forward. Your forehead rests on a small towel and legs are extended straight behind you.
prone-shoulder-iyt-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms overhead in an I position, then move to a Y position (45 degrees), and finally to a T position (90 degrees), squeezing shoulder blades together at the top. Hold each position briefly before lowering back down.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

band-external-rotation-9090.name: Band External Rotation at 90/90
band-external-rotation-9090.startPoseDescription: Stand with your shoulder abducted to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a resistance band anchored at shoulder height. Your upper arm is parallel to the floor with the band creating slight tension.
band-external-rotation-9090.endPoseDescription: Externally rotate your shoulder to bring your forearm up toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow in place. The motion is controlled and purposeful, with maximum external rotation at the end position.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

band-internal-rotation-zero-degrees.name: Band Internal Rotation at 0 Degrees
band-internal-rotation-zero-degrees.startPoseDescription: Stand with your arm at your side and elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a resistance band anchored at waist height. Your forearm starts pointing away from your body with slight band tension.
band-internal-rotation-zero-degrees.endPoseDescription: Internally rotate your shoulder to bring your forearm across your body toward your midline. The movement is slow and controlled, finishing with a brief pause at the end of the range.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

band-shoulder-abduction.name: Band Shoulder Abduction
band-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand with arms at your sides holding a resistance band anchored under your feet. The band has slight tension with your arms in a neutral position.
band-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Abduct your shoulders by raising your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height. The movement is controlled with the band providing resistance throughout the motion.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

resistance-band-step-ups.name: Resistance Band Step-Ups
resistance-band-step-ups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step (4-6 inches) with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Maintain an upright posture with slight band tension.
resistance-band-step-ups.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the platform with the affected leg first, driving through your heel and maintaining knee alignment over your toes. Step down slowly and repeat.

knee-flexion-band.name: Knee Flexion with Resistance Band
knee-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall with a resistance band looped around the foot of one leg and held in your hand. Keep your standing leg slightly bent for stability.
knee-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Bend the knee, pulling your heel toward your buttocks against the band resistance while keeping your thigh stationary. Slowly return to the starting position.

knee-flexion-extension.name: Knee Flexion and Extension
knee-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit in a sturdy chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
knee-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one foot off the floor by straightening the knee, then lower it back down in a controlled manner. Repeat the motion smoothly without locking the knee at full extension.

straight-leg-raise.name: Straight Leg Raises
straight-leg-raise.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with one leg bent and foot flat on the floor for stability. Keep the other leg straight and relaxed on the ground.
straight-leg-raise.endPoseDescription: Tighten the thigh muscle and slowly raise the straight leg about 12 inches off the ground. Hold briefly, then lower the leg back down without touching the floor.

short-arc-quads.name: Short Arc Quads
short-arc-quads.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended on the floor. Place a rolled towel or small pillow under one knee to create a slight elevation.
short-arc-quads.endPoseDescription: Tighten the thigh muscle and straighten the knee by lifting the foot slightly off the ground. Hold the contraction briefly, then relax and lower the foot back down.

seated-knee-to-chest.name: Seated Knee to Chest
seated-knee-to-chest.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keep your back against the chair and your other foot resting on the ground.
seated-knee-to-chest.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee toward your chest as far as comfortably possible. Gently pull your thigh toward your torso using your hands, feeling a stretch in the knee and hip area.

lateral-band-walk-dumbbells.name: Lateral Band Walk with Dumbbells
lateral-band-walk-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart while holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Maintain a slight squat position with knees bent.
lateral-band-walk-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side while keeping your core tight and knees bent. Return to center and repeat in the opposite direction.

monster-walk-dumbbells.name: Monster Walk with Dumbbells
monster-walk-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with feet hip-width apart. Maintain an athletic posture with a slight knee bend.
monster-walk-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Step forward and to the side in a diagonal pattern, maintaining tension and knee bend. Continue alternating legs while keeping your torso upright.

side-lying-hip-abduction-dumbbell.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction with Dumbbell
side-lying-hip-abduction-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a dumbbell resting on your top hip. Keep your bottom leg bent for stability and your top leg straight.
side-lying-hip-abduction-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Raise your top leg away from your body against the dumbbell weight. Hold at the top, maintaining alignment with your hip.

supine-ball-external-rotation.name: Supine Stability Ball Shoulder External Rotation
supine-ball-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your upper back supported on a stability ball, holding a light dumbbell in one hand with your elbow bent 90 degrees and upper arm perpendicular to your body. Your feet are planted on the ground for stability.
supine-ball-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate the dumbbell backward in an external rotation movement, bringing your forearm toward the floor while keeping your elbow fixed in place.

standing-cable-external-rotation-90.name: Standing Cable External Rotation with Arm at 90 Degrees
standing-cable-external-rotation-90.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways to a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, elbow bent at 90 degrees and arm raised to shoulder height. Hold the cable handle with a neutral grip.
standing-cable-external-rotation-90.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm backward in an external rotation movement, creating resistance against the cable while maintaining your elbow position.

standing-shoulder-flexion-scapular.name: Standing Shoulder Flexion with Scapular Retraction
standing-shoulder-flexion-scapular.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms straight and shoulders relaxed. Maintain a neutral spine and engaged core.
standing-shoulder-flexion-scapular.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms forward and upward to shoulder height while retracting your scapulae (shoulder blades), squeezing your back muscles at the top.

doorway-pectoral-stretch.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
doorway-pectoral-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your forearm on the door frame at shoulder height, elbow bent at 90 degrees. Your foot is slightly forward.
doorway-pectoral-stretch.endPoseDescription: Step forward through the doorway, allowing your chest to stretch as your arm remains fixed on the frame, feeling a gentle stretch across your pectoral muscles.

pendulum-swings.name: Pendulum Swings
pendulum-swings.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and bend forward at the hips so your torso is nearly parallel to the ground. Let your affected arm hang straight down toward the floor.
pendulum-swings.endPoseDescription: Gently swing your arm in small circular motions, gradually increasing the range of motion as tolerated. The movement comes from momentum and gravity, not from muscle effort.

prone-shoulder-external-rotation-band.name: Prone Shoulder External Rotation with Band
prone-shoulder-external-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a table or bed with your affected shoulder at the edge, elbow bent to 90 degrees with forearm hanging down. Hold one end of the resistance band in your hand.
prone-shoulder-external-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm upward against the band resistance until your forearm is parallel to the ground. Slowly lower back to starting position with control.

scapular-squeezes-band.name: Scapular Squeezes with Band
scapular-squeezes-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder width. Maintain slight tension on the band.
scapular-squeezes-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull the band toward your chest, keeping elbows at shoulder height. Hold briefly, then slowly return to the starting position.

sidelying-shoulder-abduction-band.name: Sidelying Shoulder Abduction with Band
sidelying-shoulder-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your unaffected side with legs stacked and knees bent for stability. Your affected arm is at your side with elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a resistance band loop.
sidelying-shoulder-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Lift your affected elbow upward, raising your forearm toward the ceiling against the band resistance while keeping your elbow bent. Slowly lower back to starting position.

standing-band-pull-aparts.name: Standing Band Pull-Aparts
standing-band-pull-aparts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms extended in front of you at shoulder height, holding a resistance band taut with both hands. Maintain good posture with slight knee bend.
standing-band-pull-aparts.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and slightly backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return to the starting position with control.

neck-retraction.name: Neck Retraction
neck-retraction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with shoulders relaxed and eyes facing forward. Keep your chin level and parallel to the ground.
neck-retraction.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your chin straight backward, creating a double chin appearance. Hold this retracted position while keeping your gaze forward.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

posterior-chain-activation.name: Posterior Chain Activation
