posterior-chain-activation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your head neutral on the floor.
posterior-chain-activation.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold briefly while maintaining engagement in your back and glutes.

single-arm-dumbbell-row.name: Dumbbell Row - Single Arm
single-arm-dumbbell-row.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with the arm extended downward. Keep your chest up and core engaged.
single-arm-dumbbell-row.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbell up toward your ribcage, driving your elbow back and retracting your scapula. Squeeze your mid-back at the top of the movement.

dumbbell-pullover.name: Dumbbell Pullover
dumbbell-pullover.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a bench with feet planted on the floor, holding a dumbbell with both hands at chest level. Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.
dumbbell-pullover.endPoseDescription: Lower the dumbbell in an arc over and behind your head while keeping a slight elbow bend. Raise it back over your chest, focusing on scapular retraction at the top.

prone-reverse-fly.name: Prone Reverse Fly
prone-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on an incline bench or floor with light dumbbells in each hand, arms hanging down with a slight elbow bend. Keep your forehead neutral and core engaged.
prone-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Raise both dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled arc, leading with your elbows and squeezing your rear delts. Pause briefly at shoulder height before lowering back down.

serratus-wall-pushup.name: Serratus Anterior Activation - Wall Push-up
serratus-wall-pushup.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with hands on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
serratus-wall-pushup.endPoseDescription: Press through your hands to protract your scapulae, pushing your chest slightly away from the wall. Return to start by retracting your scapulae in a controlled manner.

thoracic-rotations-foam-roller.name: Thoracic Rotations with Foam Roller
thoracic-rotations-foam-roller.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with a foam roller positioned horizontally under your mid-back at the level of your shoulder blades. Your knees are bent with feet flat on the floor, and hands are crossed over your chest.
thoracic-rotations-foam-roller.endPoseDescription: Gently drop one elbow toward the floor, rotating your upper spine while keeping your hips stable. Your gaze follows the direction of rotation as you feel a stretch across your chest and thoracic spine.

half-kneeling-thoracic-rotation.name: Half-Kneeling Thoracic Rotation
half-kneeling-thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Assume a half-kneeling position with your left knee on the ground and right foot forward, hips square. Place your left hand behind your head with your elbow out to the side.
half-kneeling-thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper spine toward the right side, opening your right elbow and chest toward the ceiling. Your pelvis remains still as you emphasize the rotation from your thoracic spine.

quadruped-thoracic-extensions.name: Quadruped Thoracic Extensions
quadruped-thoracic-extensions.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips. One hand is placed behind your head with your elbow pointing out to the side.
quadruped-thoracic-extensions.endPoseDescription: Rotate and extend your upper body, opening your elbow toward the ceiling and rotating through your thoracic spine. Your pelvis remains stable as you emphasize the rotation from your mid-back.

quadruped-bird-dog.name: Quadruped Bird Dog
quadruped-bird-dog.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral with a slight natural curve in the lower back.
quadruped-bird-dog.endPoseDescription: Extend your right arm forward and left leg back simultaneously while maintaining a neutral spine. Hold briefly, ensuring your extended arm and leg form a straight line from fingertips to heel.

prone-back-extension.name: Prone Back Extension
prone-back-extension.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forehead resting on a small towel and arms at your sides with palms down. Keep your legs straight and relaxed with toes pointed.
prone-back-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently lift your chest and shoulders off the ground using your back muscles, keeping your neck neutral. Hold at the top for 2 seconds, then slowly lower back down without touching the floor completely.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

lumbar-rotation-stretch.name: Lumbar Rotation Stretch
lumbar-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned close to your glutes. Keep your arms out to the sides at shoulder level with palms down.
lumbar-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lower both knees to the right side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor and turning your gaze left. Feel a gentle stretch through your lumbar spine and hold, then repeat to the opposite side.

seated-spinal-flexion-stretch.name: Seated Spinal Flexion Stretch
seated-spinal-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor or a chair with your feet flat and legs extended or bent comfortably. Keep your back naturally aligned and shoulders relaxed.
seated-spinal-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly fold forward at the hips, allowing your head and neck to relax naturally as you reach toward your shins. Feel a gentle stretch along your entire spine and hold without forcing the position.

calf-raises-seated.name: Calf Raises (Seated)
calf-raises-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back against the chair and posture neutral.
calf-raises-seated.endPoseDescription: Lift your heels off the ground while pressing the balls of your feet down, rising up onto your toes. Lower heels back to the floor with control.

standing-dumbbell-overhead-press.name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Press
standing-dumbbell-overhead-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent and palms facing forward. Engage your core and maintain a neutral spine throughout.
standing-dumbbell-overhead-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion, extending your arms while keeping your core tight. Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control.

supine-figure-four-rotation.name: Supine Figure-Four Hip Rotation
supine-figure-four-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and cross your right ankle over your left knee in a figure-four position. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the ground.
supine-figure-four-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your left hip outward by guiding your left knee toward the ground while maintaining the figure-four leg position. Feel the internal and external rotation movement in your right hip.

clams-resistance-band.name: Clams with Resistance Band
clams-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees, hips and knees bent at 45 degrees, and feet together. Keep your core engaged and head supported on your lower arm.
clams-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your top knee upward against the band resistance while keeping your feet together and lower body stable. Pause at the top before slowly lowering back to the starting position.

side-lying-hip-abduction-band.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction with Band
side-lying-hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Keep your bottom leg grounded and both legs relatively straight.
side-lying-hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg up against the band resistance, raising it about 12-18 inches while keeping your torso stable. Lower with control back to the starting position.

monster-walks-resistance-band.name: Monster Walks with Resistance Band
monster-walks-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your legs just above the knees. Maintain a slight forward lean with hands on hips or across chest.
monster-walks-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Take a large step forward while keeping the band taut and knees pressed outward against the resistance. Alternate legs in a controlled marching motion.

supine-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.name: Supine Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
supine-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your head neutral and shoulders relaxed.
supine-hip-internal-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Cross your left ankle over your right knee to create a figure-4 position, then gently pull your right thigh toward your chest. Feel the stretch in your left hip.

standing-hip-marching.name: Standing Hip Marching
standing-hip-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, maintaining good posture with a slight core engagement. Place hands on a countertop or wall for balance if needed.
standing-hip-marching.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up toward your chest to a comfortable height, then lower and repeat on the opposite side in a marching pattern.
conditions_seen_in: hip fracture prevention exercises for elderly

supine-hip-external-rotation-stretch.name: Supine Hip External Rotation Stretch
supine-hip-external-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Relax your head and shoulders on the floor.
supine-hip-external-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Let your right knee fall outward toward the floor in an external rotation movement while keeping your left foot grounded. Hold this gentle stretch.

supine-hip-abduction-pillow.name: Supine Hip Abduction with Pillow
supine-hip-abduction-pillow.startPoseDescription: Lying on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. A pillow is placed between your knees to maintain proper alignment.
supine-hip-abduction-pillow.endPoseDescription: Press the top knee outward against the pillow, opening the hip to approximately 45 degrees while keeping your lower back neutral. Hold briefly and return to start position.

standing-hip-flexion-support.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Support
standing-hip-flexion-support.startPoseDescription: Standing upright facing a counter or chair for support, feet hip-width apart with weight evenly distributed. Your posture is tall with a slight knee bend.
standing-hip-flexion-support.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee forward and upward to waist height without leaning backward or twisting your trunk. Lower with control and repeat on the same side.

standing-hip-extension-dumbbell.name: Standing Hip Extension with Dumbbell
standing-hip-extension-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Standing upright facing a counter for support, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side. Your operative leg is slightly bent with weight distributed evenly.
standing-hip-extension-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Press your hip backward, extending the leg behind you while maintaining a neutral spine and level pelvis. Return to start position with control.

hamstring-stretches-supine.name: Hamstring Stretches Supine
hamstring-stretches-supine.startPoseDescription: Lying on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor for stability. Your other leg is extended upward with a towel or strap looped around the foot.
hamstring-stretches-supine.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the leg toward your chest using the towel until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh. Hold the stretch without bouncing.

single-leg-balance-unstable.name: Single Leg Balance on Unstable Surface
single-leg-balance-unstable.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg on a foam pad, balance board, or BOSU ball with arms at sides or extended for balance. Keep your standing leg slightly bent at the knee.
single-leg-balance-unstable.endPoseDescription: Maintain stable single-leg stance while the unstable surface challenges ankle stabilizers and peroneal muscles. Focus on minimal wobbling and controlled engagement.

calf-raises-flat.name: Calf Raises on Flat Surface
calf-raises-flat.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a wall or rail for light support if needed. Weight evenly distributed through both feet.
calf-raises-flat.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting heels off the ground while maintaining ankle stability. Lower back down with control to complete one repetition.

short-arc-quads-ankle-support.name: Short Arc Quads with Ankle Support
short-arc-quads-ankle-support.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with a small rolled towel under one knee, keeping that leg slightly bent. The other leg is extended relaxed on the floor.
short-arc-quads-ankle-support.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle and straighten the supported leg fully, lifting the heel slightly off the floor. Hold briefly then relax, building quadriceps strength to support ankle stability.

double-leg-heel-raises-stairs.name: Double Leg Heel Raises on Stairs
double-leg-heel-raises-stairs.startPoseDescription: Stand on a stair or step with balls of feet on the edge and heels hanging off, holding a rail for light support. Feet are hip-width apart.
double-leg-heel-raises-stairs.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting heels as high as possible while maintaining ankle control. Lower heels below step level for a deeper stretch and stronger contraction.

seated-achilles-stretch.name: Seated Achilles Stretch
seated-achilles-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with legs extended in front of you. Keep your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
seated-achilles-stretch.endPoseDescription: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot and gently pull your toes toward your shin, feeling a stretch in the back of your calf and Achilles tendon. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds.

standing-calf-raise.name: Standing Calf Raise
standing-calf-raise.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a wall or support for balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.
standing-calf-raise.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortably possible. Lower back down slowly with control and repeat.

resistance-band-achilles-flexion.name: Resistance Band Achilles Flexion
resistance-band-achilles-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot. Keep your knee straight and relaxed.
resistance-band-achilles-flexion.endPoseDescription: Point your foot away from your body against the band's resistance, fully plantarflexing the ankle. Hold for 2 seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.

wall-calf-stretch-bent-knee.name: Wall Calf Stretch with Bent Knee
wall-calf-stretch-bent-knee.startPoseDescription: Face a wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height, keeping your feet about 12 inches from the wall. Bend your knees slightly.
wall-calf-stretch-bent-knee.endPoseDescription: Keeping your heel on the ground, lunge forward gently with your front leg bent, feeling a deeper stretch in the lower calf and Achilles tendon. Hold for 30 seconds each side.

isometric-achilles-contraction.name: Isometric Achilles Contraction
isometric-achilles-contraction.startPoseDescription: Sit with your leg extended and loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the band firmly. Keep your knee straight.
isometric-achilles-contraction.endPoseDescription: Push your foot downward against the band's resistance without any movement, holding a strong contraction for 6-10 seconds. Relax and repeat.

four-way-ankle-resistance.name: Four-Way Ankle Resistance (with towel)
four-way-ankle-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your injured leg extended in front of you. Loop a rolled towel around the ball of your foot, holding both ends with your hands for gentle resistance.
four-way-ankle-resistance.endPoseDescription: Perform ankle movements in four directions: point your toes down, pull toes up toward shin, turn sole inward, and turn sole outward. Hold each movement for 2 seconds against the towel resistance.

calf-raises-supported.name: Calf Raises (supported)
calf-raises-supported.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or sturdy chair with fingertips lightly touching for balance. Keep your feet hip-width apart with your weight distributed evenly on both feet.
calf-raises-supported.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining light contact with the wall for balance. Lower heels back down slowly and with control.

single-leg-balance-supported.name: Single-Leg Balance (supported)
single-leg-balance-supported.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or chair with your fingertips lightly resting on it for support. Keep your weight on your non-injured leg.
single-leg-balance-supported.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your injured foot slightly off the ground, balancing on your non-injured leg for 10-20 seconds. Maintain a light touch on the wall for safety and gradually reduce support as balance improves.

hamstring-stretches-seated.name: Hamstring Stretches (seated)
hamstring-stretches-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your uninjured leg extended straight out in front of you. Keep your back straight and your hands resting on your lap.
hamstring-stretches-seated.endPoseDescription: Gently lean forward at the hips, lowering your torso toward your extended leg while keeping your back straight. Feel a gentle stretch in the back of your thigh and hold for 20-30 seconds.

hip-abduction-standing-supported.name: Hip Abduction (standing, supported)
hip-abduction-standing-supported.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways next to a wall or chair with your fingertips resting lightly on it for balance. Keep your feet together and your posture upright.
hip-abduction-standing-supported.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your injured leg out to the side, keeping your toes pointing forward and your body upright. Raise your leg 12-18 inches off the ground and lower it back down with control.

ankle-dorsiflexion-resistance.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion with Resistance Band
ankle-dorsiflexion-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your legs extended in front of you. Place a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the ends in your hands.
ankle-dorsiflexion-resistance.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes toward your shin against the band resistance, creating tension in the front of your ankle. Hold briefly at the top of the movement.

single-leg-balance-firm.name: Single-Leg Balance on Firm Surface
single-leg-balance-firm.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides or extended for light balance. Shift your weight to one leg.
single-leg-balance-firm.endPoseDescription: Balance on one leg with the opposite knee bent at 90 degrees, maintaining an upright posture. Keep your standing ankle stable throughout.

calf-raises-dumbbell.name: Calf Raises with Dumbbell
calf-raises-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand, with feet hip-width apart. Keep your weight on the balls of your feet.
calf-raises-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto your toes, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining balance. Lower back down with control.

plantarflexion-dumbbell.name: Plantarflexion with Dumbbell Weight
plantarflexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg extended and place a light dumbbell on top of your forefoot. Keep your leg relaxed on the chair.
plantarflexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward against the dumbbell weight, engaging your calf muscles. Hold the end position briefly before returning to start.

anterior-tibialis-stretch.name: Seated Anterior Tibialis Stretch
anterior-tibialis-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, creating a figure-4 position. Keep your back straight.
anterior-tibialis-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press the top of the crossed foot downward and curl your toes toward the sole of your foot. Feel a stretch in the front of your ankle and shin.

lateral-ankle-stability-reach.name: Lateral Ankle Stability with Dumbbell Reach
lateral-ankle-stability-reach.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg holding a light dumbbell at your side, keeping your core engaged and standing leg stable. Focus on the ankle of your support leg.
lateral-ankle-stability-reach.endPoseDescription: Reach the dumbbell across your body and toward the ground in a controlled manner, challenging your ankle stabilizers. Return to standing position.

dorsiflexion-hold-gravity.name: Dorsiflexion Hold Against Gravity
dorsiflexion-hold-gravity.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended, feet pointing toward the ceiling. Keep your arms at your sides.
dorsiflexion-hold-gravity.endPoseDescription: Pull both feet toward your shins against gravity, engaging your anterior tibialis muscles. Hold this dorsiflexed position for several seconds.

inversion-eversion-strengthening.name: Inversion and Eversion Strengthening
inversion-eversion-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg extended and a resistance band looped around your forefoot. Hold both ends of the band.
inversion-eversion-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion), then outward (eversion) against the band resistance. Perform controlled movements through the full range available.

wrist-pronation-supination-band.name: Wrist Pronation/Supination with Resistance Band
wrist-pronation-supination-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, elbow bent at 90 degrees with a resistance band looped around your hand. Start with your palm facing down (pronated position).
wrist-pronation-supination-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm so your palm faces upward (supinated position) against the resistance of the band. Return to start and repeat with controlled movement.

eccentric-wrist-flexion.name: Eccentric Wrist Flexion
eccentric-wrist-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing up and wrist bent upward. Your opposite hand assists to lift the weight.
eccentric-wrist-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower the dumbbell by extending your wrist downward in a controlled eccentric motion over 3-5 seconds. Lower until your wrist is in slight extension.

radial-ulnar-deviation.name: Radial/Ulnar Deviation
radial-ulnar-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, elbow bent at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell vertically like a hammer. Start with your wrist in a neutral position.
radial-ulnar-deviation.endPoseDescription: Move your wrist side to side, tilting toward your thumb (radial deviation) and toward your pinky (ulnar deviation). Move through a comfortable range without forcing the motion.

forearm-plank-hand-variation.name: Forearm Plank with Hand Position Variation
forearm-plank-hand-variation.startPoseDescription: Start in a forearm plank position with your forearms on the ground, shoulders directly above elbows, and your body in a straight line. Keep your core engaged and neutral spine.
forearm-plank-hand-variation.endPoseDescription: Maintain the plank while alternately straightening each arm one at a time, supporting your weight on your hands in a modified push-up position. Return to forearm plank and alternate.

elbow-flexion-eccentric.name: Elbow Flexion/Extension Eccentric Training
elbow-flexion-eccentric.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected arm resting on a table, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing up and elbow bent at 90 degrees. Use your opposite hand to help lift the weight.
elbow-flexion-eccentric.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower the dumbbell by extending your elbow over 3-5 seconds in a controlled eccentric motion. Control the descent to maximize therapeutic benefit for the medial epicondyle.

supine-wrist-pronation-stretch.name: Supine Wrist Pronation Stretch
supine-wrist-pronation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with your affected arm extended out to the side at shoulder height, elbow straight, and palm facing up. Keep your shoulder relaxed and stable.
supine-wrist-pronation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your palm downward toward the floor to internally rotate your shoulder and stretch the forearm musculature. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds without forcing.

elbow-extension-band.name: Elbow Extension with Resistance Band
elbow-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, keeping the upper arm stationary against your side. Loop a resistance band around your forearm and hold the other end with your opposite hand for resistance.
elbow-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly straighten your affected arm by extending the elbow against the band resistance. Hold the fully extended position for 1-2 seconds before returning to the start position.

forearm-pronation-supination-band.name: Pronation and Supination with Band
forearm-pronation-supination-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your body with the palm facing up. Attach a resistance band to a light object or hold it with your opposite hand for resistance.
forearm-pronation-supination-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm downward (pronation) against the band resistance. Return to the start position, then repeat the opposite motion to supinate (palm up).

bicep-curl-band.name: Bicep Curl with Resistance Band
bicep-curl-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, stepping on a resistance band with both feet. Hold the band handles at your sides with palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
bicep-curl-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and curl your hands upward toward your shoulders against the band resistance. Keep your upper arms stationary and lower slowly back to the starting position.

tricep-extension-band.name: Tricep Extension with Band
tricep-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band overhead with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees behind your head. Keep your core engaged and upper arms pointing upward.
tricep-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Extend your elbows upward to straighten your arms while holding the band overhead. Maintain control and return to the bent position without letting your elbows flare out to the sides.

isometric-elbow-flexion.name: Isometric Elbow Flexion
isometric-elbow-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit with your affected elbow bent at approximately 90 degrees, tucked against your body. Place your opposite hand against your affected forearm for resistance.
isometric-elbow-flexion.endPoseDescription: Push your affected forearm upward into your opposite hand while maintaining the 90-degree elbow angle without any movement. Hold this static contraction for 5-10 seconds and relax.

thumb-opposition-stretch.name: Thumb Opposition Stretch
thumb-opposition-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is extended naturally away from your fingers.
thumb-opposition-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently press your thumb across your palm toward your pinky finger using your opposite hand. Hold the stretch feeling a gentle pull along the thumb side of your forearm.

isometric-thumb-abduction.name: Isometric Thumb Abduction
isometric-thumb-abduction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Your thumb is extended away from your fingers in a relaxed position.
isometric-thumb-abduction.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb firmly away from your fingers against resistance from your opposite hand, holding steady without movement. Maintain the contraction for 5 seconds.

wrist-extension-thumb.name: Wrist Extension with Thumb
wrist-extension-thumb.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Your wrist and thumb are in a neutral, relaxed position.
wrist-extension-thumb.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift your hand upward at the wrist, extending it gently while keeping your forearm on the table. Move through a comfortable range without forcing the motion.

finger-isolation-flexion.name: Finger Isolation Flexion
finger-isolation-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your hand resting on a table, palm facing down with fingers extended. Your wrist is in a neutral position.
finger-isolation-flexion.endPoseDescription: Curl each finger individually into your palm one at a time, starting with the thumb, then release. Move slowly and deliberately through each finger.

pronation-supination.name: Pronation and Supination
pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees, forearm extended forward with your palm facing inward. Your opposite hand rests at your side.
pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supination), then back to palm facing down (pronation). Move through a comfortable range at a slow, controlled pace.

grip-relaxation-technique.name: Grip Relaxation Technique
grip-relaxation-technique.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arms resting on a table in front of you. Make a gentle fist with both hands, lightly squeezing your fingers into your palms.
grip-relaxation-technique.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your hands fully, spreading all fingers wide apart and relaxing completely. Hold this open, relaxed position for 3-5 seconds before repeating.

isolated-finger-lifts.name: Isolated Finger Lifts
isolated-finger-lifts.startPoseDescription: Place your hand flat on a table with all fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your palm and other fingers in contact with the table surface.
isolated-finger-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift one finger at a time off the table while keeping the others down. Hold for 2 seconds at the top before lowering.

dumbbell-wrist-curls.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curls
dumbbell-wrist-curls.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up, holding a light dumbbell. Your hand hangs slightly off the edge of the table.
dumbbell-wrist-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl your wrist upward, lifting the dumbbell while keeping your forearm still on the table. Lower slowly back to start position.

finger-resistance-band.name: Finger Resistance Band Exercises
finger-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with a resistance band looped around your fingers and anchored under your foot or held in your other hand. Your fingers are relaxed and slightly curled.
finger-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Extend all your fingers against the resistance of the band in a spreading motion. Control the movement and return to the starting position slowly.

hand-intrinsic-muscle-strengthening.name: Hand Intrinsic Muscle Strengthening
hand-intrinsic-muscle-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand flat on a table with fingers extended and relaxed. Keep your palm in contact with the table surface.
hand-intrinsic-muscle-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Spread all fingers apart as wide as comfortable against mild resistance, then bring them back together. Perform this movement slowly and controlled.

supine-shoulder-flexion-slides.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion Slides
supine-shoulder-flexion-slides.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a smooth surface with your affected arm at your side, palm down. Keep your elbow straight throughout the movement.
supine-shoulder-flexion-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arm overhead along the surface, raising your shoulder into flexion as far as comfortable. Return to the starting position and repeat.

isometric-shoulder-internal-rotation.name: Isometric Shoulder Internal Rotation
isometric-shoulder-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected elbow bent to 90 degrees and held against your ribcage. Place your hand against your abdomen with a small towel roll between your elbow and ribs.
isometric-shoulder-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Press your hand inward against your abdomen, creating tension in the internal rotators without moving your elbow. Hold this isometric contraction for 5-10 seconds.

isometric-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Isometric Shoulder External Rotation
isometric-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected elbow bent to 90 degrees and held against your ribcage. Make a fist with your hand in front of your body with a towel roll between your elbow and ribs.
isometric-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Press your fist outward against the towel roll, creating tension in the external rotators without allowing movement. Maintain the isometric hold for 5-10 seconds.

supine-scapular-squeezes.name: Supine Scapular Squeezes
supine-scapular-squeezes.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your elbows slightly bent and shoulders relaxed.
supine-scapular-squeezes.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and downward, pulling them toward the spine. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds, then relax.

prone-y-t-w-raises.name: Prone Prone Y-T-W Raises
prone-y-t-w-raises.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your arms hanging straight down from your shoulders. Your feet should be planted on the floor for stability.
prone-y-t-w-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms overhead in a 'Y' position, then lower and raise in a 'T' position, then finally in a 'W' position. Perform controlled movements with light weights or bodyweight.

seated-rows-resistance-band.name: Seated Rows with Resistance Band
seated-rows-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your legs extended in front of you and a resistance band looped around your feet. Hold the band handles with both hands, allowing your arms to extend forward with slight tension.
seated-rows-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your elbows close to your body and return slowly to the starting position.

doorway-pectoralis-stretch.name: Doorway Pectoralis Stretch
doorway-pectoralis-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your affected elbow bent to 90 degrees and forearm against the doorframe at shoulder height. Step one foot forward.
doorway-pectoralis-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean your body forward, stretching your pectoralis muscle and anterior shoulder. Hold for 20-30 seconds without exceeding comfortable range of motion.

hamstring-curls-with-band.name: Hamstring Curls with Band
hamstring-curls-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended and a resistance band looped around your feet. Place your arms under your forehead for comfort.
hamstring-curls-with-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your knees and curl your heels toward your glutes against the band resistance, keeping your hips on the floor. Hold briefly at the top of the movement.

knee-extension-with-band.name: Knee Extension with Band
knee-extension-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair or bench with a resistance band looped around your knee and anchored to a stable point in front of you. Keep your back against the support.
knee-extension-with-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten your knee fully against the band resistance, extending your lower leg outward. Hold briefly at full extension and return to the starting position.

single-leg-balance-with-band.name: Single-Leg Balance with Band Support
single-leg-balance-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a resistance band anchored at chest height for light support. Keep your core engaged and eyes focused on a fixed point.
single-leg-balance-with-band.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg slightly off the ground and balance on the other leg for 20-30 seconds, lightly using the band for stability as needed. Switch legs and repeat.

neck-isometric-neutral.name: Neck Isometric Hold - Neutral
neck-isometric-neutral.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your shoulders relaxed and your head in a neutral position facing forward. Your hands rest gently on your thighs.
neck-isometric-neutral.endPoseDescription: Place your hand against your forehead and press your head forward into your hand without allowing any movement, holding steady tension for the duration. Maintain a neutral neck alignment with no flexion or extension occurring.

supine-leg-slides.name: Supine Leg Slides
supine-leg-slides.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a firm surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Your arms rest at your sides with palms down, and your spine maintains its natural curve with a neutral pelvis.
supine-leg-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide one leg straight out along the floor, straightening the knee while maintaining contact with the ground. Keep your pelvis stable and your lower back neutral, then slide the leg back to the bent position.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

seated-cat-cow.name: Seated Cat-Cow
seated-cat-cow.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs or clasped gently in front of your chest. Your spine is in a neutral, lengthened position.
seated-cat-cow.endPoseDescription: Round your spine by bringing your chin toward your chest and rounding your shoulders forward (cat phase). Then arch gently by lifting your chest, tilting your chin slightly upward, and engaging your upper back (cow phase).

standing-marching-place.name: Standing Marching in Place
standing-marching-place.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at your sides or resting on a countertop for balance if needed. Your posture is tall with shoulders relaxed and gaze forward.
standing-marching-place.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one knee up to a comfortable height while maintaining upright posture, then lower it and alternate to the other side in a gentle marching rhythm. Keep your core engaged and your movements controlled throughout.

dumbbell-deadlifts-light.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts (Light)
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Keep your chest up and shoulders back with a neutral spine.
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips while keeping a slight bend in your knees, lowering the dumbbells to mid-shin height. Maintain a neutral back and return to standing by driving through your heels.

sidelying-external-rotation-band.name: Sidelying External Rotation with Band
sidelying-external-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your left side with your right shoulder flexed to 90 degrees and elbow bent to 90 degrees. Hold a resistance band with your right hand at chest level.
sidelying-external-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Externally rotate your shoulder by rotating your forearm upward against the band resistance. Keep your elbow fixed at your ribs and control the return to starting position.

prone-horizontal-abduction-100.name: Prone Horizontal Abduction at 100 Degrees
prone-horizontal-abduction-100.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with chest supported and arms hanging down at your sides. Thumbs face forward in a neutral grip position.
prone-horizontal-abduction-100.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms to approximately 100 degrees of horizontal abduction (slightly higher than shoulder height) with thumbs pointing up. Squeeze the shoulder blades and lower with control.

thoracic-spine-rotation-foam-roller.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation with Foam Roller
thoracic-spine-rotation-foam-roller.startPoseDescription: Lie supine with a foam roller positioned horizontally under your mid-back at the level of your shoulder blades. Knees are bent with feet on the floor and hands behind your head.
thoracic-spine-rotation-foam-roller.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to the right, dropping your right elbow toward the floor while keeping the foam roller under your mid-back. Return to center and repeat on the left side.

quadruped-thoracic-rotation-band.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation with Band
quadruped-thoracic-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your right arm near your body. Keep your hips stable and core engaged.
quadruped-thoracic-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your right elbow toward the ceiling, opening up through the chest and thoracic spine while resisting the band. Return to center and complete all reps before switching sides.

pallof-press-band.name: Pallof Press with Band
pallof-press-band.startPoseDescription: Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold the band at chest height with both hands, resisting the rotational force.
pallof-press-band.endPoseDescription: Press the band straight out in front of you while maintaining a stable torso and resisting rotation. Return to chest and repeat all reps before switching sides.

banded-good-morning.name: Banded Good Morning
banded-good-morning.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and loop a resistance band around your neck and hold the ends. Keep your knees slightly bent and your spine neutral.
banded-good-morning.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso while maintaining a straight back and neutral spine. Return to standing by driving through your heels and engaging your posterior chain.

balance-single-leg-stance.name: Balance Training - Single Leg Stance
balance-single-leg-stance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together, with one hand on a wall or sturdy chair for light support. Engage your core and keep your gaze fixed ahead.
balance-single-leg-stance.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg slightly off the ground, balancing on the opposite leg while maintaining an upright posture. Gradually reduce hand support as balance improves.

prone-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Dumbbell
prone-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench or incline with your chest supported and a light dumbbell in your right hand, arm hanging down. Your forehead rests on the bench for stability.
prone-shoulder-flexion-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbell forward and upward to shoulder height, leading with your thumb pointing up. Pause at the top while maintaining control, then lower back to the starting position.

external-rotation-dumbbell.name: External Rotation with Dumbbell
external-rotation-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a light dumbbell in your right hand with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked against your ribs. Your forearm points forward across your body.
external-rotation-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Rotate the dumbbell outward away from your body, keeping your elbow fixed at your side. Stop when your forearm is perpendicular to your body, then control the weight back to the starting position.

lying-dumbbell-pullover.name: Lying Dumbbell Pullover
lying-dumbbell-pullover.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a light dumbbell with both hands above your chest with arms slightly bent. Your shoulders are relaxed into the bench.
lying-dumbbell-pullover.endPoseDescription: Lower the dumbbell in an arc over your head toward the floor behind you, allowing a gentle stretch across your chest and shoulders. Return the dumbbell back to the starting position with control.

quadruped-thoracic-rotations.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotations
quadruped-thoracic-rotations.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place one hand behind your head with the elbow pointing out to the side.
quadruped-thoracic-rotations.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso, bringing your elbow toward the opposite knee, then rotate back to open your chest toward the ceiling. Perform all reps on one side before switching.

chest-stretch-doorframe.name: Chest Stretch with Doorframe
chest-stretch-doorframe.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with one arm raised to 90 degrees, forearm against the doorframe. Step forward through the doorway.
chest-stretch-doorframe.endPoseDescription: Keep your forearm on the doorframe and lean your body forward through the doorway to feel a stretch across your chest and anterior shoulder. Hold the stretch position maintaining steady breathing.

reverse-pec-flyes.name: Reverse Pec Flyes
reverse-pec-flyes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells in hand and arms bent at 90 degrees, elbows at shoulder height. Your palms should face inward.
reverse-pec-flyes.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc motion, squeezing your rear deltoids and upper back muscles at the end of the movement. Return to start position with controlled movement.

resistance-band-reverse-pec-flyes.name: Resistance Band Reverse Pec Flyes
resistance-band-reverse-pec-flyes.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor and a resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended forward. Your shoulders should be relaxed and spine neutral.
resistance-band-reverse-pec-flyes.endPoseDescription: Pull the band outward and backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together as your arms move to your sides. Your chest opens and upper back engages fully.

band-assisted-thoracic-extension.name: Band-Assisted Thoracic Extension
band-assisted-thoracic-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with a resistance band looped around your upper back below your shoulders, holding both ends across your chest. Your feet are flat on the floor.
band-assisted-thoracic-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently arch backward using the band as light assistance, extending through your thoracic spine while maintaining a neutral neck. Your chest opens toward the ceiling.

resistance-band-face-pulls.name: Resistance Band Face Pulls
resistance-band-face-pulls.startPoseDescription: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at eye level with both hands, arms extended forward. The band should be taut with slight tension.
resistance-band-face-pulls.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your face, separating your hands as they approach, with elbows high and wide. Your shoulder blades squeeze together as the band reaches near your temples.

reverse-snow-angels.name: Reverse Snow Angels
reverse-snow-angels.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a bed or mat with arms at your sides and forehead resting on a small pillow. Keep your legs straight and relaxed.
reverse-snow-angels.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms out to the sides in a snow angel motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your arms should form a 'T' shape with your body.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

chin-tucks-resistance.name: Chin Tucks with Resistance
chin-tucks-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and eyes forward. Place your fingers lightly under your chin.
chin-tucks-resistance.endPoseDescription: Gently press your chin backward against the resistance of your fingers while maintaining a level gaze. Hold briefly without moving your head down.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

thoracic-spine-extension.name: Thoracic Spine Extension
thoracic-spine-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and clasp your hands behind your head at the base of your skull. Keep your elbows wide.
thoracic-spine-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your upper back over the chair, using your hands to support your head without forcing it backward. Look slightly upward while maintaining a comfortable extension.
conditions_seen_in: desk worker upper back and neck pain

shoulder-shrugs-dumbbells.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbells
shoulder-shrugs-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing inward. Keep your arms straight and shoulders relaxed downward.
shoulder-shrugs-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Elevate both shoulders toward your ears in a shrugging motion, pausing briefly at the top. Return to the starting position with controlled movement.

overhead-dumbbell-press.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
overhead-dumbbell-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent at 90 degrees and palms facing forward. Engage your core and maintain neutral spine alignment.
overhead-dumbbell-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead, extending your arms fully while maintaining control. Keep your core tight and avoid arching your lower back excessively.

cervical-neck-stretches.name: Cervical Neck Stretches
cervical-neck-stretches.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with neutral posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your hands resting in your lap or on your thighs.
cervical-neck-stretches.endPoseDescription: Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch on the left side of your neck. Hold briefly, then repeat on the opposite side.

standing-hamstring-stretch.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
standing-hamstring-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart facing forward with a slight knee bend. Place your hands on your hips or a support surface.
standing-hamstring-stretch.endPoseDescription: Step your right foot forward and straighten the leg, hinging forward at the hips while keeping your back flat. Feel the stretch along the back of your right thigh.

standing-chest-shoulder-stretch.name: Standing Chest and Shoulder Stretch
standing-chest-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy structure with feet hip-width apart. Place your right forearm on the surface at shoulder height with elbow bent at 90 degrees.
standing-chest-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso gently away from the wall, keeping your forearm in contact with the surface. Feel a stretch across your chest and front shoulder.

child-pose.name: Prone Child's Pose
child-pose.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees on a mat with shoulders over wrists and hips over knees. Engage your core lightly to maintain stability.
child-pose.endPoseDescription: Sink your hips back toward your heels while extending your arms forward and lowering your forehead to the ground. Feel a gentle stretch through your back and shoulders.

calf-stretch-against-wall.name: Calf Stretch Against Wall
calf-stretch-against-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with feet hip-width apart and hands on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body upright and core engaged.
calf-stretch-against-wall.endPoseDescription: Step your right foot back and keep your heel planted while maintaining a straight leg. Lean slightly into the wall to deepen the stretch in your right calf.

resistance-band-shoulder-pull-apart.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Pull-Apart
resistance-band-shoulder-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands, arms straight and band taut. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
resistance-band-shoulder-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

seated-torso-rotation-band.name: Seated Torso Rotation with Band
seated-torso-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding a resistance band across your chest with both hands at shoulder height. Keep your core engaged and spine tall.
seated-torso-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, pulling gently on the band to deepen the twist. Return to center and repeat on the other side, maintaining an upright posture throughout.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

prone-thoracic-rotation-band.name: Prone Thoracic Rotation with Band
prone-thoracic-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head on the ground. Keep your legs straight and core engaged.
prone-thoracic-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the band toward the floor beside you, rotating through your mid-back. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: general flexibility improvement for sedentary adult

standing-shoulder-abduction.name: Standing Shoulder Abduction
standing-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms hanging naturally at your sides with palms facing your thighs. Your posture is upright with shoulders relaxed and your gaze forward.
standing-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms out to the sides and upward in a controlled motion, lifting them to approximately shoulder height or slightly higher. Your arms move in a smooth arc away from your body with a slight bend in the elbows.

quadruped-shoulder-flexion.name: Quadruped Shoulder Flexion
quadruped-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists directly under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Your neck is neutral with your gaze toward the floor, maintaining a flat back.
quadruped-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Extend one arm forward and upward, reaching it diagonally across your body and overhead as far as comfortable. Your arm moves through overhead flexion while your torso and opposite arm remain stable and supportive.

seated-ankle-dorsiflexion.name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion with Resistance
seated-ankle-dorsiflexion.startPoseDescription: Sit on a chair or bench with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Wrap a light dumbbell or resistance band around the ball of one foot.
seated-ankle-dorsiflexion.endPoseDescription: Pull your toes upward toward your shin, creating tension through the front of the ankle and lower leg. Hold briefly at the top of the movement against the resistance.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

wall-squat-hold.name: Wall Squat Hold
wall-squat-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and positioned about 12 inches away from the wall. Hold dumbbells at your sides.
wall-squat-hold.endPoseDescription: Slide down the wall until your thighs are parallel to the ground and knees bend at 90 degrees. Maintain this isometric position, keeping your chest upright and weight in your heels.

pigeon-pose-hold.name: Pigeon Pose Hold
pigeon-pose-hold.startPoseDescription: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Bring one knee forward behind your wrists in a bent position.
pigeon-pose-hold.endPoseDescription: Lower your hips toward the ground, keeping your front leg bent and back leg extended straight. Fold your torso forward over the front leg to deepen the hip and ankle stretch.

modified-wall-pushups.name: Modified Push-ups (Wall or Incline)
modified-wall-pushups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or incline bench at arm's length away with hands placed shoulder-width apart on the surface. Your body should form a straight line from head to heels with core engaged.
modified-wall-pushups.endPoseDescription: Lower your chest toward the wall or bench by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle from your body. Return to starting position by pressing through your hands.

kegel-pelvic-floor.name: Pelvic Floor Exercises (Kegels)
kegel-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with your back supported and feet flat on the floor. Relax your abdominal, buttock, and thigh muscles completely.
kegel-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Contract your pelvic floor muscles (the muscles you use to stop urination midstream) for 3-5 seconds, then fully relax for the same duration. Maintain normal breathing throughout.

quadruped-leg-lifts.name: Quadruped Leg Lifts
quadruped-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips, maintaining a neutral spine. Your neck should be neutral and core gently engaged.
quadruped-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg behind you to hip height with a bent knee, squeezing your glute at the top. Keep your lower back stable and return to starting position.

supported-squats.name: Supported Squats (with Chair or Bar)
supported-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart facing a chair or barre with hands lightly on it for balance. Keep your chest upright and weight in your heels.
supported-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending at the hips and knees as if sitting into a chair, keeping your chest up and knees behind your toes. Return to standing by pressing through your heels.

side-lying-leg-lifts.name: Side-Lying Leg Lifts
side-lying-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended and head resting on it, legs stacked together. Engage your core and keep your torso stable.
side-lying-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift your top leg to hip height while maintaining a slight forward angle of the leg, then lower it back down without touching your bottom leg. Keep your upper body still throughout.

stationary-marching.name: Stationary Marching in Place
stationary-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides, and core engaged. Maintain an upright posture with shoulders relaxed.
stationary-marching.endPoseDescription: March in place by lifting one knee up to hip height while swinging the opposite arm forward, alternating in a steady rhythm. Keep your movements controlled and breathing steady.

standing-hip-circles.name: Standing Hip Circles
standing-hip-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips for balance. Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
standing-hip-circles.endPoseDescription: Make slow, controlled circles with your hips, moving in one direction for several rotations, then reversing. Keep your upper body stable and avoid leaning side to side.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

banded-dead-bug.name: Banded Dead Bug
banded-dead-bug.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band taut between your hands above your chest.
banded-dead-bug.endPoseDescription: Extend your right leg straight while pressing your left arm overhead, keeping the band tight. Return to start and alternate sides in a controlled manner.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

banded-bird-dog.name: Banded Bird Dog
banded-bird-dog.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one foot. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
banded-bird-dog.endPoseDescription: Extend the banded leg straight back while simultaneously reaching the opposite arm forward. Maintain a straight line from fingertips to heel.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

banded-superman.name: Banded Superman
banded-superman.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band held in both hands extended above your head. Keep your legs straight and forehead neutral on the floor.
banded-superman.endPoseDescription: Pull the band down toward your sides while lifting your chest and legs off the ground. Squeeze your back muscles and hold briefly at the top.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

banded-side-plank-hip-abduction.name: Banded Side Plank with Hip Abduction
banded-side-plank-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your forearm on the ground and a resistance band looped around your thighs. Stack your feet and lift your hips off the ground.
banded-side-plank-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Maintain the side plank position while abducting your top hip, pressing it upward against the band resistance. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

banded-quadruped-reach.name: Banded Quadruped Reach
banded-quadruped-reach.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around both feet. Keep your core tight and back flat.
banded-quadruped-reach.endPoseDescription: Reach one arm forward while simultaneously sliding the opposite knee out to the side against the band. Return to center and alternate sides smoothly.
conditions_seen_in: core strengthening for lower back prevention

heel-toe-raises.name: Heel-Toe Raises
heel-toe-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands resting on a wall or sturdy surface for balance. Keep your body upright and core engaged.
heel-toe-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as comfortable. Lower heels down and then lift your toes, rocking back onto your heels.

standing-chest-squeeze.name: Standing Chest Squeeze
standing-chest-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and bring your hands up to chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed and down.
standing-chest-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Press your palms together firmly in front of your chest, squeezing your chest muscles. Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds, then release and repeat.

standing-knee-lifts.name: Standing Knee Lifts
standing-knee-lifts.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands resting on a chair back or wall for balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.
standing-knee-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest while keeping your standing leg straight and core tight. Lower your leg back down with control and repeat before switching sides.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

standing-torso-twist.name: Standing Torso Twist
standing-torso-twist.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands behind your head with elbows out to the sides. Keep your hips still and facing forward.
standing-torso-twist.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper body to one side, moving only from the waist and rib cage. Return to center and twist to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

dumbbell-step-up.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
dumbbell-step-up.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a bench or sturdy step, holding dumbbells at your sides. Position one foot on the elevated surface with your other foot on the ground.
dumbbell-step-up.endPoseDescription: Drive through your front heel to step up and stand tall on the bench. Bring your back knee up toward your chest to fully engage the movement.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

quad-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Quadriceps and Hip Flexor Stretch
quad-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted in front, hands on the ground for balance. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.
quad-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Push your hips forward and slightly arch your back to feel a stretch in the front of your back leg's hip and thigh. Hold the stretch while maintaining an upright posture.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

hamstring-hip-stretch.name: Hamstring and Hip Stretch
hamstring-hip-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit on the ground with one leg extended and the other bent with the foot toward your inner thigh. Sit upright with a tall spine.
hamstring-hip-stretch.endPoseDescription: Fold forward over your extended leg, allowing your hands to slide down toward your foot. Keep your back flat and feel the stretch along the back of your thigh and hip.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

shoulder-rolls-stretches.name: Shoulder Rolls and Stretches
shoulder-rolls-stretches.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Maintain good posture with shoulders down and back.
shoulder-rolls-stretches.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll your shoulders backward in a circular motion, then reverse and roll forward. Gently bring each arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder.

modified-plank-hold.name: Modified Plank Hold
modified-plank-hold.startPoseDescription: Begin on your forearms and knees with elbows under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your neck neutral and core engaged.
modified-plank-hold.endPoseDescription: Hold a straight line from your knees through your hips to your shoulders, maintaining tension in your core and avoiding sagging. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

resistance-band-chest-opener.name: Resistance Band Chest Opener
resistance-band-chest-opener.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band at shoulder width in front of your chest with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
resistance-band-chest-opener.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull the band apart by moving your hands outward and back, opening your chest and engaging your upper back. Pause briefly while maintaining tension in the band.

progressive-muscle-relaxation-lower-body.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation - Lower Body
progressive-muscle-relaxation-lower-body.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides in a comfortable position. Take several deep, slow breaths to begin relaxing.
progressive-muscle-relaxation-lower-body.endPoseDescription: Tense all the muscles in your legs and glutes for 5 seconds, then completely release and relax. Focus on the sensation of relaxation as tension melts away from your lower body.

resistance-band-pull-apart-overhead.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart - Overhead
resistance-band-pull-apart-overhead.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and hold a resistance band overhead with hands shoulder-width apart and arms extended. Keep your core engaged.
resistance-band-pull-apart-overhead.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull the band down and back behind your head, stretching across your chest and shoulders. Return to the starting position with controlled movement.

seated-neck-relaxation.name: Seated Neck Relaxation
seated-neck-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and looking straight ahead. Keep your back tall and your hands resting on your thighs.
seated-neck-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a gentle stretch along the left side of your neck. Breathe deeply and hold before returning to center.

resistance-band-row-seated.name: Resistance Band Row - Seated
resistance-band-row-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with legs extended and a resistance band looped around your feet, holding the ends with arms extended forward. Keep your spine tall and shoulders back.
resistance-band-row-seated.endPoseDescription: Pull the band ends toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together and engaging your back muscles. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

deep-diaphragmatic-breathing.name: Deep Diaphragmatic Breathing
deep-diaphragmatic-breathing.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and feet flat on the floor, one hand on your chest and one on your belly. Relax your shoulders and jaw.
deep-diaphragmatic-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose, allowing your belly to expand while your chest remains relatively still. Exhale slowly through your mouth, feeling your body sink deeper into relaxation.

dumbbell-walking-lunges.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
dumbbell-walking-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Your shoulders are back and core is engaged.
dumbbell-walking-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees. Your back knee hovers just above the ground.

dumbbell-shoulder-press.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
dumbbell-shoulder-press.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Your core is braced and shoulders are packed down.
dumbbell-shoulder-press.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion until your arms are nearly fully extended. Your shoulders remain stable without excessive arching.

dumbbell-bicep-curls.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
dumbbell-bicep-curls.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward. Your elbows remain stationary against your ribs.
dumbbell-bicep-curls.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending at the elbows. Your upper arms stay fixed and only the forearms move throughout the exercise.

plank-with-dumbbell-rows.name: Plank with Dumbbell Rows
plank-with-dumbbell-rows.startPoseDescription: Assume a high plank position with hands on dumbbells positioned slightly wider than shoulder-width. Your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
plank-with-dumbbell-rows.endPoseDescription: Row one dumbbell toward your hip while stabilizing your core and preventing rotation. Return to center and alternate sides in a controlled manner.

bicep-curls-light-weights.name: Bicep Curls with Light Weights
bicep-curls-light-weights.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells (1-3 lbs) at your sides with palms facing forward. Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs and core tight.
bicep-curls-light-weights.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and curl the weights up toward your shoulders in a controlled motion. Pause at the top, then slowly lower back to the starting position.

resisted-shoulder-flexion.name: Resisted Shoulder Flexion
resisted-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Place one end of the resistance band under your feet and hold the other end in your affected hand with palm facing down.
resisted-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your affected arm forward and upward to shoulder height, keeping your elbow slightly bent. The resistance band should be taut throughout the movement.

resisted-shoulder-abduction.name: Resisted Shoulder Abduction
resisted-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and both arms at your sides. Secure the resistance band under your feet and hold both ends at your sides with palms facing inward.
resisted-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, keeping elbows slightly bent and maintaining tension on the band. The band should resist the lifting motion throughout.

resisted-internal-rotation.name: Resisted Internal Rotation
resisted-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees and positioned against your torso. Wrap the resistance band around your forearm and hold the other end securely in your opposite hand.
resisted-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm inward across your body against the band's resistance, keeping your elbow fixed at your side. Return slowly to the starting position with controlled movement.

resisted-external-rotation.name: Resisted External Rotation
resisted-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your torso. Secure the resistance band around your forearm with the opposite end anchored to your opposite side.
resisted-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward away from your body against the band's resistance, maintaining a 90-degree elbow bend. Move smoothly and return to center with control.

finger-flexion-band-resistance.name: Finger Flexion with Band Resistance
finger-flexion-band-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected forearm supported on a table, palm facing up. Loop a light resistance band around your fingers and hold the band's ends in your opposite hand.
finger-flexion-band-resistance.endPoseDescription: Curl your fingers inward against the band's resistance, making a fist while keeping your wrist stable. Slowly release to the starting position with controlled extension.

supine-shoulder-stretch-band.name: Supine Shoulder Stretch with Band
supine-shoulder-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both arms extended above your chest, holding the resistance band with a wide grip. Keep your shoulders relaxed and your lower back neutral.
supine-shoulder-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly pull the band apart horizontally across your chest, feeling a stretch across your shoulders and chest. Hold the stretch gently while maintaining steady breathing.

seated-elbow-flexion-band.name: Seated Elbow Flexion with Band
seated-elbow-flexion-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with feet flat on the floor, with the resistance band secured under your foot. Hold the band's handle in your affected hand with your arm extended downward.
seated-elbow-flexion-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder against the band's resistance. Lower your arm slowly to full extension with control.

supine-clamshells.name: Supine Clamshells
supine-clamshells.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
supine-clamshells.endPoseDescription: While keeping your feet together and lower back in contact with the floor, open one knee out to the side like a clamshell. Return to center and repeat on the other side.
conditions_seen_in: hip fracture prevention exercises for elderly

dumbbell-bicep-curls-light.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls (Light Weight)
dumbbell-bicep-curls-light.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides holding light dumbbells with palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your torso and core engaged.
dumbbell-bicep-curls-light.endPoseDescription: Slowly bend your elbows to lift the dumbbells toward your shoulders in a controlled manner. Lower the weights back down with control, maintaining proper elbow positioning throughout.

single-leg-squats.name: Single Leg Squats
single-leg-squats.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on one leg with the other leg lifted slightly in front of you, arms extended forward for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
single-leg-squats.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending the standing leg's knee to approximately 45-60 degrees, keeping your torso upright and weight in your heel. The lifted leg remains extended or slightly bent for counterbalance.

single-leg-balance-ball-toss.name: Single Leg Balance with Ball Toss
single-leg-balance-ball-toss.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a medicine ball at chest height with both hands. Keep your gaze focused forward and engage your core for stability.
single-leg-balance-ball-toss.endPoseDescription: Toss the medicine ball to a partner or wall while maintaining single-leg stance, then catch it and return to the starting position. Your standing leg remains stable with a slight knee bend throughout.

romanian-deadlifts.name: Romanian Deadlifts
romanian-deadlifts.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight knee bend. Keep your chest up and shoulders back with core engaged.
romanian-deadlifts.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells toward the floor while maintaining a slight knee bend, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings. Your torso remains straight as you lower to approximately hip level.

banded-pull-apart.name: Banded Pull-Apart
banded-pull-apart.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band at chest height with both arms extended straight out in front of you. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
banded-pull-apart.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement. Return to the center with control without allowing the band to snap back.

banded-triceps-extension.name: Banded Triceps Extension
banded-triceps-extension.startPoseDescription: Stand on one end of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height with your elbow bent. Keep your elbow close to your torso and upper arm stationary.
banded-triceps-extension.endPoseDescription: Extend your arm upward and slightly forward, straightening the elbow against the band resistance until your arm is nearly fully extended. Lower back to the starting position with controlled tension throughout.

supine-shoulder-abduction-slides.name: Supine Shoulder Abduction Slides
supine-shoulder-abduction-slides.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your elbows straight but not locked, and ensure your shoulders are relaxed away from your ears.
supine-shoulder-abduction-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your affected arm out to the side along the floor, moving it away from your body in an arc-like motion until you feel a gentle stretch. Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, keeping your arm in contact with the surface throughout the movement.

crossbody-shoulder-stretch.name: Crossbody Shoulder Stretch
crossbody-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and shoulders relaxed, with your affected arm hanging naturally at your side. Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged and gaze forward.
crossbody-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently grasp the elbow or upper arm of the affected side and pull it across your body toward your chest. Hold this position while maintaining an upright posture, feeling the stretch across the back of the shoulder and upper back.
