seated-shoulder-blade-retractions.name: Seated Shoulder Blade Retractions
seated-shoulder-blade-retractions.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a firm chair with your feet flat on the floor, your arms bent at 90 degrees with elbows at your sides, and palms facing forward. Maintain good posture and keep your shoulders relaxed.
seated-shoulder-blade-retractions.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your elbows backward, squeezing your shoulder blades together while keeping your arms bent at 90 degrees. Hold this contraction briefly, then slowly return your arms to the starting position without letting your shoulders shrug upward.

dumbbell-lateral-lunges.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunges
dumbbell-lateral-lunges.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together, holding a dumbbell at chest level with both hands, or one dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Maintain an upright posture with engaged core.
dumbbell-lateral-lunges.endPoseDescription: Step sideways and lower your body by bending one knee, keeping the opposite leg straight and chest upright. Push off your bent leg to return to the starting position.

calf-raises-with-dumbbells.name: Calf Raises with Dumbbells
calf-raises-with-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms straight. Keep your core tight and posture tall.
calf-raises-with-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the ground as high as possible while maintaining balance. Lower your heels back down with control and repeat.

pelvic-floor-kegels.name: Pelvic Floor Muscle Contractions (Kegels)
pelvic-floor-kegels.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees bent at 90 degrees. Relax your pelvic floor muscles completely.
pelvic-floor-kegels.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping the flow of urine, holding the contraction for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest for equal duration.

supine-pelvic-floor-activation.name: Supine Pelvic Floor Activation
supine-pelvic-floor-activation.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Arms are at your sides with palms down.
supine-pelvic-floor-activation.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles while maintaining steady breathing, holding the contraction for 5 seconds. Maintain neutral spine position throughout.

standing-hip-flexor-strengthening.name: Standing Hip Flexor Strengthening
standing-hip-flexor-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or sturdy support with hands lightly touching for balance. Feet are hip-width apart and weight is evenly distributed.
standing-hip-flexor-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee toward chest while maintaining upright posture and pelvic floor engagement. Hold the lifted position for 2 seconds, then lower slowly.

quadruped-pelvic-floor-hold.name: Quadruped Pelvic Floor Hold
quadruped-pelvic-floor-hold.startPoseDescription: Position yourself on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine with core gently engaged.
quadruped-pelvic-floor-hold.endPoseDescription: Contract the pelvic floor muscles strongly while maintaining stable quadruped position for 5 seconds. Keep breathing steady and avoid holding your breath.

standing-hip-adductor-squeeze.name: Standing Hip Adductor Squeeze
standing-hip-adductor-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on a support or wall for balance. Place a small pillow or foam pad between your thighs.
standing-hip-adductor-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the pad firmly between your thighs while contracting pelvic floor muscles simultaneously. Hold the squeeze for 5 seconds, maintaining upright posture.

prone-hip-extension-pelvic-floor.name: Prone Hip Extension with Pelvic Floor Engagement
prone-hip-extension-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with arms folded under your forehead and legs extended. Engage your pelvic floor muscles to prepare for movement.
prone-hip-extension-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg up about 12 inches while squeezing the glute and maintaining pelvic floor contraction. Keep the movement controlled and hold the top position for 2 seconds.

seated-deep-breathing-core.name: Seated Deep Breathing with Core Engagement
seated-deep-breathing-core.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with proper posture, feet flat on floor, and hands resting on your thighs. Take normal, relaxed breaths.
seated-deep-breathing-core.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply through the nose while relaxing pelvic floor, then exhale slowly while gently contracting pelvic floor and transverse abdominis. Complete 10 cycles of coordinated breathing.

hip-internal-rotation-stretch.name: Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
hip-internal-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, creating a figure-4 position.
hip-internal-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the bottom leg's thigh toward your chest using your hands behind the thigh, feeling a stretch in the hip and outer glute. Hold for 30 seconds and breathe deeply.

quadruped-pelvic-tilts.name: Quadruped Pelvic Tilts
quadruped-pelvic-tilts.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Keep your spine neutral with a slight natural curve in your lower back.
quadruped-pelvic-tilts.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your pelvis to round your lower back, drawing your belly button toward your spine. Return to neutral and repeat in a controlled, rhythmic motion.

resisted-hip-abduction.name: Resisted Hip Abduction
resisted-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your bottom leg slightly bent for stability and top leg straight. Place a resistance band around both legs just above the knees.
resisted-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Keep your top leg straight and lift it toward the ceiling, creating tension against the band. Lower back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

seated-pelvic-floor-awareness.name: Seated Pelvic Floor Awareness
seated-pelvic-floor-awareness.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees. Maintain good posture with a neutral spine.
seated-pelvic-floor-awareness.endPoseDescription: Practice gentle contractions and releases of the pelvic floor muscles, imagining stopping the flow of urination. Maintain relaxation between contractions and focus on slow, controlled movements.

resisted-glute-activation-band.name: Resisted Glute Activation with Band
resisted-glute-activation-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with a slight forward lean.
resisted-glute-activation-band.endPoseDescription: Press your knees outward against the band resistance while maintaining a half-squat position. Keep tension on the band and return to standing, squeezing your glutes.

cat-cow-mobility-stretch.name: Cat-Cow Mobility Stretch
cat-cow-mobility-stretch.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with wrists aligned under shoulders and knees under hips. Look slightly downward with a neutral spine.
cat-cow-mobility-stretch.endPoseDescription: Arch your back gently while lifting your gaze and chest toward the ceiling (cow position), then reverse into a rounded spine with head tucked (cat position). Move fluidly between positions.

child-pose-relaxation.name: Pelvic Floor Relaxation with Child's Pose
child-pose-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Spread your knees wide apart to allow space for your belly.
child-pose-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Sink your hips back toward your heels while extending your arms forward, allowing your forehead to rest gently on the ground. Feel your pelvic floor and hip muscles soften and release.

deep-squat-hold.name: Deep Squat Hold with Relaxation
deep-squat-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, weight distributed evenly through both feet. Hands can be held in front for light support if needed.
deep-squat-hold.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower into a deep squat position with weight in your heels, allowing your pelvic floor to relax and lengthen. Breathe deeply and hold this position for 20-30 seconds.

glute-bridge-release.name: Glute Bridge with Pelvic Floor Release
glute-bridge-release.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and parallel. Arms rest at your sides with palms down.
glute-bridge-release.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips toward the ceiling while consciously relaxing and releasing your pelvic floor muscles. Hold the bridge position while maintaining deep, relaxed breathing.

cat-cow-mobilization.name: Cat-Cow Mobilization
cat-cow-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Spine is in neutral position with gaze toward the ground.
cat-cow-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Arch your back gently, lifting your gaze and chest toward the ceiling (cow), then reverse by rounding your spine and tucking your chin (cat). Move slowly with deep breathing to encourage pelvic floor relaxation.

pelvic-floor-activation-supine.name: Pelvic Floor Activation - Supine
pelvic-floor-activation-supine.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Arms are relaxed at your sides with palms down.
pelvic-floor-activation-supine.endPoseDescription: Engage your pelvic floor muscles by contracting as if stopping the flow of urine, holding for 3-5 seconds. Maintain normal breathing while keeping your abdomen and glutes relaxed.

bridging-pelvic-floor.name: Bridging with Pelvic Floor Engagement
bridging-pelvic-floor.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Engage your pelvic floor muscles before initiating movement.
bridging-pelvic-floor.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips toward the ceiling while maintaining pelvic floor engagement and glute contraction. Hold briefly at the top while maintaining steady breathing.

quadruped-alternating-leg-lifts.name: Quadruped with Alternating Leg Lifts
quadruped-alternating-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine and engage your pelvic floor.
quadruped-alternating-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Extend one leg behind you while keeping the pelvic floor engaged and core tight. Return to start and alternate legs, avoiding any arching in the lower back.

seated-kegel-posture.name: Seated Kegel with Posture Hold
seated-kegel-posture.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and good posture, maintaining neutral spine. Relax your breathing and prepare to engage the pelvic floor.
seated-kegel-posture.endPoseDescription: Contract your pelvic floor muscles for 5-8 seconds while maintaining upright posture and relaxed breathing. Release and rest for equal duration between repetitions.

standing-hip-stability-dumbbell.name: Standing Hip Stability with Dumbbell
standing-hip-stability-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side, feet hip-width apart. Engage your pelvic floor and core for stability.
standing-hip-stability-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lift the opposite leg out to the side 6-12 inches while maintaining pelvic floor engagement. Keep the standing leg straight and avoid leaning to either side.

modified-dead-bug.name: Modified Dead Bug
modified-dead-bug.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and shins parallel to the floor. Engage your pelvic floor and keep arms extended toward the ceiling.
modified-dead-bug.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower one arm overhead while extending the opposite leg without touching the floor. Return to start and alternate sides while maintaining constant pelvic floor engagement.

standing-wall-squats-pelvic.name: Standing Wall Squats with Pelvic Floor
standing-wall-squats-pelvic.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and 12 inches from the wall. Engage your pelvic floor muscles before lowering.
standing-wall-squats-pelvic.endPoseDescription: Slide down the wall into a partial squat, keeping knees aligned over ankles and maintaining pelvic floor engagement. Hold briefly then slide back up, avoiding any bearing down sensation.

lying-lateral-leg-lifts.name: Lying Lateral Leg Lifts
lying-lateral-leg-lifts.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your bottom leg bent for support and top leg extended straight. Keep your hips stacked and engage your pelvic floor.
lying-lateral-leg-lifts.endPoseDescription: Lift the top leg 12-18 inches while keeping it straight and maintaining core engagement. Return to start without dropping the leg and continue with controlled movements.

heel-slides-core.name: Heel Slides with Core Engagement
heel-slides-core.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Engage your pelvic floor and maintain contact with the lower back.
heel-slides-core.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide one heel away from your body, extending the leg while keeping your lower back pressed to the floor. Return to start while maintaining constant pelvic floor engagement throughout.

gaze-stabilization-smooth-pursuits.name: Gaze Stabilization - Smooth Pursuits
gaze-stabilization-smooth-pursuits.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your head still and neck neutral. Focus your eyes on a fixed point at eye level in front of you.
gaze-stabilization-smooth-pursuits.endPoseDescription: Slowly move your eyes to follow a moving target (imaginary or real) from left to right, then up and down, maintaining focus without moving your head. Keep your gaze locked on the target throughout the movement.

plank-hold.name: Core Stability - Plank Hold
plank-hold.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows directly under your shoulders. Your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
plank-hold.endPoseDescription: Push up onto your forearms and toes, engaging your core to keep your body in a straight horizontal line. Avoid sagging hips or raising them too high.

neck-rolls.name: Neck Mobility - Slow Neck Rolls
neck-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and your chin slightly tucked. Keep your head in a neutral starting position.
neck-rolls.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll your head in controlled circles, moving your chin toward your chest, then to the side, then back and across in a smooth, continuous motion. Reverse direction and repeat.

marching-head-turns.name: Vestibular Training - Marching in Place with Head Turns
marching-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms ready to move at your sides. Keep your gaze level ahead.
marching-head-turns.endPoseDescription: March in place by lifting knees alternately while slowly turning your head from side to side. Coordinate the head turns with the marching motion for vestibular adaptation.

stationary-cycling.name: Low-Impact Cardio - Stationary Cycling
stationary-cycling.startPoseDescription: Sit on a stationary bike with your seat adjusted so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Grip the handlebars lightly with a neutral wrist position.
stationary-cycling.endPoseDescription: Pedal at a steady, moderate pace in smooth, controlled revolutions. Maintain an upright or slightly forward-leaning posture while keeping your head and gaze stable.

cervical-retraction-band.name: Cervical Retraction with Band Resistance
cervical-retraction-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and good posture. Place a resistance band around the back of your head at forehead level, holding both ends in front of you.
cervical-retraction-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your chin straight back, creating a double chin appearance, while resisting the band with your hands. Hold this retracted position for 2 seconds.

scapular-rows-band.name: Scapular Rows with Band
scapular-rows-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around a fixed point at shoulder height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder width.
scapular-rows-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms at shoulder height. Your elbows should move back slightly past your torso.

cervical-rotation-band.name: Cervical Rotation with Band Support
cervical-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a resistance band looped around your head, with the band positioned at your temples. Hold the band taut with both hands at chest level.
cervical-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your head to look over one shoulder while the band provides gentle resistance. Maintain the rotation for 2 seconds before returning to center.

standing-balance-head-turns.name: Standing Balance with Head Turns
standing-balance-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides, looking straight ahead. Keep your core engaged and maintain good posture.
standing-balance-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your head to look over your right shoulder, pause briefly, then return to center and rotate left. Perform this movement slowly and deliberately to challenge vestibular stability.

prone-shoulder-yti-band.name: Prone Shoulder Y-T-I with Band
prone-shoulder-yti-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with your arms at your sides and forehead resting on the mat. Loop a resistance band around both wrists.
prone-shoulder-yti-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms forward into a Y position overhead, then to a T position out to the sides, then along your body in an I position. Each position should involve squeezing your back muscles against the band resistance.

quadruped-neck-flexion-extension.name: Quadruped Neck Flexion-Extension
quadruped-neck-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with your neck in a neutral position, looking down at the mat. Keep your core engaged and shoulders stable.
quadruped-neck-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly drop your head and look toward your chest in flexion, then slowly raise your head and gaze upward in extension. Perform this movement in a controlled, smooth manner.

chin-tucks-band-isometric.name: Band-Assisted Chin Tucks with Isometric Hold
chin-tucks-band-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and loop a resistance band around the back of your head. Hold the band ends in front at chest level with slight tension.
chin-tucks-band-isometric.endPoseDescription: Perform a chin tuck by drawing your chin straight backward against the band resistance, engaging your deep neck flexors. Hold this position for 5-10 seconds while maintaining steady breathing.

standing-hip-hinge-stability.name: Standing Hip Hinge with Stability
standing-hip-hinge-stability.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart with a resistance band looped around a fixed point at waist height in front of you. Hold the band with both hands at chest level.
standing-hip-hinge-stability.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine and keeping your head in line with your torso. The band should provide resistance as you hinge, engaging your core and posterior chain.

tandem-stance-support.name: Tandem Stance with Support
tandem-stance-support.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a chair or wall with hands lightly touching for support. Position one foot in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position.
tandem-stance-support.endPoseDescription: Hold this narrow-stance position while maintaining balance and keeping your body upright. Use your hands for support as needed to maintain stability.

slow-walking-visual-focus.name: Slow Walking with Visual Focus
slow-walking-visual-focus.startPoseDescription: Stand upright in an open area near support if needed. Focus your gaze on a fixed point at eye level ahead of you.
slow-walking-visual-focus.endPoseDescription: Walk slowly forward in a straight line while maintaining focus on your fixed point. Keep your gait smooth and controlled, using support as needed for safety.

dumbbell-farmers-walk.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
dumbbell-farmers-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms extended. Keep your shoulders relaxed and spine neutral.
dumbbell-farmers-walk.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly while maintaining an upright posture and keeping dumbbells at arm's length. Engage your core and keep your gaze forward.

standing-marching-head-turns.name: Standing Marching with Head Turns
standing-marching-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands on hips or at your sides. Maintain neutral head position.
standing-marching-head-turns.endPoseDescription: March in place by lifting knees, while slowly turning your head left and right with each step. Coordinate smooth head movements with leg movements.

supine-eye-movements.name: Supine Eye Movements
supine-eye-movements.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on floor. Keep your head still and focus on a fixed point on the ceiling above.
supine-eye-movements.endPoseDescription: Move only your eyes in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions while keeping your head completely still. Track slowly and deliberately in each direction.

facial-mirror-smile.name: Facial Mirror Exercises - Smile
facial-mirror-smile.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in front of a mirror with a neutral facial expression. Keep your head still and relaxed with your shoulders down.
facial-mirror-smile.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift both corners of your mouth upward into a smile, engaging the muscles on both sides of your face equally. Hold the smile for 3-5 seconds while observing symmetry in the mirror.

forehead-wrinkle-raise.name: Forehead Wrinkle Exercises
forehead-wrinkle-raise.startPoseDescription: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral expression and your eyebrows in their resting position. Keep your head still and neck relaxed.
forehead-wrinkle-raise.endPoseDescription: Raise both eyebrows upward to create horizontal wrinkles across your forehead. Hold for 3-5 seconds, then slowly lower, focusing on controlled movement and symmetry.

eye-closure-blink.name: Eye Closure Strengthening
eye-closure-blink.startPoseDescription: Sit upright facing a mirror with eyes open and a neutral expression. Keep your head still and relaxed.
eye-closure-blink.endPoseDescription: Slowly close both eyes together, squinting gently without excessive force. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then slowly open, ensuring equal movement on both sides of the face.

mouth-corner-lift-alternate.name: Mouth Corner Lift - Alternating
mouth-corner-lift-alternate.startPoseDescription: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral facial expression and relaxed lips. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
mouth-corner-lift-alternate.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one corner of your mouth upward, hold for 2 seconds, then release and repeat on the opposite side. Perform 10-15 alternating repetitions while monitoring symmetry.

cheek-puff-release.name: Cheek Puff and Release
cheek-puff-release.startPoseDescription: Sit upright facing a mirror with a neutral expression and lips gently closed. Keep your head still and relaxed.
cheek-puff-release.endPoseDescription: Puff out both cheeks with air, hold for 2-3 seconds, then slowly release the air through your lips while maintaining control. Repeat 10-12 times, ensuring equal puffing on both sides.

lip-pucker-stretch.name: Lip Pucker and Stretch
lip-pucker-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral facial expression and relaxed lips. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
lip-pucker-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pucker your lips forward as if to whistle, hold for 2-3 seconds, then stretch your lips into a wide smile. Alternate between positions for 12-15 repetitions.

nose-wrinkle-raise.name: Nose Wrinkle Exercise
nose-wrinkle-raise.startPoseDescription: Sit upright facing a mirror with a neutral expression and your nose in a relaxed position. Keep your head still and shoulders down.
nose-wrinkle-raise.endPoseDescription: Wrinkle your nose upward by raising the muscles around the nasal bridge, creating creases across the bridge of your nose. Hold for 2-3 seconds, then relax and repeat 10-12 times.

tongue-press-lateral.name: Tongue Press and Lateral Movement
tongue-press-lateral.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open and your tongue in the center of your mouth. Keep your head still and shoulders relaxed.
tongue-press-lateral.endPoseDescription: Press your tongue firmly against one cheek from the inside, hold for 2 seconds, then move to the opposite cheek. Alternate sides for 12-15 repetitions.

coordinated-facial-expression.name: Neuromuscular Re-education - Coordinated Expressions
coordinated-facial-expression.startPoseDescription: Sit facing a mirror with a neutral expression and completely relaxed facial muscles. Keep your head still and your shoulders down.
coordinated-facial-expression.endPoseDescription: Combine multiple movements: lift eyebrows, puff cheeks, and lift mouth corners simultaneously, then release. Hold the combined expression for 3-5 seconds, focusing on coordination and symmetry.

shoulder-shrug-release.name: Shoulder Shrug and Release
shoulder-shrug-release.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms at your sides and shoulders in a relaxed position. Keep your neck neutral and eyes forward.
shoulder-shrug-release.endPoseDescription: Lift both shoulders up toward your ears in a shrug position, then release them downward with control. Allow the shoulders to drop back to their natural resting position.

scapular-squeeze-band.name: Scapular Squeeze with Band
scapular-squeeze-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a resistance band at chest height with arms extended forward, elbows slightly bent. Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
scapular-squeeze-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together, bringing your hands out to the sides. Hold the contraction briefly while maintaining upright posture.

gentle-jaw-opening.name: Gentle Jaw Opening
gentle-jaw-opening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your back supported and shoulders relaxed. Keep your lips closed and your neck in a neutral position.
gentle-jaw-opening.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth about half an inch while keeping your tongue flat on the floor of your mouth. Hold this gentle opening for 3-5 seconds without forcing.

resisted-mouth-opening.name: Resisted Mouth Opening
resisted-mouth-opening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed in a relaxed position. Place one finger under your chin, applying gentle upward pressure.
resisted-mouth-opening.endPoseDescription: Slowly open your mouth about one inch while gently resisting the opening with your finger underneath. Hold the resistance for 3-5 seconds.

lateral-jaw-movement.name: Lateral Jaw Movement
lateral-jaw-movement.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open, about a quarter-inch, in a relaxed neutral position. Keep your head still and stable.
lateral-jaw-movement.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your lower jaw to one side, moving it about one-quarter inch without opening your mouth further. Return to center and repeat on the other side.

tongue-to-palate.name: Tongue-to-Palate Exercise
tongue-to-palate.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed and your jaw relaxed in a neutral position. Breathe normally through your nose.
tongue-to-palate.endPoseDescription: Place your tongue flat against the roof of your mouth and gently press upward with moderate pressure. Hold for 5 seconds while keeping your jaw relaxed.

postural-neck-stretch.name: Postural Neck Stretch
postural-neck-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your shoulders relaxed and your back supported against the chair. Look straight ahead.
postural-neck-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side as far as comfortable, then tilt your chin down slightly toward your shoulder. Hold for 20-30 seconds and feel the stretch along the jaw and neck.

relaxation-breathing-jaw-release.name: Relaxation Breathing with Jaw Release
relaxation-breathing-jaw-release.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with your shoulders relaxed and your eyes either open or gently closed. Allow your jaw to rest naturally.
relaxation-breathing-jaw-release.endPoseDescription: Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts, then exhale through your mouth for 6 counts while consciously letting your jaw muscles relax and drop slightly. Feel the tension release.

isometric-jaw-clenching.name: Isometric Jaw Clenching
isometric-jaw-clenching.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your mouth closed in a relaxed position and your teeth slightly apart. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed.
isometric-jaw-clenching.endPoseDescription: Gently clench your teeth together with about 50% of your maximum effort, engaging the jaw muscles moderately. Hold for 5 seconds, then completely relax.

lateral-neck-flexion-resistance.name: Lateral Neck Flexion with Resistance
lateral-neck-flexion-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and neutral neck position. Place your right hand against the right side of your head near your temple.
lateral-neck-flexion-resistance.endPoseDescription: Gently push your head to the right while providing resistance with your hand, isometrically tensing the left-side neck muscles. Hold for 5-10 seconds without moving.

dumbbell-shoulder-presses.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Presses
dumbbell-shoulder-presses.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your back against a bench or chair, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent. Your core is engaged and your feet are flat on the floor.
dumbbell-shoulder-presses.endPoseDescription: Press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled motion until your arms are nearly fully extended. Lower them back to shoulder height with control.

postural-correction-hold.name: Postural Correction Hold
postural-correction-hold.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and shoulders back and down. Engage your core muscles as if bracing for impact.
postural-correction-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain this upright posture with your weight balanced evenly between both feet, shoulders relaxed but not rounded. Hold this corrected position for 30-60 seconds.

supine-quadriceps-sets.name: Supine Quadriceps Sets
supine-quadriceps-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and a small towel roll under one knee. Keep your other leg relaxed on the mat.
supine-quadriceps-sets.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle of the leg with the towel roll, straightening the knee completely. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds before relaxing.

kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Kneel on one knee with the other foot stepped forward in a lunge position, keeping your torso upright. Engage your core to maintain a neutral spine.
kneeling-hip-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Shift your weight forward while squeezing your glute on the back leg, creating a stretch in the front of the hip. Keep your shoulders back and chest open.

standing-balance-walk.name: Standing Balance Walk
standing-balance-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, using a parallel bar or wall within arm's reach for safety support. Engage your core and maintain good posture.
standing-balance-walk.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly with deliberate, controlled steps, focusing on weight transfer and balance. Keep your gaze forward and avoid looking down at your feet.

seated-hip-abduction-band.name: Seated Hip Abduction with Band
seated-hip-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat and knees together. Loop a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.
seated-hip-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Press knees outward against the band resistance, keeping feet planted on the floor. Hold for 2 seconds and return to center.

seated-neck-isometric-band.name: Seated Neck Isometric with Band
seated-neck-isometric-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and wrap a resistance band around your head at forehead level. Hold both ends firmly with your hands.
seated-neck-isometric-band.endPoseDescription: Press your head forward gently against the band without moving, creating an isometric contraction. Hold for 5-10 seconds and relax.

seated-tricep-extension-band.name: Seated Tricep Extension with Band
seated-tricep-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and hold one end of a resistance band overhead with one arm bent at the elbow. Secure the other end under your seated position.
seated-tricep-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten the overhead arm by extending the elbow upward against the band resistance. Lower slowly with control and repeat on both sides.

seated-spinal-rotation-stretch.name: Seated Spinal Rotation Stretch
seated-spinal-rotation-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and hands crossed over your chest. Keep your hips facing forward.
seated-spinal-rotation-stretch.endPoseDescription: Rotate your upper body gently to one side, holding the stretch for 15-20 seconds. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

big-marching-in-place.name: Big Marching in Place
big-marching-in-place.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Maintain an upright posture with engagement through your core.
big-marching-in-place.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up as high as possible toward the chest while driving the opposite arm forward. Alternate legs in a marching pattern with exaggerated, BIG movements.

big-stepping-forward.name: Big Stepping Forward
big-stepping-forward.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides or extended forward for balance. Keep your chest upright and core engaged.
big-stepping-forward.endPoseDescription: Take a BIG step forward with one leg, ensuring the step is exaggerated and covers substantial distance. Return to standing and repeat with the opposite leg.

big-sit-to-stand.name: Big Sit-to-Stand
big-sit-to-stand.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor hip-width apart and hands on the armrests or thighs. Lean your trunk slightly forward.
big-sit-to-stand.endPoseDescription: Stand up with a BIG, exaggerated movement using your legs and core, extending your hips and knees fully. Stand tall at the top before slowly returning to the seated position.

big-stepping-backward.name: Big Stepping Backward
big-stepping-backward.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface for support if needed. Maintain an upright posture and forward gaze.
big-stepping-backward.endPoseDescription: Take a BIG step backward with one leg, extending the step as far as safely possible. Return to standing and alternate with the opposite leg.

big-head-turns.name: Big Head Turns
big-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your head facing forward and shoulders relaxed. Keep your trunk stable and only move your head.
big-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Turn your head as far as possible to one side in a BIG, exaggerated motion. Return to center and rotate to the opposite side with maximum range.

big-reaching-overhead.name: Big Reaching Overhead
big-reaching-overhead.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms resting at your sides. Keep your posture upright with your core engaged.
big-reaching-overhead.endPoseDescription: Reach both arms BIG and high overhead, fully extending through your shoulders and standing tall on your toes if possible. Hold briefly at the top before lowering.

big-stepping-sideways.name: Big Stepping Sideways
big-stepping-sideways.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet together and hands on a stable surface or extended for balance. Maintain an upright posture throughout.
big-stepping-sideways.endPoseDescription: Take a BIG step to one side, moving your leg as far as possible while keeping your trunk upright. Return to center and step to the opposite side.

single-leg-standing-dumbbell.name: Single Leg Standing with Dumbbell
single-leg-standing-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at your side. Keep your core engaged and eyes focused on a fixed point ahead.
single-leg-standing-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to approximately 90 degrees while maintaining an upright posture. Hold this position steady, using your standing leg's foot and ankle stabilizers to maintain balance.

glute-bridges-dumbbell.name: Glute Bridges with Dumbbell
glute-bridges-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell across your hips with both hands, keeping your arms relaxed.
glute-bridges-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top position while maintaining tension in your core.

standing-dumbbell-rows.name: Standing Dumbbell Rows
standing-dumbbell-rows.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended downward. Maintain a slight knee bend and engage your core.
standing-dumbbell-rows.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribcage by driving your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

seated-marching-dumbbell.name: Seated Marching with Dumbbell Hold
seated-marching-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor, holding a light dumbbell in each hand. Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture.
seated-marching-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward your chest while maintaining balance, alternating legs in a marching motion. Continue the marching pattern while holding the dumbbells steady at your sides.

wall-slides-dumbbell.name: Wall Slides with Dumbbell
wall-slides-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand with your back against a wall, feet about 6 inches away, holding a light dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height. Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
wall-slides-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide your arm up the wall overhead, extending your elbow while keeping the back of your arm in contact with the wall. Slide back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.

pronation-supination-weight.name: Pronation and Supination with Light Weight
pronation-supination-weight.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right elbow bent at 90 degrees, resting on a table or your lap. Hold a light dumbbell (2-5 lbs) vertically with a neutral grip.
pronation-supination-weight.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell palm-up (supination), pause briefly, then rotate to turn it palm-down (pronation). Complete the movement in a controlled manner without moving your elbow.

grip-strength-training.name: Grip Strength Training with Adjustable Gripper
grip-strength-training.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your arm relaxed at your side, holding an adjustable hand gripper in your right hand in the open position. Your fingers are extended.
grip-strength-training.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the gripper handles together using your grip strength, hold for 2 seconds, then slowly release. Keep your wrist in a neutral position throughout the movement.

reverse-dumbbell-wrist-curls.name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curls
reverse-dumbbell-wrist-curls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right forearm resting on a table, hand hanging off the edge with palm facing down. Hold a light dumbbell (3-8 lbs) in your hand.
reverse-dumbbell-wrist-curls.endPoseDescription: Extend your hand upward at the wrist, lifting the dumbbell, then slowly lower it back down. Keep your forearm stationary and control the movement throughout.

isometric-wrist-hold.name: Isometric Wrist Hold
isometric-wrist-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your right arm at your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees. Hold a light dumbbell or plate in a neutral wrist position.
isometric-wrist-hold.endPoseDescription: Maintain the dumbbell in a stable, neutral wrist position without any movement. Hold this static contraction for 20-30 seconds, focusing on stabilizing muscles.

forearm-plank-wrist.name: Forearm Plank with Wrist Awareness
forearm-plank-wrist.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with your forearms on the ground, elbows directly under your shoulders. Your body is straight from head to heels, supported on your forearms and toes.
forearm-plank-wrist.endPoseDescription: Hold your body in a straight line, distributing weight evenly through your forearms and hands. Maintain neutral wrist position without excessive flexion or extension.

banded-lateral-walks.name: Banded Lateral Walks
banded-lateral-walks.startPoseDescription: Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees and stand with feet hip-width apart. Maintain a slight knee bend and neutral spine throughout.
banded-lateral-walks.endPoseDescription: Take a controlled step to the right, keeping tension on the band and your chest upright. Step your left foot to follow, maintaining the same stance width.

banded-crab-walk.name: Banded Crab Walk
banded-crab-walk.startPoseDescription: Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees slightly and hinge slightly forward at the hips.
banded-crab-walk.endPoseDescription: Step backward at a diagonal angle while maintaining tension on the band and keeping your chest up. Continue stepping in reverse, maintaining band tension throughout.

supine-scapular-squeeze.name: Supine Scapular Squeeze
supine-scapular-squeeze.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both arms at your sides, palms facing down, and knees bent with feet flat on the floor. Your shoulders are relaxed away from your ears.
supine-scapular-squeeze.endPoseDescription: Press your shoulders down into the floor and squeeze your shoulder blades together, creating tension across your upper back. Hold for 3 seconds, then relax.

dumbbell-reverse-fly.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
dumbbell-reverse-fly.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees, holding light dumbbells with arms extended down in front of your thighs. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine.
dumbbell-reverse-fly.endPoseDescription: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled arc until your arms are parallel to the ground at shoulder height. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.

quadruped-shoulder-rotations.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability Rotations
quadruped-shoulder-rotations.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with hands directly under shoulders and knees under hips. Maintain a neutral spine and engage your core throughout the movement.
quadruped-shoulder-rotations.endPoseDescription: Reach your right arm across your body and rotate your torso to the left, threading your arm under your body. Return to center and alternate sides.

dumbbell-single-arm-row.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
dumbbell-single-arm-row.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand with arm extended down. Hinge slightly at the hips with a neutral spine and brace your core.
dumbbell-single-arm-row.endPoseDescription: Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, driving your elbow back and squeezing your back muscles. Lower the dumbbell with control back to the starting position.

supine-shoulder-flexion-holds.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion Holds
supine-shoulder-flexion-holds.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a light dumbbell in your right hand with your arm extended upward toward the ceiling.
supine-shoulder-flexion-holds.endPoseDescription: Maintain the arm position while keeping your shoulder blade stable and packed. Hold this position while ensuring your lower back stays neutral against the floor.

reverse-machine-fly.name: Reverse Machine Fly
reverse-machine-fly.startPoseDescription: Sit upright at a reverse fly machine with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the ground. Grip the handles with a neutral grip at shoulder height.
reverse-machine-fly.endPoseDescription: Pull the handles back in a wide arc, squeezing your shoulder blades together and opening your chest. Your arms should form a wide V-shape at the end of the movement.

prone-glute-bridge.name: Prone Glute Bridge
prone-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Position your feet about 12 inches from your buttocks.
prone-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold briefly before lowering.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

quadruped-bird-dog-resistance-band.name: Quadruped Bird Dog with Resistance Band
quadruped-bird-dog-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Start on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around one foot and held in the opposite hand. Keep your spine neutral and core engaged.
quadruped-bird-dog-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Simultaneously extend the banded leg straight back and opposite arm straight forward against the band resistance. Maintain a straight line and return to start without touching the ground.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

standing-hip-abduction-resistance-band.name: Standing Hip Abduction with Resistance Band
standing-hip-abduction-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Hold onto a chair or wall for balance if needed.
standing-hip-abduction-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Keep your toes forward and press your knees outward against the band resistance without tilting your torso. Squeeze your outer hip muscles and return to the starting position with control.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

banded-lateral-band-walk.name: Banded Lateral Band Walk
banded-lateral-band-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a resistance band looped around both legs just above the knees. Bend your knees slightly in a semi-squat position with hands on your hips.
banded-lateral-band-walk.endPoseDescription: Step laterally to one side while maintaining band tension and keeping your knees bent. Return to center and repeat, maintaining controlled movement throughout.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

standing-hip-flexion-resistance-band.name: Standing Hip Flexion with Resistance Band
standing-hip-flexion-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around one foot and holding the other end of the band in both hands at chest level. Keep your core engaged and stand tall.
standing-hip-flexion-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Lift the banded leg forward and up against the band resistance, raising the knee toward your chest. Control the movement back down without letting the foot touch the ground.
conditions_seen_in: long-haul truck driver hip and back tightness

cervical-lateral-flexion-stretch.name: Cervical Lateral Flexion Stretch
cervical-lateral-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your spine neutral and look straight ahead.
cervical-lateral-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder, feeling a stretch along the left side of your neck. Keep your shoulders level and avoid rotating your trunk.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

prone-shoulder-blade-retraction.name: Prone Shoulder Blade Retraction
prone-shoulder-blade-retraction.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a mat with arms at your sides, palms down, and legs extended. Rest your forehead on a small towel to keep your neck neutral.
prone-shoulder-blade-retraction.endPoseDescription: Lift your chest slightly off the ground while squeezing your shoulder blades together and back. Keep your neck in neutral position and hold for 2 seconds.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

adductor-stretch.name: Adductor Stretch
adductor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with both feet on the floor and knees bent. Press the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall outward into a butterfly position.
adductor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently lean forward from your hips while keeping your back straight, feeling a stretch along your inner thighs. Push your knees down slightly with your elbows for deeper tension.

anti-rotation-press.name: Anti-Rotation Press with Rotation
anti-rotation-press.startPoseDescription: Stand perpendicular to a cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle at chest level with both hands. Engage your core and keep your shoulders level.
anti-rotation-press.endPoseDescription: Press the cable away from your body while simultaneously rotating your torso toward the cable. Hold at full extension, then return to start with control.

banded-shoulder-stabilization.name: Banded Shoulder Stabilization
banded-shoulder-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band looped around both wrists at chest height. Your arms are extended forward with a slight bend in the elbows, maintaining neutral posture.
banded-shoulder-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your arms outward in a controlled motion, engaging your shoulder stabilizers. Your arms remain at chest height with elbows slightly bent as you create tension in the band.

quadruped-band-hip-abduction.name: Quadruped Band Hip Abduction
quadruped-band-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Keep your spine neutral with core engaged and hands directly under shoulders.
quadruped-band-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee outward against band resistance while keeping your hip level and core tight. The movement initiates from the hip while maintaining a stable neutral spine.

seated-band-knee-extension.name: Seated Band Knee Extension
seated-band-knee-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around one foot and held at the other end. Your knee is bent at approximately 90 degrees with feet flat on the floor.
seated-band-knee-extension.endPoseDescription: Straighten your leg by extending the knee against band resistance while maintaining proper posture. Your leg should reach near-full extension without locking the knee joint.

side-lying-band-hip-abduction.name: Side-Lying Band Hip Abduction
side-lying-band-hip-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Stack your hips and shoulders in alignment with legs stacked together.
side-lying-band-hip-abduction.endPoseDescription: Lift your top knee upward against band resistance while keeping your hips stacked and lower body stable. The movement is controlled and isolated to the hip abductors.

prone-band-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Prone Band Shoulder External Rotation
prone-band-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band in both hands, arms bent at 90 degrees with elbows at shoulder height. Your forearms rest on the ground pointing forward.
prone-band-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearms outward against band resistance by engaging the rotator cuff muscles. Your elbows remain anchored at shoulder height throughout the movement.

supine-band-glute-bridge.name: Supine Band Glute Bridge
supine-band-glute-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and a resistance band looped around your thighs just above the knees. Your arms rest at your sides for stability.
supine-band-glute-bridge.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips upward while maintaining band tension between the knees. Your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders at the peak.

standing-band-ankle-inversion-stability.name: Standing Band Ankle Inversion with Stability
standing-band-ankle-inversion-stability.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding onto a stable surface with one leg slightly lifted and a resistance band looped around the forefoot. Your stance leg is engaged with a slight knee bend.
standing-band-ankle-inversion-stability.endPoseDescription: Turn your foot inward against band resistance while maintaining balance and control. Your ankle movement is deliberate and stabilized by engagement of the surrounding muscles.

kneeling-band-core-rotation.name: Kneeling Band Core Rotation
kneeling-band-core-rotation.startPoseDescription: Kneel upright with a resistance band anchored at chest height across your body. Your core is engaged and shoulders are stacked over hips with neutral spine.
kneeling-band-core-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso away from the anchor point against band resistance while keeping your hips stable. Your movement originates from the core with controlled, deliberate rotation.

standing-band-assisted-balance.name: Standing Band Assisted Balance
standing-band-assisted-balance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a resistance band looped around a stable object at waist height with light tension. Your feet are hip-width apart with one foot prepared to lift slightly.
standing-band-assisted-balance.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg while maintaining balance on the stance leg, using light band tension for stability assistance. Your core remains engaged with posture upright throughout the movement.

plantar-fascia-self-massage.name: Plantar Fascia Self-Massage
plantar-fascia-self-massage.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair and place one foot flat on the floor. Cross the opposite ankle over the standing knee to access the sole of your foot.
plantar-fascia-self-massage.endPoseDescription: Using your thumbs or fingers, apply gentle pressure and massage along the arch of the foot from heel to toes. Work slowly along the plantar fascia for 1-2 minutes.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

standing-wall-calf-stretch.name: Standing Wall Calf Stretch
standing-wall-calf-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with your hands placed on the wall at shoulder height. Position one leg forward with knee bent and one leg back with the heel on the ground.
standing-wall-calf-stretch.endPoseDescription: Lean forward into the wall keeping your back heel pressed firmly into the ground. Feel the stretch in the calf of your back leg.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

seated-foot-rolls.name: Seated Foot Rolls
seated-foot-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor. Keep your back against the chair.
seated-foot-rolls.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll one foot inward and outward in circular motions, then reverse direction. Repeat for 15-20 rotations in each direction per foot.
conditions_seen_in: Sever's disease (calcaneal apophysitis) in young athlete

neck-isometric-holds-affected-side.name: Neck Isometric Holds - Affected Side
neck-isometric-holds-affected-side.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place your hand against the side of your head on the affected side (the side the chin is rotated toward).
neck-isometric-holds-affected-side.endPoseDescription: Press your head gently into your hand while resisting with equal pressure, creating an isometric contraction without movement. Hold this tension for 5-10 seconds while maintaining neutral cervical spine alignment.

neck-stretch-sternocleidomastoid.name: Neck Stretching - Sternocleidomastoid
neck-stretch-sternocleidomastoid.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and shoulders relaxed. Keep your chin level and face forward.
neck-stretch-sternocleidomastoid.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head toward the unaffected side (away from the tight muscle) while slightly rotating your chin upward. Hold this position to feel a stretch along the front and side of the affected neck.

chin-tucks-neck-rotation.name: Chin Tucks with Neck Rotation
chin-tucks-neck-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit with upright posture, shoulders back, and eyes looking straight ahead. Maintain a neutral cervical spine position.
chin-tucks-neck-rotation.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your chin straight back to create a double chin appearance, then slowly rotate your head toward the unaffected side. Return to center and relax before repeating.

lateral-neck-flexion-stretch-unaffected.name: Lateral Neck Flexion Stretch - Unaffected Side
lateral-neck-flexion-stretch-unaffected.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with neutral spine and shoulders relaxed at rest. Place one hand on top of your head for gentle assistance.
lateral-neck-flexion-stretch-unaffected.endPoseDescription: Slowly tilt your head toward the unaffected side, using light pressure from your hand to deepen the stretch. Feel the stretch along the opposite side of your neck where the torticollis muscle is tight.

dumbbell-shoulder-shrugs.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Shrugs
dumbbell-shoulder-shrugs.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a light dumbbell in each hand with arms at your sides. Maintain neutral neck position and relaxed shoulders.
dumbbell-shoulder-shrugs.endPoseDescription: Elevate both shoulders up toward your ears in a shrugging motion while keeping arms straight. Hold briefly at the top, then lower back to starting position with controlled movement.

prone-head-turns.name: Prone Head Turns
prone-head-turns.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a firm surface with your forehead resting on a small rolled towel or pillow. Keep your arms relaxed alongside your body.
prone-head-turns.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side, resting your cheek on the support while avoiding excessive rotation. Pause briefly, then turn to the opposite side in a controlled manner.

neck-rotation-stretch-supine.name: Neck Rotation Stretch - Supine
neck-rotation-stretch-supine.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Keep your head in neutral position resting on a low pillow or towel roll.
neck-rotation-stretch-supine.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your head toward the unaffected side, allowing gravity to assist in the stretch. Hold this position to release tension in the affected sternocleidomastoid muscle.

dumbbell-farmers-carries.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carries
dumbbell-farmers-carries.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with neutral wrist and shoulder position. Engage your core and maintain tall posture.
dumbbell-farmers-carries.endPoseDescription: Walk forward maintaining upright posture, shoulders level, and neutral neck alignment. Focus on keeping both shoulders balanced and avoiding lateral neck flexion throughout the movement.

modified-stationary-bike.name: Modified Stationary Bike
modified-stationary-bike.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the stationary bike with feet flat on the pedals and hands resting on the handlebars. Adjust the seat height so your knee has a slight bend when the pedal is at its lowest point.
modified-stationary-bike.endPoseDescription: Pedal at a comfortable, sustainable pace with minimal resistance. Maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

wall-pushups.name: Wall Pushups
wall-pushups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with feet shoulder-width apart, about 12-18 inches away from the wall. Place both palms flat against the wall at shoulder height.
wall-pushups.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and lower your body toward the wall in a controlled manner. Push back to the starting position, maintaining a straight line from head to heels.

seated-scapular-stabilization.name: Seated Scapular Stabilization
seated-scapular-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with good posture and feet flat on the floor. Hold a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
seated-scapular-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Gently press the band forward and slightly outward while squeezing your shoulder blades together. Hold this contraction for 2-3 seconds without hyperextending your shoulders.

supine-hip-bridges-with-band.name: Supine Hip Bridges with Band
supine-hip-bridges-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees.
supine-hip-bridges-with-band.endPoseDescription: Press your hips upward while pushing outward against the band to engage the glutes and hip stabilizers. Hold the top position briefly before lowering back down.

standing-quadriceps-sets-with-band.name: Standing Quadriceps Sets with Band
standing-quadriceps-sets-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around one thigh just above the knee. Maintain neutral spine and core engagement.
standing-quadriceps-sets-with-band.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps muscle while gently pressing the back of your knee into the band. Maintain the contraction for 2-3 seconds without locking the knee.

quadruped-band-pull-aparts.name: Quadruped Band Pull-Aparts
quadruped-band-pull-aparts.startPoseDescription: Position yourself on hands and knees with a neutral spine. Hold a resistance band horizontally in front of your chest with arms extended.
quadruped-band-pull-aparts.endPoseDescription: Pull the band apart by moving your hands outward while maintaining core stability. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end point for 2 seconds.

seated-hamstring-stretch-with-band.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch with Band
seated-hamstring-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent with foot flat. Loop a resistance band around the arch of the extended foot.
seated-hamstring-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band to bring your foot toward your torso while keeping your leg relatively straight. Hold a comfortable stretch for 30 seconds without bouncing.

kneeling-band-shoulder-abduction.name: Kneeling Band Shoulder Abduction
kneeling-band-shoulder-abduction.startPoseDescription: Kneel upright with a resistance band anchored under one knee. Hold the band in one hand at your side with elbow bent to 90 degrees.
kneeling-band-shoulder-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise your elbow out to the side to shoulder height while keeping your arm in a gentle bend. Avoid excessive shoulder shrugging or momentum.

side-lying-hip-abduction-with-band.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction with Band
side-lying-hip-abduction-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Rest your head on your lower arm.
side-lying-hip-abduction-with-band.endPoseDescription: Open your top knee outward against the band resistance while keeping your feet together. Control the movement and avoid rolling backward with your torso.

seated-core-engagement-with-band-rotatio.name: Seated Core Engagement with Band Rotation
seated-core-engagement-with-band-rotatio.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with excellent posture, holding a resistance band with both hands at chest height. Keep your elbows slightly bent and band under light tension.
seated-core-engagement-with-band-rotatio.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso gently to one side while maintaining stable hips and a neutral spine. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side with controlled movements.

prone-scapular-y-raises-with-band.name: Prone Scapular Y-Raises with Band
prone-scapular-y-raises-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a comfortable surface with arms at your sides holding a light resistance band. Keep your forehead on a small pillow to maintain neutral cervical spine.
prone-scapular-y-raises-with-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms overhead in a Y-position while engaging your lower trapezius. Hold briefly at the top before lowering, avoiding excessive shoulder strain.

standing-band-assisted-calf-raises.name: Standing Band-Assisted Calf Raises
standing-band-assisted-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with a resistance band looped around both feet, holding the ends in your hands for light support. Maintain an upright posture with core engagement.
standing-band-assisted-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up on the balls of your feet while pressing through all five toes for stability. Lower slowly back to starting position with controlled movement.

gentle-neck-rolls.name: Gentle Neck Rolls
gentle-neck-rolls.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and shoulders relaxed. Keep your spine neutral and look straight ahead.
gentle-neck-rolls.endPoseDescription: Slowly roll your head in a complete circle, moving from chin toward chest, then to shoulder, back, and opposite shoulder. Move smoothly and gently without forcing the range of motion.

seated-hip-circles.name: Seated Hip Circles
seated-hip-circles.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
seated-hip-circles.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your hips in slow, controlled circles, moving your torso in a circular motion. Reverse direction after several circles.

supine-chest-dumbbell-fly.name: Supine Chest Dumbbell Fly
supine-chest-dumbbell-fly.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a bench or firm surface with feet flat on the floor. Hold dumbbells directly above your chest with arms extended and a slight bend in the elbows.
supine-chest-dumbbell-fly.endPoseDescription: Lower the dumbbells in a wide arc out to the sides in a controlled motion until you feel a stretch across your chest. Return to the starting position by bringing the dumbbells back together.

seated-bicep-curl.name: Seated Bicep Curl
seated-bicep-curl.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and dumbbells held at your sides with arms extended and palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
seated-bicep-curl.endPoseDescription: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders in a controlled manner, squeezing your biceps at the top. Lower the weights back down with control to the starting position.

seated-shoulder-shrug-dumbbells.name: Seated Shoulder Shrug with Dumbbells
seated-shoulder-shrug-dumbbells.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and dumbbells held at your sides with arms extended. Allow your shoulders to relax in a neutral position.
seated-shoulder-shrug-dumbbells.endPoseDescription: Raise your shoulders up toward your ears in a controlled shrugging motion, squeezing the trapezius muscles. Lower your shoulders back down to the starting position without dropping abruptly.

prone-quadriceps-stretch.name: Prone Quadriceps Stretch
prone-quadriceps-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie face-down on a mat or carpet in a prone position with your forehead resting on your hands. Relax your legs and keep your pelvis on the ground.
prone-quadriceps-stretch.endPoseDescription: Bend one knee and gently pull your heel toward your glute, feeling a stretch along the front of your thigh. Keep your hips grounded and avoid twisting your lower back.

stationary-bike-low-intensity.name: Stationary Bike - Low Intensity
stationary-bike-low-intensity.startPoseDescription: Sit on the stationary bike with feet flat on the pedals at the bottom of the stroke. Maintain upright posture with hands on the handlebars and a relaxed grip.
stationary-bike-low-intensity.endPoseDescription: Pedal smoothly at a comfortable, conversational pace with moderate resistance. Keep knees tracking forward and maintain consistent cadence throughout.

chest-press-machine.name: Chest Press Machine
chest-press-machine.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on the machine with back firmly against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Grip the handles at chest level with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
chest-press-machine.endPoseDescription: Push the handles forward in a controlled manner until arms are nearly straight without locking elbows. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

leg-press-machine.name: Leg Press Machine
leg-press-machine.startPoseDescription: Sit in the machine with back and head resting against the support pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart. Knees should be at approximately 90 degrees.
leg-press-machine.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to extend the legs until knees are nearly straight but not locked. Slowly lower back to the starting position with controlled movement.

lat-pulldown-machine.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
lat-pulldown-machine.startPoseDescription: Sit at the machine with thighs under the pad and feet flat on the floor. Reach up and grip the wide bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
lat-pulldown-machine.endPoseDescription: Pull the bar down toward your chest by driving elbows down and back. Return the bar to the starting position with a controlled movement without fully straightening arms.

treadmill-walking-incline.name: Treadmill Walking - Incline
treadmill-walking-incline.startPoseDescription: Stand on the treadmill with feet hip-width apart, lightly holding the handrails for balance. Set a comfortable walking speed with a gentle incline (3-5 degrees).
treadmill-walking-incline.endPoseDescription: Walk steadily up the incline while maintaining an upright posture and natural arm swing. Maintain a conversational pace that allows for easy breathing throughout.

seated-row-machine.name: Seated Row Machine
seated-row-machine.startPoseDescription: Sit at the machine with chest against the pad and feet flat on the floor. Extend arms forward to grip the handles with a neutral grip.
seated-row-machine.endPoseDescription: Pull the handles toward your torso by retracting shoulder blades and bending elbows. Extend arms back to the start with control, maintaining contact with the chest pad.

hamstring-stretch-seated.name: Hamstring Stretch - Seated
hamstring-stretch-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit on the floor with one leg extended straight and the other knee bent with foot flat on the ground. Keep your back straight and engage your core.
hamstring-stretch-seated.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hips and gently fold forward over the extended leg until a mild stretch is felt. Hold this position while maintaining relaxed breathing.

shoulder-flexion-mobility-standing.name: Shoulder Flexion Mobility - Standing
shoulder-flexion-mobility-standing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed away from ears.
shoulder-flexion-mobility-standing.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms overhead in a smooth, controlled motion to ear level or higher as tolerated. Lower arms back down with control and repeat in a rhythmic manner.

quadriceps-sets-supine.name: Quadriceps Sets - Supine
quadriceps-sets-supine.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both legs extended and a small towel roll under one knee. Keep the other leg extended and relaxed.
quadriceps-sets-supine.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle of the extended leg by straightening the knee and pulling the kneecap upward. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds then relax and repeat.

tandem-stance-band-support.name: Tandem Stance with Band Support
tandem-stance-band-support.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height with both hands for light support. Keep your core engaged and gaze fixed on a focal point ahead.
tandem-stance-band-support.endPoseDescription: Place one foot directly in front of the other in a heel-to-toe position, maintaining light tension on the band for balance assistance. Hold this narrow stance while keeping your torso upright and shoulders relaxed.

single-leg-stance-band-anchor.name: Single-Leg Stance with Band Anchor
single-leg-stance-band-anchor.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a sturdy point with a resistance band looped around it at waist height, holding the band with one hand for light support. Position feet hip-width apart with knees slightly bent.
single-leg-stance-band-anchor.endPoseDescription: Lift one leg off the ground, bending the knee to 90 degrees while using minimal band support to maintain balance. Keep your standing leg stable and core engaged throughout the hold.

seated-marching-band-resistance.name: Seated Marching with Band Resistance
seated-marching-band-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with feet flat on the floor, with a resistance band looped around both feet. Hold the band's ends in your hands with slight tension.
seated-marching-band-resistance.endPoseDescription: Lift one foot a few inches off the ground against the band's resistance while maintaining an upright posture. Alternate legs in a controlled marching motion, focusing on foot and ankle engagement.

seated-toe-heel-taps-band.name: Seated Toe and Heel Taps with Band Loop
seated-toe-heel-taps-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, with a light resistance band looped around the front of both feet. Keep your hands on your thighs for stability.
seated-toe-heel-taps-band.endPoseDescription: Tap your toes upward against the band's resistance, lifting the balls of your feet while heels remain grounded. Then reverse the motion, pressing your toes down and lifting your heels to work the opposing muscles.

quadruped-band-balance.name: Quadruped with Band-Assisted Balance
quadruped-band-balance.startPoseDescription: Begin on hands and knees with a resistance band looped around your waist, anchored to a stable object at chest height for light support. Keep your core engaged and spine neutral.
quadruped-band-balance.endPoseDescription: Extend one leg straight back and the opposite arm straight forward, creating a diagonal line through your body. Hold briefly while maintaining balance with minimal band support, then return to starting position.

seated-band-foot-flexion.name: Seated Resistance Band Foot Flexion
seated-band-foot-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one foot flat on the floor and the opposite leg extended with a resistance band looped around the ball of that foot. Hold the band's ends for controlled resistance.
seated-band-foot-flexion.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward and inward against the band's resistance, engaging the foot and calf muscles. Return to neutral and perform repetitions with controlled movement before switching feet.

standing-marching-band-resistance.name: Standing Marching with Band Resistance
standing-marching-band-resistance.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, with a resistance band looped around both feet and held at your sides with slight tension. Keep your core engaged and posture tall.
standing-marching-band-resistance.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up to a comfortable height against the band's resistance while maintaining upright balance. Alternate legs in a controlled marching motion, focusing on stability and foot awareness.

arm-elevation-deep-breathing.name: Arm Elevation with Deep Breathing
arm-elevation-deep-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your shoulders relaxed and take a deep breath in through your nose.
arm-elevation-deep-breathing.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms out to the sides and overhead in a smooth arc while exhaling. Hold this elevated position briefly, then lower arms back down as you inhale.

gentle-shoulder-circles.name: Gentle Shoulder Circles
gentle-shoulder-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with good posture, feet shoulder-width apart, and arms hanging naturally at your sides. Keep your neck neutral and gaze forward.
gentle-shoulder-circles.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate both shoulders backward in small circles, moving up toward your ears, back, and down. Complete 8-10 circles, then reverse direction.

seated-arm-compressions-towel.name: Seated Arm Compressions with Towel Roll
seated-arm-compressions-towel.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with your affected arm extended in front of you at chest height. Imagine holding an imaginary towel roll along the length of your arm.
seated-arm-compressions-towel.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze your forearm and hand as if wringing out the imaginary towel from shoulder to fingertips. Release and repeat with gentle, rhythmic compressions moving downward.

wrist-finger-flexion-extension.name: Wrist and Finger Flexion Extension
wrist-finger-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table with your hand hanging slightly over the edge. Keep your palm facing downward in a neutral position.
wrist-finger-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Gently curl your fingers and wrist downward, then slowly extend them back up and slightly backward. Move through a pain-free range of motion with controlled, deliberate movements.

supine-arm-slides.name: Supine Arm Slides
supine-arm-slides.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back on a firm surface with both arms at your sides, palms facing down. Keep your knees slightly bent with feet flat on the floor for comfort.
supine-arm-slides.endPoseDescription: Slowly slide both arms overhead along the floor in a snow-angel motion, raising them above your head. Gently slide arms back down to your sides in a controlled manner.

seated-torso-rotation-arm-swing.name: Seated Torso Rotation with Arm Swing
