seated-torso-rotation-arm-swing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed gently over your chest. Keep your hips and lower body still throughout the movement.
seated-torso-rotation-arm-swing.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your arms to swing naturally with the rotation. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side in a slow, controlled manner.

prone-hand-elevation-relaxation.name: Prone Hand Elevation and Relaxation
prone-hand-elevation-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bed or firm surface with pillows under your chest and affected arm resting below heart level. Keep your head turned to one side in a comfortable position.
prone-hand-elevation-relaxation.endPoseDescription: Gently elevate your affected arm above heart level using pillows or cushions for support. Hold this elevated position to promote lymphatic drainage through gravity.

gentle-isometric-arm-holds.name: Gentle Isometric Arm Holds
gentle-isometric-arm-holds.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your affected arm bent at the elbow, held at chest height with palm facing inward. Use your other hand to support the affected arm from underneath.
gentle-isometric-arm-holds.endPoseDescription: Gently press your affected arm downward against the resistance of your supporting hand without moving. Hold this gentle isometric contraction for 3-5 seconds, then relax.

breathing-exercises-arm-positioning.name: Breathing Exercises with Arm Positioning
breathing-exercises-arm-positioning.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with both feet flat on the floor and arms resting on your thighs. Close your eyes or maintain a soft gaze.
breathing-exercises-arm-positioning.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms out to shoulder height while inhaling deeply for a count of 4. Lower arms while exhaling slowly for a count of 4, promoting lymphatic circulation.

neck-flexion-stretch.name: Gentle Neck Flexion Stretch
neck-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Place hands gently at the back of your head.
neck-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, allowing the weight of your hands to provide gentle traction. Hold the stretch without forcing any movement.

lightweight-shoulder-flexion.name: Lightweight Shoulder Flexion
lightweight-shoulder-flexion.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms extended. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
lightweight-shoulder-flexion.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms forward and upward in a controlled arc until they reach shoulder height. Lower slowly back to the starting position without jerking.

lightweight-lateral-raises.name: Lightweight Lateral Raises
lightweight-lateral-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, holding light dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Engage your core and keep shoulders down.
lightweight-lateral-raises.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides in a slow, controlled motion until they reach shoulder height. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.

lightweight-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Lightweight Shoulder External Rotation
lightweight-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with elbows bent at 90 degrees, held close to your ribs, holding light dumbbells with forearms in neutral position. Keep your upper arms stationary throughout.
lightweight-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate forearms outward away from your body in a controlled motion using shoulder external rotation. Return to the starting position without moving your elbows or upper arms.

standing-wall-pushups.name: Standing Wall Push-ups
standing-wall-pushups.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall at arm's length away with feet hip-width apart and hands placed flat on the wall at shoulder height. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
standing-wall-pushups.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and lean your body toward the wall, lowering your chest in a controlled manner. Push through your hands to return to the starting position.

seated-marching-arm-swings.name: Seated Marching with Arm Swings
seated-marching-arm-swings.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides. Maintain good posture with your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
seated-marching-arm-swings.endPoseDescription: Alternately lift knees while swinging opposite arms in a marching motion, keeping movements controlled and smooth. Gradually increase tempo while maintaining proper form and breathing consistently.

seated-shoulder-rows-band.name: Seated Shoulder Rows with Band
seated-shoulder-rows-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around a fixed point at shoulder height in front of you. Hold both ends of the band with arms extended forward at shoulder level.
seated-shoulder-rows-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest, bending your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight and return to start with controlled motion.

seated-standing-march-band.name: Seated Standing March with Resistance Band
seated-standing-march-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a sturdy chair with a resistance band around your thighs just above the knees. Maintain good posture with hands on the chair for light support.
seated-standing-march-band.endPoseDescription: March in place by lifting one knee up against the band resistance while maintaining balance. Alternate legs in a controlled, steady rhythm.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

standing-bicep-curls-band.name: Standing Bicep Curls with Band
standing-bicep-curls-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, standing on a resistance band with both feet. Hold the band ends in each hand with arms at your sides and palms facing forward.
standing-bicep-curls-band.endPoseDescription: Bend your elbows and curl your hands toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary. Slowly lower back to start with control.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

gluteal-sets.name: Gluteal Sets
gluteal-sets.startPoseDescription: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Keep your arms at your sides with palms down.
gluteal-sets.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your buttock muscles as tightly as possible and hold the contraction. Maintain the squeeze for 3-5 seconds while keeping your hips level.

seated-knee-lifts.name: Seated Knee Lifts
seated-knee-lifts.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with your back against the backrest and both feet flat on the floor. Keep your hands on your thighs or the sides of the chair.
seated-knee-lifts.endPoseDescription: Straighten one leg by lifting your foot up while keeping your thigh on the chair, fully extending your knee. Lower your foot back down and repeat on the opposite leg.

seated-arm-lifts.name: Seated Arm Lifts
seated-arm-lifts.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a firm chair with your feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
seated-arm-lifts.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise both arms up toward shoulder height with elbows bent, lifting hands toward your armpits. Lower your arms back down with control and repeat.

four-seven-eight-breathing.name: 4-7-8 Breathing Pattern
four-seven-eight-breathing.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable position with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. Rest your hands on your thighs.
four-seven-eight-breathing.endPoseDescription: Inhale through your nose for 4 counts, hold for 7 counts, then exhale through your mouth for 8 counts. Repeat the pattern for 4 complete cycles.

dumbbell-farmers-carry-breathing.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Carry with Breathing
dumbbell-farmers-carry-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip. Keep your shoulders back and core engaged.
dumbbell-farmers-carry-breathing.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly for 30-40 steps while maintaining diaphragmatic breathing, taking one breath per 2-3 steps. Keep your posture tall and stable throughout.

quadruped-breathing-arm-lifts.name: Quadruped Breathing with Arm Lifts
quadruped-breathing-arm-lifts.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips. Your spine is neutral and core is engaged.
quadruped-breathing-arm-lifts.endPoseDescription: Inhale and extend your right arm forward to shoulder height while maintaining spinal stability. Exhale as you return to start, then repeat on the left side.

standing-chest-opener-breathing.name: Standing Chest Opener with Deep Breathing
standing-chest-opener-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at waist level with arms extended forward. Your posture is upright with shoulders relaxed.
standing-chest-opener-breathing.endPoseDescription: Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc while inhaling deeply through your nose and expanding your ribcage. Exhale as you return to the starting position.

dumbbell-goblet-squat-breathing.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat with Box Breathing
dumbbell-goblet-squat-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Your core is engaged and chest is upright.
dumbbell-goblet-squat-breathing.endPoseDescription: Lower into a squat while breathing in for 4 counts, hold the bottom position for 4 counts, then stand while exhaling for 4 counts. Pause at the top for 4 counts before repeating.

side-lying-ribcage-expansion.name: Side-Lying Ribcage Expansion
side-lying-ribcage-expansion.startPoseDescription: Lie on your left side with your left arm extended on the ground and right arm resting on your torso. Your hips and shoulders are stacked.
side-lying-ribcage-expansion.endPoseDescription: Inhale deeply while opening your right arm up and back, rotating your ribcage and thorax toward the ceiling. Exhale as you return your arm to your torso.

dumbbell-overhead-press-breathing.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press with Breathing Control
dumbbell-overhead-press-breathing.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows bent. Your core is engaged and posture is tall.
dumbbell-overhead-press-breathing.endPoseDescription: Exhale as you press the dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner until arms are nearly fully extended. Inhale as you lower the weights back to shoulder height.

breathing-sustained-plank.name: Breathing with Sustained Plank
breathing-sustained-plank.startPoseDescription: Hold a plank position with forearms on the ground and elbows under shoulders, body forming a straight line from head to heels. Your core is fully engaged.
breathing-sustained-plank.endPoseDescription: Maintain the plank while practicing rhythmic diaphragmatic breathing, taking full breaths without allowing your hips to sag or pike upward. Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing continuously.

thumb-ip-flexion-isometric.name: Thumb IP Joint Flexion Isometric
thumb-ip-flexion-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up. Your affected thumb is extended straight out with fingers relaxed.
thumb-ip-flexion-isometric.endPoseDescription: Gently bend only the tip joint of your thumb while pressing against mild resistance from your opposite hand. Hold this isometric contraction for 5 seconds without allowing movement.

thumb-mcp-flexion-strengthening.name: Thumb MCP Joint Flexion Strengthening
thumb-mcp-flexion-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Your thumb is extended straight out from your hand with other fingers relaxed.
thumb-mcp-flexion-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Curl your thumb downward at the middle knuckle joint, bending it across your palm. Hold this position briefly, then return to start maintaining control throughout.

thumb-abduction-resistance.name: Thumb Abduction Against Resistance
thumb-abduction-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your hand flat on a table, palm down. Your thumb is positioned close to your index finger in a neutral position.
thumb-abduction-resistance.endPoseDescription: Lift your thumb away from your index finger against light resistance from a therapy band or your opposite hand. Hold at end range for 2 seconds before returning.

thumb-adduction-strengthening.name: Thumb Adduction Strengthening
thumb-adduction-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand flat on a table, palm down, with your thumb abducted away from your index finger. Place a soft object like a foam ball between thumb and palm.
thumb-adduction-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb inward against the resistance, squeezing the object gently. Hold for 3 seconds, focusing on controlled activation of the thumb muscles.

thumb-opposition-exercise.name: Thumb Opposition Exercise
thumb-opposition-exercise.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your hand open in front of you, palm facing upward. Your thumb is relaxed in neutral position away from your fingers.
thumb-opposition-exercise.endPoseDescription: Slowly bring your thumb across your palm to touch the tip of each finger sequentially from index to pinky. Move through the full range of opposition smoothly.

wrist-radial-deviation-strengthening.name: Wrist Radial Deviation Strengthening
wrist-radial-deviation-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm pronated and supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell (1-3 lbs) with your thumb facing up. Your wrist is in neutral position.
wrist-radial-deviation-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Lift your hand upward by deviating at the wrist toward the thumb side, creating a gentle arc. Control the movement as you return to neutral position slowly.

ulnar-nerve-gliding-mobilization.name: Ulnar Nerve Gliding Mobilization
ulnar-nerve-gliding-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your arm at your side, elbow extended, and fingers relaxed in neutral. Your neck is in neutral alignment.
ulnar-nerve-gliding-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your arm overhead while gently tilting your head away from the raised arm. This creates gentle tension in the ulnar nerve pathway that controls thumb function.

pip-joint-extension-isometric.name: PIP Joint Extension Isometric Hold
pip-joint-extension-isometric.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing down. Place your affected finger in a slightly flexed position with the PIP joint bent at approximately 30 degrees.
pip-joint-extension-isometric.endPoseDescription: Gently press the top of your finger downward against resistance from your other hand while maintaining the PIP joint in extension. Hold this isometric contraction for the prescribed duration without allowing movement.

finger-flexor-stretch-band.name: Finger Flexor Stretch with Resistance Band
finger-flexor-stretch-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing up. Loop a resistance band around your affected finger just below the PIP joint.
finger-flexor-stretch-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band upward to extend the PIP joint into a comfortable stretch. Maintain this gentle tension for the prescribed duration, feeling a stretch along the flexor surface of your finger.

resisted-pip-extension-band.name: Resisted PIP Extension with Band
resisted-pip-extension-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down. Loop a resistance band around your affected finger at the middle phalanx with slight tension in the flexed position.
resisted-pip-extension-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly extend the PIP joint against the band resistance, straightening the finger joint while maintaining control. Hold briefly at full extension before slowly returning to the starting position.

dip-joint-active-rom.name: DIP Joint Active Range of Motion
dip-joint-active-rom.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your hand resting on a table, palm down, with the affected finger supported. The finger should be in a neutral, relaxed position.
dip-joint-active-rom.endPoseDescription: Actively flex and extend only the DIP joint (furthest finger joint) while keeping the PIP joint relatively still. Move through the full available range of motion in a controlled manner.

intrinsic-muscle-activation-band.name: Intrinsic Muscle Activation with Band Loops
intrinsic-muscle-activation-band.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand flat on a table, palm down. Place resistance band loops around each finger, creating gentle downward pressure on the fingers.
intrinsic-muscle-activation-band.endPoseDescription: Lift all fingers upward against the band resistance while keeping your palm flat on the table. Focus on activating the intrinsic hand muscles that support proper finger extension and prevent deformity.

finger-abduction-band-resistance.name: Progressive Finger Abduction with Band Resistance
finger-abduction-band-resistance.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand relaxed on a table, palm down, with fingers slightly apart. Loop a resistance band around two fingers to be separated.
finger-abduction-band-resistance.endPoseDescription: Slowly spread the two fingers apart against the band resistance, maintaining proper PIP extension throughout the movement. Hold briefly at maximum separation before slowly returning to neutral.

sustained-pip-extension-gravity.name: Sustained PIP Extension with Gravity Resistance
sustained-pip-extension-gravity.startPoseDescription: Sit with your arm extended forward and palm facing down at shoulder height. Allow your affected finger to hang in a slightly flexed position beneath your hand.
sustained-pip-extension-gravity.endPoseDescription: Extend the PIP joint against gravity to straighten the finger fully. Hold this extended position while fighting the natural tendency of the joint to flex, building endurance in the extensor mechanism.

protective-splinting-position.name: Protective Finger Splinting Position Exercise
protective-splinting-position.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your hand resting on a table in a neutral position. Your affected finger should be relaxed and in its natural position.
protective-splinting-position.endPoseDescription: Gently position your finger into the proper splinting alignment, with the PIP joint in slight extension and the DIP joint in slight flexion. Hold this therapeutic position for the prescribed duration to train proper joint mechanics.

thumb-abduction-stretch.name: Thumb Abduction Stretch
thumb-abduction-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table with your palm facing down. Your hand is relaxed in a neutral position.
thumb-abduction-stretch.endPoseDescription: Using your other hand, gently pull your thumb away from your fingers into a wide abduction position. Hold the stretch gently without forcing the joint.

grip-strengthening-soft.name: Grip Strengthening with Soft Object
grip-strengthening-soft.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably and hold a soft object like a foam ball or rolled towel in your hand at rest. Your fingers are relaxed around the object.
grip-strengthening-soft.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze the object with your whole hand, including your thumb, for 3-5 seconds. Release and rest before repeating.

thumb-isometric-stabilization.name: Thumb Isometric Stabilization
thumb-isometric-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported and your hand open on a table. Place your other hand's index finger against the side of your thumb.
thumb-isometric-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb firmly against the resistance of your other hand without moving. Hold for 5 seconds, then release and rest.

hand-dexterity-drills.name: Hand and Finger Dexterity Drills
hand-dexterity-drills.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your hands resting in your lap or on a table. Your fingers are relaxed and slightly spread apart.
hand-dexterity-drills.endPoseDescription: Slowly tap each finger to your thumb in sequence, then reverse the pattern. Move gently and focus on controlled, deliberate movements.

thumb-cmc-stabilization.name: Thumb CMC Joint Stabilization
thumb-cmc-stabilization.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting palm-up on a table. Your thumb is relaxed and positioned naturally away from your fingers.
thumb-cmc-stabilization.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb firmly into the table surface and hold for 5 seconds without moving. Relax and repeat, maintaining gentle pressure throughout.

gentle-finger-flexion-with-splint.name: Gentle Finger Flexion with Splint
gentle-finger-flexion-with-splint.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, hand in a neutral position with the mallet finger splint in place. Your other fingers are extended.
gentle-finger-flexion-with-splint.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl the fingers without the splint into a loose fist, bending only at the PIP and DIP joints. The splinted finger remains fully extended in its protective position.

grip-strength-with-ball.name: Grip Strength with Ball
grip-strength-with-ball.startPoseDescription: Sit upright holding a soft therapy ball or stress ball in your palm with fingers relaxed around it. The splinted finger is protected and rests on top of the ball.
grip-strength-with-ball.endPoseDescription: Gently squeeze the ball using your unaffected fingers and palm, keeping the splinted finger relaxed on top without flexing at the tip joint. Release and repeat for gentle grip training.

light-dumbbell-wrist-curls.name: Light Dumbbell Wrist Curls
light-dumbbell-wrist-curls.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, holding a light dumbbell in your hand with your wrist extended slightly beyond the table edge. Your fingers are relaxed around the weight.
light-dumbbell-wrist-curls.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your wrist upward against the weight of the dumbbell, then slowly lower it back down. Keep movement controlled and gentle to avoid stressing the healing mallet finger.

reverse-wrist-curls-light-weight.name: Reverse Wrist Curls with Light Weight
reverse-wrist-curls-light-weight.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing downward, holding a light dumbbell with your wrist extended slightly beyond the table edge. Your fingers are relaxed.
reverse-wrist-curls-light-weight.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift the back of your hand upward, extending your wrist against the dumbbell weight, then lower it gently back down. Keep movements controlled to build strength without compromising the splinted finger.

finger-isolation-tapping.name: Finger Isolation and Tapping
finger-isolation-tapping.startPoseDescription: Sit with your hand resting on a table, palm facing downward with the mallet finger splint in place. Your fingers are extended in a relaxed position.
finger-isolation-tapping.endPoseDescription: Gently tap each unaffected finger one at a time on the table while keeping the others still. The splinted finger remains completely stationary in the protective splint throughout the exercise.

plantar-fascia-release-with-ball.name: Plantar Fascia Release with Ball
plantar-fascia-release-with-ball.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your foot flat on the ground or elevated slightly. Have a foam roller or massage ball ready.
plantar-fascia-release-with-ball.endPoseDescription: Roll the ball along the arch of your foot from heel to toe, applying moderate pressure. Spend extra time on tender spots to release tension in the plantar fascia.

quad-sets-with-towel-roll.name: Quad Sets with Towel Roll
quad-sets-with-towel-roll.startPoseDescription: Sit with your back against a wall or bench with a small towel roll placed under your knee. Keep your other leg extended or bent.
quad-sets-with-towel-roll.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps muscle by pressing the back of your knee down into the towel roll and straightening your leg. Hold for 2-3 seconds and feel the muscle contract.

calf-raises-off-loading.name: Calf Raises (Off-loading variation)
calf-raises-off-loading.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall or holding onto a sturdy bar with feet hip-width apart and weight distributed evenly. Place most of your weight through your heels to reduce pressure on the sesamoids.
calf-raises-off-loading.endPoseDescription: Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting onto the balls of your feet while maintaining weight through the heel side. Lower back down with control to return to start.

seated-hip-abduction-resistance-band.name: Seated Hip Abduction with Resistance Band
seated-hip-abduction-resistance-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with a resistance band looped around both thighs just above the knees. Keep your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
seated-hip-abduction-resistance-band.endPoseDescription: Press your knees outward against the resistance band, opening your legs apart. Hold for 2 seconds at the end range and slowly return to the starting position.

intrinsic-foot-muscle-activation.name: Intrinsic Foot Muscle Activation
intrinsic-foot-muscle-activation.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with your foot flat on the floor and toes relaxed. Focus on the arch of your foot.
intrinsic-foot-muscle-activation.endPoseDescription: Without curling your toes, shorten the arch by drawing the ball of your foot toward the heel while keeping your toes extended. Hold for 3-5 seconds and release.

supine-core-engagement-neutral-spine.name: Supine Core Engagement with Neutral Spine
supine-core-engagement-neutral-spine.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms at your sides. Maintain a neutral spine with a small gap between your lower back and the floor.
supine-core-engagement-neutral-spine.endPoseDescription: Gently engage your core by drawing your lower ribs toward your pelvis without flattening your lower back. Breathe steadily and hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.

stationary-bike-flat-pedal.name: Stationary Bike with Flat Pedal Position
stationary-bike-flat-pedal.startPoseDescription: Sit on a stationary bike with proper seat height adjusted so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke. Keep the pedal platform flat under the forefoot to avoid sesamoid pressure.
stationary-bike-flat-pedal.endPoseDescription: Pedal smoothly with moderate resistance at a comfortable pace, keeping weight distributed across the entire foot rather than on the ball of the foot.

seated-foot-inversion-with-band.name: Seated Foot Inversion with Band
seated-foot-inversion-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with legs extended in front of you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of your foot with the foot in a neutral position.
seated-foot-inversion-with-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn the sole of your foot inward (inversion) against the band resistance. Hold the end position for 2 seconds while maintaining tension.

seated-plantar-fascia-stretch-with-band.name: Seated Plantar Fascia Stretch with Band
seated-plantar-fascia-stretch-with-band.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one leg crossed over the opposite knee so the sole of your foot faces you. Loop a resistance band around the ball of the foot.
seated-plantar-fascia-stretch-with-band.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the band toward your shin to dorsiflex the foot, creating a stretch along the bottom of the foot and arch. Hold the stretch for 30 seconds.

resisted-foot-eversion.name: Resisted Foot Eversion
resisted-foot-eversion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with legs extended and a resistance band looped around the ball of one foot. Your foot starts in a neutral position.
resisted-foot-eversion.endPoseDescription: Rotate the sole of your foot outward (eversion) against the band resistance. Maintain the movement slowly and with control.

calf-raises-with-band-support.name: Calf Raises with Band Support
calf-raises-with-band-support.startPoseDescription: Stand upright facing a wall or holding a resistance band attached to a fixed object for light support. Feet are hip-width apart with weight distributed evenly.
calf-raises-with-band-support.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels off the ground. Hold the peak position for 1 second before lowering back down.

prone-hip-extension-with-band.name: Prone Hip Extension with Band
prone-hip-extension-with-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down with a resistance band looped around both feet at the arches. Your forehead rests on your hands with core engaged.
prone-hip-extension-with-band.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your glutes and lift one leg upward against the band resistance while keeping the other leg on the ground. Lower with control and alternate sides.

seated-toe-flexor-stretch.name: Seated Toe Flexor Stretch
seated-toe-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with one foot crossed over the opposite knee, exposing the sole of your foot. Gently press your fingers against the underside of your toes.
seated-toe-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Apply gentle pressure to curl your toes back toward your shin, creating a stretch along the bottom of the foot. Hold for 30 seconds without forcing.

seated-foot-flexor-stretch.name: Seated Foot Flexor Stretch
seated-foot-flexor-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor. Place one foot across the opposite knee to access the sole of the foot.
seated-foot-flexor-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull the toes and ball of the foot toward the shin, creating a stretch along the plantar fascia and arch. Hold this stretched position while maintaining an upright posture.

calf-raises-bilateral.name: Calf Raises - Bilateral
calf-raises-bilateral.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands lightly resting on a chair or countertop for balance. Your weight should be distributed evenly across all foot contact points.
calf-raises-bilateral.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels off the ground while maintaining balance. Hold the elevated position, then slowly lower heels back to the floor.

seated-hip-marches.name: Seated Hip Marches
seated-hip-marches.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor at hip-width apart. Maintain good posture with your back against the chair.
seated-hip-marches.endPoseDescription: Lift one knee up toward the chest while keeping the other foot on the ground. Alternate lifting knees in a marching motion, moving at a comfortable pace.

glute-bridge-supine.name: Supine Glute Bridge
glute-bridge-supine.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart and parallel. Arms should rest at your sides with palms down for stability.
glute-bridge-supine.endPoseDescription: Push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold briefly before lowering.

quad-sets-standing-wall.name: Standing Quad Sets - Wall Support
quad-sets-standing-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with hands lightly touching the wall for balance at shoulder height. Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
quad-sets-standing-wall.endPoseDescription: Tighten the quadriceps muscle on one leg by straightening the knee fully without locking it. Hold the contraction for 2-3 seconds, then relax and repeat before switching legs.

ankle-circles-seated.name: Seated Ankle Circles
ankle-circles-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and lift one foot slightly off the ground, keeping the knee bent at approximately 90 degrees. The lifted foot should be relaxed.
ankle-circles-seated.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your foot in circular motions, drawing imaginary circles in the air with your toes. Complete circles in both directions, maintaining smooth, controlled movements.

hip-abduction-standing-wall.name: Standing Hip Abduction - Wall Support
hip-abduction-standing-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand sideways to a wall with your hand lightly resting on the wall for balance. Keep your feet hip-width apart and maintain upright posture.
hip-abduction-standing-wall.endPoseDescription: Lift the outer leg out to the side, keeping it straight and level with the hip. Maintain this raised position briefly, then lower the leg back down with control.

big-toe-joint-mobilization.name: Big Toe Joint Mobilization
big-toe-joint-mobilization.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with one leg crossed over the opposite knee, bringing the foot closer to your body. Grasp your big toe gently with your hand.
big-toe-joint-mobilization.endPoseDescription: Slowly and gently dorsiflex (bend upward) and plantarflex (bend downward) the big toe through its available range of motion. Hold gentle stretches at the end of each direction for 2 seconds.

seated-toe-taps.name: Seated Toe Taps
seated-toe-taps.startPoseDescription: Sit in a chair with both feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees. Keep your heel planted and toes relaxed.
seated-toe-taps.endPoseDescription: Tap your toes up and down at the forefoot while keeping your heel firmly on the ground, moving only at the ball of the foot and toe joints. Perform 15-20 taps, moving through a comfortable, pain-free range.

glute-strengthening-with-dumbbell.name: Glute Strengthening with Dumbbell
glute-strengthening-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Engage your core and maintain neutral spine.
glute-strengthening-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lower into a single-leg squat on the opposite leg while keeping your chest upright, then drive through the heel to return to standing. Performing 10-12 repetitions reduces compensatory stress on the hallux rigidus.

figure-four-stretch.name: Figure Four Stretch
figure-four-stretch.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place one ankle across the opposite thigh, creating a figure-four shape.
figure-four-stretch.endPoseDescription: Pull the bottom leg's thigh toward your chest using your hands, deepening the stretch in the outer hip and glute of the crossed leg. Hold and breathe deeply.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand upright on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand. Keep your core engaged and shoulders back.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while extending your free leg behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the floor. Return to standing while maintaining a neutral spine throughout the movement.
conditions_seen_in: lumbar disc herniation return to golf

side-lying-external-rotation-band.name: Side-Lying External Rotation with Band
side-lying-external-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Lie on your left side with your right arm at your side, elbow bent to 90 degrees, holding a looped resistance band. Your forearm rests across your stomach.
side-lying-external-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your right forearm upward against the band resistance, keeping your elbow fixed at your side. Your forearm lifts toward your chest while maintaining the 90-degree elbow angle.

banded-internal-rotation-90-90.name: Banded Internal Rotation at 90/90
banded-internal-rotation-90-90.startPoseDescription: Stand with your right arm raised to 90 degrees at the shoulder and bent 90 degrees at the elbow, holding a resistance band. Your forearm points upward and slightly back.
banded-internal-rotation-90-90.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm forward and downward against band resistance, bringing it toward your midline. Your upper arm and elbow remain fixed at 90 degrees throughout the movement.

half-kneeling-single-arm-row-band.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Row with Band
half-kneeling-single-arm-row-band.startPoseDescription: Kneel on your right knee with left foot forward, holding a resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you. Your arm is extended straight out with the band at medium tension.
half-kneeling-single-arm-row-band.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your ribcage by driving your elbow back, squeezing your shoulder blade toward your spine. Your torso remains upright and stable with minimal rotation.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

standing-shoulder-abduction-band.name: Standing Shoulder Abduction with Band
standing-shoulder-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, stepping on a resistance band with both feet and holding the other end in each hand at your sides. Your arms hang naturally with a slight bend at the elbows.
standing-shoulder-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, lifting against the band resistance. Your arms form a T position with thumbs pointing upward and elbows slightly bent.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

prone-horizontal-abduction-band.name: Prone Horizontal Abduction with Band
prone-horizontal-abduction-band.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a table with both arms hanging off the edge, holding a resistance band that's anchored underneath. Your arms hang naturally at the sides with the band at slight tension.
prone-horizontal-abduction-band.endPoseDescription: Raise both arms out to the sides against band resistance, lifting to shoulder height with elbows slightly bent. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end position.
conditions_seen_in: shoulder labral repair return to throwing

double-leg-calf-raises.name: Double Leg Calf Raises
double-leg-calf-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, hands lightly touching a wall or sturdy chair for balance. Keep your core engaged and shoulders relaxed.
double-leg-calf-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels as high as comfortable off the ground. Hold briefly at the top, then lower heels back down with control.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

seated-ankle-plantarflexion.name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion
seated-ankle-plantarflexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor, knees at 90 degrees. Maintain neutral posture with hands on your lap or armrests.
seated-ankle-plantarflexion.endPoseDescription: Point your toes downward and away from your body, extending through the ankle joint. Hold briefly, then slowly return your foot to the starting neutral position.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

seated-inversion-ankle-stretch.name: Seated Inversion Ankle Stretch
seated-inversion-ankle-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair and cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-4 position. Keep your posture tall and stable.
seated-inversion-ankle-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently turn the sole of your right foot inward toward your body and hold the position. Feel a mild stretch along the outside of the ankle and lower leg.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

tandem-stance-walk.name: Tandem Stance Walk
tandem-stance-walk.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with one hand lightly touching a wall or chair for balance. Position your feet in a heel-to-toe line as if walking a tightrope.
tandem-stance-walk.endPoseDescription: Slowly move forward by placing one foot directly in front of the other in a straight line, maintaining the heel-to-toe alignment. Move deliberately while keeping light contact with the wall.
conditions_seen_in: ankle sprain return to cutting sports

step-ups-with-dumbbell.name: Step-Ups with Dumbbell
step-ups-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a low step (4-6 inches) holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Position the surgical leg in front of the step.
step-ups-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the step with the surgical leg, driving through the heel and standing fully upright on the step. Step down with control and repeat.

walking-lunges-with-dumbbell.name: Walking Lunges with Dumbbell
walking-lunges-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with feet hip-width apart. Take a controlled step forward with the surgical leg.
walking-lunges-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Lower your body by bending both knees until the back knee nearly touches the ground and the front knee is at 90 degrees. Push through the front heel to return to standing.
conditions_seen_in: ACL post-op return to running (16 weeks)

hamstring-curls-with-dumbbell.name: Hamstring Curls with Dumbbell
hamstring-curls-with-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on the floor with forehead resting on your hands. Both legs are extended with a dumbbell placed between your feet.
hamstring-curls-with-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Bend the surgical knee, curling the heel toward the glutes while keeping the thigh on the ground. Hold briefly, then lower with control.
conditions_seen_in: ACL post-op return to running (16 weeks)

plantar-fascia-foot-stretch.name: Plantar Fascia Foot Stretch
plantar-fascia-foot-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with one foot placed on the opposite knee, crossing your legs. The sole of the foot is facing toward you.
plantar-fascia-foot-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently pull your toes back toward your shin using your fingers, creating a stretch along the bottom of your foot.
conditions_seen_in: chef lower back and plantar fascia pain

pronation-supination.name: Pronation and Supination
pronation-supination.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and held against your side, palm facing down (pronated position). Keep your upper arm stable and only rotate at the forearm.
pronation-supination.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm to turn your palm upward (supinated position), then rotate back to palm-down. Move through the full range of motion available without forcing.

seated-torso-twist-gentle.name: Seated Torso Twist - Gentle
seated-torso-twist-gentle.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hands crossed over your chest or arms at shoulder height. Maintain good upright posture.
seated-torso-twist-gentle.endPoseDescription: Gently rotate your torso to one side, holding the twist for 15-20 seconds while keeping hips still. Return to center and repeat on the other side.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

lateral-neck-flexion-stretch.name: Lateral Neck Flexion - Stretch
lateral-neck-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Maintain a neutral head position with eyes forward.
lateral-neck-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head to bring your ear toward your shoulder, creating a stretch along the opposite side of the neck. Hold for 20-30 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the other side.

gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.name: Gentle Wrist Flexion Stretch
gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your affected arm extended in front of you, palm facing upward. Your opposite hand is positioned to gently assist the stretch.
gentle-wrist-flexion-stretch.endPoseDescription: Slowly press the back of your extended hand downward with your opposite hand, creating a gentle stretch through the forearm. Keep your elbow straight but not locked, maintaining a comfortable stretch sensation.

warm-compress-rest.name: Warm Compress and Rest
warm-compress-rest.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably in a chair with your hand resting in your lap or on a table. Prepare to apply warm, moist heat to the affected hand.
warm-compress-rest.endPoseDescription: Hold a warm (not hot) compress or soak your hand in warm water for 5-10 minutes. Keep the hand relaxed and allow gentle circulation to the affected area.

graded-grip-strengthening.name: Graded Grip Strengthening
graded-grip-strengthening.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a therapy ball or soft grip tool in your hand, arm at your side. Keep your wrist in neutral position.
graded-grip-strengthening.endPoseDescription: Squeeze the tool gently to 50% effort, holding for 3-5 seconds. Release slowly and rest between repetitions.

knee-rom-flexion.name: Knee Range of Motion Flexion
knee-rom-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit on a chair with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Keep the other leg relaxed.
knee-rom-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one foot off the ground by bending the knee, bringing your heel toward your buttock through full comfortable range. Lower with control and repeat.

prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.name: Prone Shoulder Horizontal Abduction
prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bed with your arm hanging off the edge at about 90 degrees of abduction. Your head rests on the surface with neck in neutral.
prone-shoulder-horizontal-abduction.endPoseDescription: Raise your arm outward and slightly backward to shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blade. Lower back down with control and repeat.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff prehab for overhead athletes

prone-t-y-i-holds.name: Prone T-Y-I Holds
prone-t-y-i-holds.startPoseDescription: Lie face down on a bench with your chest at the edge and feet on the ground for stability. Your arms hang toward the floor with a slight bend in the elbows.
prone-t-y-i-holds.endPoseDescription: Raise your arms to form a 'T' shape (90 degrees from body), then lift to a 'Y' shape (135 degrees), and finally to an 'I' shape (180 degrees overhead). Squeeze your shoulder blades at each position.

shoulder-internal-rotation-band.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation with Band
shoulder-internal-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with your right elbow bent at 90 degrees, tucked against your ribs with forearm pointing forward. Hold one end of a resistance band, with the band anchored at elbow height to your right side.
shoulder-internal-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm inward across your body, maintaining the 90-degree elbow angle and keeping your elbow fixed at your side. The band should provide gentle resistance through the full range of internal rotation.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a slight knee bend. Your standing leg is engaged and your core is tight.
single-leg-romanian-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge at the hip while keeping your back leg extended behind you for balance, lowering the dumbbell toward the ground. Your torso remains in line with your extended leg.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

standing-torso-rotation-with-band.name: Standing Torso Rotation with Band
standing-torso-rotation-with-band.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands extended in front of you. Engage your core and keep your hips still.
standing-torso-rotation-with-band.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the band across your body while keeping your arms at chest level. Hold briefly and return to center, then rotate to the opposite side.
conditions_seen_in: diabetes management aerobic and resistance program

gentle-knee-flexion.name: Gentle Knee Flexion
gentle-knee-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Keep your back supported against the chair.
gentle-knee-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly lift one foot off the ground by bending the knee, raising your shin toward your chest as far as comfortable. Hold briefly, then lower back down with control.

resistance-band-rows-seated.name: Resistance Band Rows - Seated
resistance-band-rows-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with a looped resistance band anchored at chest height in front of you, holding both ends with arms extended forward. Your back is straight and core is engaged.
resistance-band-rows-seated.endPoseDescription: Pull the band toward your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Your elbows should pass your torso at the peak of the movement.
conditions_seen_in: dentist upper back and neck strain

gentle-finger-flexion.name: Gentle Finger Flexion Exercises
gentle-finger-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit comfortably with your forearm supported on a table, palm facing down. Keep your wrist in a neutral position with fingers fully extended.
gentle-finger-flexion.endPoseDescription: Slowly curl your fingers inward to make a gentle fist, bending only at the knuckles without forcing. Hold briefly and return to the extended position.

scapular-squeeze-retraction.name: Scapular Squeeze with Retraction
scapular-squeeze-retraction.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with arms at your sides, palms facing forward, and shoulders in a neutral position. Your chest is open and your posture is tall.
scapular-squeeze-retraction.endPoseDescription: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down your back, pulling your arms slightly backward while maintaining neutral neck position. Hold this contraction for 2 seconds.

supine-bridge.name: Supine Bridge
supine-bridge.startPoseDescription: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms at your sides. Keep your neck relaxed and head supported by the floor.
supine-bridge.endPoseDescription: Lift your hips upward by driving through your heels until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Hold at the top while maintaining neutral cervical alignment.

dumbbell-deadlifts-light.name: Dumbbell Deadlifts (Light)
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells at your sides with arms straight. Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
dumbbell-deadlifts-light.endPoseDescription: Hinge at your hips while maintaining a neutral spine, lowering the weights down your legs. Drive through your heels to return to standing position.

seated-sleeper-stretch.name: Seated Sleeper Stretch
seated-sleeper-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and your back against the chair back. Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height with elbow bent.
seated-sleeper-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull your bent elbow toward your chest, creating a stretch across the back of the operative shoulder. Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds while maintaining upright posture.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff repair return to overhead sport (6 months)

shoulder-rolls-seated.name: Shoulder Rolls - Seated
shoulder-rolls-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms relaxed at your sides. Maintain an upright posture with shoulders in a neutral position.
shoulder-rolls-seated.endPoseDescription: Roll both shoulders backward in a circular motion for 5-8 repetitions, then reverse direction and roll forward. Move slowly and smoothly through the full range of motion.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

standing-quad-sets-band.name: Standing Quad Sets with Band
standing-quad-sets-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with a resistance band looped around your knee and the other end anchored low behind you. Keep your knee slightly bent and core engaged.
standing-quad-sets-band.endPoseDescription: Straighten your knee against the band resistance, fully extending your leg while maintaining an upright posture. Hold at full extension before slowly returning to the starting position.

standing-heel-toe-raises.name: Standing Heel-Toe Raises
standing-heel-toe-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and hands resting on a wall or chair for balance support. Keep your body straight and core engaged.
standing-heel-toe-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto your toes, lifting your heels off the ground, then lower back down and repeat. Move slowly and controlled throughout the movement.
conditions_seen_in: mild traumatic brain injury return to activity

postural-chin-tucks.name: Postural Chin Tucks
postural-chin-tucks.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders back and spine against the chair. Look straight ahead with your mouth closed and jaw relaxed.
postural-chin-tucks.endPoseDescription: Gently draw your chin straight backward as if creating a double chin, keeping your gaze forward. Hold for 2-3 seconds and release slowly.

neck-isometric-flexion.name: Neck Isometric Flexion
neck-isometric-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and place your interlaced hands behind your head. Your elbows are spread wide to the sides.
neck-isometric-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently press your head forward into your hands while resisting with equal force from your hands, keeping your neck stationary. Hold this isometric contraction for 5 seconds without any movement.

mirror-facial-awareness.name: Mirror Facial Awareness
mirror-facial-awareness.startPoseDescription: Sit upright facing a mirror at eye level, approximately 12-18 inches away. Your posture should be straight and relaxed.
mirror-facial-awareness.endPoseDescription: Perform slow, deliberate facial movements (smile, frown, raise eyebrows, close eyes) while observing symmetry and control in the mirror. Hold each expression for 3-5 seconds.

radial-ulnar-deviation.name: Radial and Ulnar Deviation
radial-ulnar-deviation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table and your hand hanging off the edge in neutral position. Your thumb points upward.
radial-ulnar-deviation.endPoseDescription: Move your wrist side to side, bringing your thumb toward your body, then moving your pinky side toward your body in a controlled motion. Keep your forearm stable throughout.
conditions_seen_in: rock climber finger A2 pulley strain
flexor tendon repair zone 2 (8 weeks post-op)

heel-toe-raises.name: Heel-Toe Raises
heel-toe-raises.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart near a wall or counter for light support. Keep your posture upright and hands available to lightly touch the support if needed.
heel-toe-raises.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto your toes while keeping heels on the ground, then lower down and rock back onto your heels with toes lifted. Move in a slow, controlled rhythm.
conditions_seen_in: osteoporosis safe exercise program for 70 year old

thoracic-rotation-quadruped.name: Thoracic Rotation in Quadruped
thoracic-rotation-quadruped.startPoseDescription: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Place your left hand behind your head with elbow pointing out to the side.
thoracic-rotation-quadruped.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to bring your left elbow toward your right knee, then rotate to open your chest and look up toward the ceiling. Move through the rotation in a controlled manner.

band-shoulder-external-rotation.name: Band-Resisted Shoulder External Rotation
band-shoulder-external-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band anchored at elbow height with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side. Your forearm is positioned across your body horizontally.
band-shoulder-external-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm outward away from your body against band resistance, keeping your elbow stationary at your side. Your forearm moves to approximately 45-90 degrees from the starting position.

step-up-dumbbell.name: Step-Up with Dumbbell
step-up-dumbbell.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a bench or elevated platform holding dumbbells at your sides with your core engaged. Your posture is upright and your feet are hip-width apart.
step-up-dumbbell.endPoseDescription: Step up onto the platform with one leg, driving through that heel to stand tall at the top. Your trailing leg extends behind you or steps up to meet the platform.
conditions_seen_in: ACL injury prevention program for female athletes

doorway-shoulder-stretch.name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
doorway-shoulder-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees and forearm resting against the doorframe. Position your body so you face the doorframe.
doorway-shoulder-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently step forward through the doorway, allowing your chest to stretch as your arm stays anchored on the frame. Feel the stretch across your anterior shoulder and chest.

calf-raises-seated.name: Calf Raises - Seated
calf-raises-seated.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair with feet flat on the floor, hands resting on your lap or holding light dumbbells on your knees. Keep your back against the chair.
calf-raises-seated.endPoseDescription: Raise up onto the balls of your feet by lifting your heels off the ground, engaging the calf muscles. Lower heels back down with control and repeat.
conditions_seen_in: heart failure NYHA class 2 exercise program

standing-quad-sets-wall.name: Standing Quad Sets with Wall Support
standing-quad-sets-wall.startPoseDescription: Stand facing a wall with both hands lightly touching the wall for balance. Keep your feet hip-width apart with a slight knee bend.
standing-quad-sets-wall.endPoseDescription: Tighten your quadriceps muscle and straighten one knee fully, lifting your heel slightly off the ground. Hold for 2-3 seconds and relax, then repeat on the other leg.

calf-raises-step.name: Calf Raises on Step
calf-raises-step.startPoseDescription: Stand on a step or stair with the balls of your feet on the edge and heels hanging off. Hold dumbbells at your sides for added resistance.
calf-raises-step.endPoseDescription: Rise up onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as possible while maintaining pressure through the outer foot. Lower back down with control to the starting position.

cervical-rotation.name: Cervical Range of Motion - Rotation
cervical-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and spine neutral. Keep your eyes forward and jaw relaxed.
cervical-rotation.endPoseDescription: Slowly turn your head to one side, bringing your chin toward your shoulder without forcing. Hold the end position briefly before returning to center.

forearm-pronation-supination-mobility.name: Forearm Pronation Supination Mobility
forearm-pronation-supination-mobility.startPoseDescription: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees held against your body and your hand in neutral position. Perform slow, controlled rotations without resistance.
forearm-pronation-supination-mobility.endPoseDescription: Your forearm has rotated fully to face either palm up or palm down. Move smoothly through the full range of motion without forcing the movement.

doorway-pectoral-stretch.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
doorway-pectoral-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway with your right arm raised to 90 degrees, placing your forearm against the door frame. Your body faces straight ahead with good posture.
doorway-pectoral-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently step forward through the doorway, allowing your body to rotate slightly to the left while maintaining contact with the door frame. You will feel a stretch across your chest and front shoulder.

single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Deadlift
single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.startPoseDescription: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand at your side. Your standing leg is stable and your core is engaged.
single-leg-dumbbell-deadlift.endPoseDescription: Hinge forward at the hip while extending your free leg behind you for balance, allowing the dumbbell to travel down your standing leg. Return to standing and repeat.

big-standing-marching.name: Big Standing Marching
big-standing-marching.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, arms ready at the sides. Maintain good posture with shoulders back and core engaged.
big-standing-marching.endPoseDescription: March in place with exaggerated high knee lifts, bringing each knee up toward chest level with big, purposeful movements. Swing arms in coordination with legs.

seated-thoracic-rotation.name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
seated-thoracic-rotation.startPoseDescription: Sit upright on a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor. Cross your arms across your chest, with your right hand touching your left shoulder and left hand touching your right shoulder.
seated-thoracic-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to the right as far as comfortably possible, keeping your hips stable and facing forward. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.

seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.name: Seated Figure Four Hip Stretch
seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a chair with both feet flat on the floor and good posture. Keep your core gently engaged and shoulders relaxed.
seated-figure-four-hip-stretch.endPoseDescription: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to create a figure four shape, then gently lean forward from the hips. Feel a deep stretch in the outer hip of the crossed leg.

hand-wrist-circles.name: Gentle Hand and Wrist Circles
hand-wrist-circles.startPoseDescription: Stand with arms extended in front of you at shoulder height with palms facing down. Keep your elbows straight but not locked.
hand-wrist-circles.endPoseDescription: Slowly rotate both hands and wrists in full circles, creating smooth circular motions from the wrist joint. Continue rotating in one direction for 10 circles, then reverse.

cervical-lateral-flexion.name: Cervical Range of Motion - Lateral Flexion
cervical-lateral-flexion.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and head in neutral position. Keep both feet flat on the floor.
cervical-lateral-flexion.endPoseDescription: Gently tilt your head toward one shoulder, bringing your ear toward your collarbone without forcing. Feel a mild stretch on the opposite side of the neck.

standing-core-rotation-band.name: Standing Core Rotation with Band
standing-core-rotation-band.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a resistance band at chest height with both hands. Engage your core and keep hips still.
standing-core-rotation-band.endPoseDescription: Rotate your torso to one side, extending the band outward with straight arms. Return to center and rotate to the opposite side with controlled movement.

isometric-wrist-hold.name: Isometric Wrist Hold
isometric-wrist-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, hand hanging slightly off the edge, palm facing down in a neutral position. Your opposite hand is ready to provide gentle resistance.
isometric-wrist-hold.endPoseDescription: Gently press your wrist upward against the resistance of your opposite hand without allowing any movement to occur. Hold this static contraction for 5-10 seconds without pain.

shoulder-cross-body-stretch.name: Shoulder Cross Body Stretch
shoulder-cross-body-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bring one arm across your body at shoulder height. Keep your posture upright.
shoulder-cross-body-stretch.endPoseDescription: Use your opposite hand to gently pull the arm closer to your chest. Relax into the stretch across the back of the shoulder and upper back.

thermal-moist-heat-relaxation.name: Thermal Moist Heat Application with Relaxation
thermal-moist-heat-relaxation.startPoseDescription: Sit in a comfortable, upright position in a quiet environment. Apply a warm, moist heating pad to both sides of your jaw for 5 minutes.
thermal-moist-heat-relaxation.endPoseDescription: While the heat is applied, gently let your mouth fall open slightly and relax all jaw muscles. Breathe deeply and allow tension to release from your facial and neck muscles.

gentle-neck-flexion-extension.name: Gentle Neck Flexion and Extension
gentle-neck-flexion-extension.startPoseDescription: Sit upright in a comfortable chair with shoulders relaxed and feet flat on the floor. Keep your gaze forward with a neutral spine.
gentle-neck-flexion-extension.endPoseDescription: Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, creating a gentle stretch in the back of the neck. Hold briefly, then return to neutral and gently tilt your head back slightly.

heel-to-toe-walking.name: Heel-to-Toe Walking
heel-to-toe-walking.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with arms extended to the sides for balance or lightly touching a wall. Look ahead and maintain good posture.
heel-to-toe-walking.endPoseDescription: Walk forward slowly, placing your heel down first followed by rolling through to your toes. Keep steps deliberate and controlled while maintaining balance.

thumb-cmc-isometric-hold.name: Thumb CMC Joint Isometric Hold
thumb-cmc-isometric-hold.startPoseDescription: Sit upright with your forearm resting on a table, palm facing up. Place your opposite hand's thumb against the base of your affected thumb.
thumb-cmc-isometric-hold.endPoseDescription: Press your thumb against resistance without moving the joint, holding steady pressure for 5-10 seconds. Maintain neutral wrist position throughout the hold.

dumbbell-lateral-lunge.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunges
dumbbell-lateral-lunge.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet together holding dumbbells at your sides, chest up and core engaged. Maintain an upright posture with weight distributed evenly.
dumbbell-lateral-lunge.endPoseDescription: Step out to one side and bend that knee into a lunge position while keeping the other leg straight. The laterally bent leg should push your ankle through its full range of motion.

resistance-band-internal-rotation.name: Resistance Band Internal Rotation
resistance-band-internal-rotation.startPoseDescription: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, holding a resistance band with both hands. Keep your upper arm stationary against your ribcage throughout the movement.
resistance-band-internal-rotation.endPoseDescription: Rotate your forearm inward across your body against the band resistance while maintaining the 90-degree elbow bend. Hold briefly at the end of the range of motion.

thoracic-extension-stretch.name: Thoracic Spine Extension Stretch
thoracic-extension-stretch.startPoseDescription: Sit upright and clasp your hands behind your head with your elbows wide. Your feet are flat on the floor.
thoracic-extension-stretch.endPoseDescription: Gently arch your upper back and press your chest forward while extending through your thoracic spine. Keep your lower back neutral and avoid overextending your lumbar region.

doorway-pec-stretch.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
doorway-pec-stretch.startPoseDescription: Stand in a doorway or against a wall post with your right arm raised to 90 degrees, elbow bent at 90 degrees with forearm vertical. Your palm should be flat against the frame or wall.
doorway-pec-stretch.endPoseDescription: Step forward through the doorway, gently rotating your torso away from your right side, allowing your shoulder to extend and pec to stretch. Keep your spine neutral and hold the stretch position with controlled breathing.
conditions_seen_in: rotator cuff repair return to overhead sport (6 months)

shoulder-pendulum-swings.name: Shoulder Pendulum Swings
shoulder-pendulum-swings.startPoseDescription: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart and let your affected arm hang naturally at your side. Lean slightly forward at the hips for support.
shoulder-pendulum-swings.endPoseDescription: Gently swing your arm forward and backward in a pendulum motion, allowing gravity to assist the movement. Gradually increase the range of motion without forcing it.
conditions_seen_in: CRPS (complex regional pain syndrome) upper limb desensitization
